function NebbieDash.swRunScheduleNext(delay) local run = NebbieDash._swRun if not run or run.status ~= "running" then return end NebbieDash.swRunClearTimers() local gen = run.generation delay = tonumber(delay) or (NebbieDash.speedwalkDelay or 0.35) if delay <= 0 or type(tempTimer) ~= "function" then NebbieDash.swRunSendCurrent() return end run.timerId = tempTimer(delay, function() local r = NebbieDash._swRun if not r or r.generation ~= gen or r.status ~= "running" then return end NebbieDash.swRunSendCurrent() end) end
function NebbieDash.swRunFinish(ok) local run = NebbieDash._swRun if not run then return end local desc = run.desc or "" NebbieDash.swRunClearTimers() run.status = "idle" run.awaitingMove = false run.pauseReason = nil run.walkIndex = nil run.steps = {} run.nextStep = 1 run.generation = (run.generation or 0) + 1 if ok then NebbieDash.swRunNotify("Speedwalk completato" .. (desc ~= "" and (": " .. desc) or ""), "green") end if NebbieDash._swUiCreated and not NebbieDash._swUiHidden then NebbieDash.refreshSwUi() end end
function NebbieDash.swRunPause(reason) local run = NebbieDash._swRun if not run or run.status ~= "running" then return false end NebbieDash.swRunClearTimers() run.status = "paused" run.awaitingMove = false run.pauseReason = reason or "pausa" NebbieDash.swRunNotify( "Speedwalk in pausa @ passo " .. tostring(run.nextStep) .. "/" .. tostring(#(run.steps or {})) .. (reason and (" (" .. reason .. ")") or "") .. " — <yellow>nsw resume<green> / <yellow>nsw skip", "orange") return true end
function NebbieDash.swRunResume(skipCurrent) local run = NebbieDash._swRun if not run or run.status ~= "paused" then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Nessuno speedwalk in pausa.
") return false end if skipCurrent then run.nextStep = (tonumber(run.nextStep) or 1) + 1 end if (tonumber(run.nextStep) or 1) > #(run.steps or {}) then NebbieDash.swRunFinish(true) return true end run.status = "running" run.pauseReason = nil run.generation = (run.generation or 0) + 1 NebbieDash.swRunNotify( "Riprendo speedwalk @ passo " .. tostring(run.nextStep) .. "/" .. tostring(#run.steps) .. (skipCurrent and " (skip)" or ""), "green") NebbieDash.swRunScheduleNext(0) return true end
function NebbieDash.swRunStop() local run = NebbieDash._swRun if not run or run.status == "idle" then cecho("<grey>[NebbieDash] Nessuno speedwalk attivo.
") return false end local desc = run.desc or "" NebbieDash.swRunClearTimers() run.status = "idle" run.awaitingMove = false run.pauseReason = nil run.steps = {} run.nextStep = 1 run.walkIndex = nil run.generation = (run.generation or 0) + 1 NebbieDash.swRunNotify("Speedwalk interrotto" .. (desc ~= "" and (": " .. desc) or ""), "orange") return true end
function NebbieDash.swRunOnMoveOk() local run = NebbieDash._swRun if not run or run.status ~= "running" or not run.awaitingMove then return end run.awaitingMove = false if run.waitTimerId and type(killTimer) == "function" then pcall(killTimer, run.waitTimerId) end run.waitTimerId = nil run.nextStep = (tonumber(run.nextStep) or 1) + 1 if run.nextStep > #(run.steps or {}) then NebbieDash.swRunFinish(true) return end NebbieDash.swRunScheduleNext(NebbieDash.speedwalkDelay or 0.35) end
function NebbieDash.swRunOnFail(reason) local run = NebbieDash._swRun if not run or run.status ~= "running" then return end NebbieDash.swRunPause(reason or "blocco") end
function NebbieDash.onSpeedwalkGameLine() local line = (type(line) == "string" and line) or (matches and matches[1]) or "" if NebbieDash.isSpeedwalkFailLine(line) then local _, reason = NebbieDash.isSpeedwalkFailLine(line) NebbieDash.swRunOnFail(reason) return end if NebbieDash.isSpeedwalkMoveOkLine(line) then NebbieDash.swRunOnMoveOk() end end
-- Avvia (o riavvia) uno speedwalk dal pannello / click. function NebbieDash.runSpeedwalk(index) local entry = NebbieDash.speedwalks[index] if not entry then return end local steps = entry.steps or {} if #steps == 0 then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Speedwalk senza passi.
") return end local run = NebbieDash._swRun if run.status == "running" or run.status == "paused" then NebbieDash.swRunClearTimers() end run.status = "running" run.walkIndex = index run.desc = entry.desc or "" run.steps = {} for _, s in ipairs(steps) do table.insert(run.steps, s) end run.nextStep = 1 run.awaitingMove = false run.pauseReason = nil run.generation = (run.generation or 0) + 1 NebbieDash.swRunNotify( "Speedwalk: <white>" .. run.desc .. "<green> (" .. #run.steps .. " passi) — " .. "<yellow>nsw pause/stop/resume", "green") NebbieDash.swRunScheduleNext(0) end
function NebbieDash.cmdNsw(argStr) argStr = (argStr or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" local mode, rest = argStr:match("^(%S+)%s*(.-)$") mode = (mode or ""):lower() rest = (rest or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if mode == "" or mode == "status" or mode == "?" or mode == "help" then local run = NebbieDash._swRun or {} cecho("<green>[NebbieDash] Speedwalk: <white>" .. NebbieDash.swRunStatusLine() .. "
") cecho("<grey> <yellow>nsw pause<grey> | <yellow>nsw resume<grey> | <yellow>nsw skip<grey> | <yellow>nsw stop
") cecho("<grey> <yellow>nswui<grey> apre il pannello floating (path in profiles/ndashboard).
") if mode == "help" or mode == "?" then cecho("<grey>Conferma passo: riga <white>Uscite:<grey> (o buio). Fail → pausa automatica.
") end return end if mode == "pause" or mode == "pausa" then if not NebbieDash.swRunPause("manuale") then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Nessuno speedwalk in corso da mettere in pausa.
") end return end if mode == "resume" or mode == "riprendi" or mode == "continue" then local skip = rest:lower() == "skip" or rest:lower() == "salta" NebbieDash.swRunResume(skip) return end if mode == "skip" or mode == "salta" then NebbieDash.swRunResume(true) return end if mode == "stop" or mode == "abort" or mode == "cancel" then NebbieDash.swRunStop() return end cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Uso: nsw status|pause|resume|skip|stop
") end
function NebbieDash.cmdShowEq() local name = NebbieDash.currentChar if not name then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Nessun personaggio rilevato ancora. Digita un comando in gioco, poi riprova.
") return end local data = NebbieDash.getCharData(name) if not data.eqUpdated then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Nessuna cache equip per " .. name .. " — esegui <yellow>nresync<orange> o <yellow>neq<orange>.
") end NebbieDash.cmdResyncEq() end
function NebbieDash.cmdShowAttrib() local name = NebbieDash.currentChar if not name then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Nessun personaggio rilevato ancora. Digita un comando in gioco, poi riprova.
") return end NebbieDash.cmdResyncAttrib() end
function NebbieDash.cmdSetCharacter(name) if not name or name == "" then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Uso: nchar NomePersonaggio
") return end NebbieDash.setCurrentCharacter(name, true) end
-- Comando di lancio da usare quando si clicca una spell attiva nel pannello -- (vedi refreshDashboard): dipende dalla classe del personaggio corrente -- (mago/chierico -> cast, sorcerer -> recall, psionico -> mind), non e' -- deducibile dal nome della spell stesso, quindi va impostato una volta per -- personaggio. Default "c" (cast) finche' non specificato. function NebbieDash.cmdSetClass(prefix) prefix = (prefix or ""):lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") if not NebbieDash.CAST_PREFIX[prefix] then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Uso: nclass <c|r|m> (cast/recall/mind)
") return end local name = NebbieDash.currentChar if not name then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Nessun personaggio rilevato ancora.
") return end NebbieDash.getCharData(name).castPrefix = prefix NebbieDash.saveStore() NebbieDash.refreshDashboard() cecho("<green>[NebbieDash] Comando di rilancio per " .. name .. " impostato su '" .. prefix .. "' (" .. NebbieDash.CAST_PREFIX[prefix] .. ").
") end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Dashboard (miniconsole su bordo destro — MUDLET-WIKI-NOTES.md §6) -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Dashboard: bordo sinistro = solo Equip. Speedwalk → finestra floating `nswui`. NebbieDash.guiWidthEquip = 260 NebbieDash.guiWidthRight = 0 NebbieDash.fontSize = 11 -- Le descrizioni oggetto sono spesso lunghe (es. "Un tubino rinforzato con -- una grossa Union Jack (in condizioni eccellenti)") e vanno quasi sempre a -- capo in un pannello laterale stretto; le tronchiamo per un colpo d'occhio -- piu' pulito (il testo completo resta comunque visibile con `eq` normale). NebbieDash.itemMaxLen = 42 -- Soglia (in tick) sotto la quale una spell attiva viene mostrata in rosso -- invece che verde, per segnalare che sta per scadere. NOTA: riflette solo -- il valore letto all'ultimo `nattrib`/`nresync`, NON un conto alla rovescia -- in tempo reale — non conosciamo quanti secondi dura un tick sul server, e -- senza quell'informazione non possiamo stimare il tempo residuo reale. NebbieDash.spellWarnTicks = 5 -- Analogo a itemMaxLen ma per l'anteprima delle direzioni nel pannello -- speedwalk (il comando eseguito al click usa comunque la lista completa, -- solo l'anteprima a schermo viene troncata). NebbieDash.speedwalkPreviewMaxLen = 96 NebbieDash.speedwalkNoteMaxLen = 96 -- Limite caratteri per l'auto-larghezza colonna destra. NebbieDash.autoWidthRightMaxChars = 58 NebbieDash.autoWidthSidebarMaxWindowPct = 0.38 NebbieDash.autoWidthEquip = true NebbieDash.autoWidthRight = true NebbieDash.autoWidthMin = 180
function NebbieDash.truncate(s, maxLen) if not s or #s <= maxLen then return s end return s:sub(1, math.max(1, maxLen - 1)) .. "…" end
-- A capo morbido per miniconsole (Mudlet non fa wrap da solo: righe troppo -- lunghe vengono tagliate/nascoste). Preferisce virgola o spazio prima del limite. function NebbieDash.wrapPanelText(s, maxLen) maxLen = maxLen or 80 if maxLen < 8 then maxLen = 8 end local lines = {} local rest = (s or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") while rest and #rest > maxLen do local cut = maxLen local searchFrom = math.min(#rest, maxLen) local searchTo = math.max(1, searchFrom - 48) for i = searchFrom, searchTo, -1 do local c = rest:sub(i, i) if c == "," or c == " " then cut = i break end end local piece = rest:sub(1, cut):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") if piece == "" then piece = rest:sub(1, maxLen) cut = maxLen end table.insert(lines, piece) rest = rest:sub(cut + 1):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") end if rest and rest ~= "" then table.insert(lines, rest) end return lines end
-- Colonne utili per il wrap (larghezza bordo / font meno indentazione " " / " "). function NebbieDash.panelWrapCols(_side, indentCols) indentCols = indentCols or 0 local w = NebbieDash.guiWidthEquip or 260 local charW = (type(calcFontSize) == "function" and calcFontSize(NebbieDash.fontSize)) or 8 if type(charW) == "table" then charW = charW[1] or 8 end charW = charW or 8 if charW <= 0 then charW = 8 end return math.max(16, math.floor(w / charW) - indentCols - 1) end
-- Costruisce l'elenco di righe da mostrare nel pannello equip: una riga per -- ogni posizione nota in EQ_SLOT_ORDER (piu' EQ_SLOT_CLAN se showClanSlot), -- marcata come vuota se nessun oggetto catturato da `eq` ha una posizione -- corrispondente. Il confronto e' sul TESTO della posizione, case-insensitive -- (mai sul numero di slot del gioco — vedi nota su EQ_SLOT_ORDER). Se due -- posizioni condividono la stessa etichetta (es. le due collane), gli -- oggetti catturati vengono assegnati in ordine di apparizione: non c'e' modo -- di sapere quale dei due slot "identici" corrisponda a quale, ma nessun -- oggetto viene perso o duplicato. function NebbieDash.buildEquipRows(data) local pool = {} for _, entry in pairs(data.eq or {}) do local key = ((entry and entry.location) or "?"):lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") pool[key] = pool[key] or {} table.insert(pool[key], entry) end local positions = {} for _, label in ipairs(NebbieDash.EQ_SLOT_ORDER) do table.insert(positions, label) end if NebbieDash.showClanSlot then table.insert(positions, NebbieDash.EQ_SLOT_CLAN) end
local rows = {} for _, label in ipairs(positions) do local bucket = pool[label:lower()] local matched = bucket and table.remove(bucket, 1) table.insert(rows, { location = label, item = matched and matched.item or nil, empty = not matched }) end -- Posizioni riportate dal gioco ma non presenti nell'elenco canonico sopra -- (mai osservate finora): mostrate comunque, per non nascondere dati reali. for _, bucket in pairs(pool) do for _, entry in ipairs(bucket) do table.insert(rows, { location = entry.location, item = entry.item, empty = false, unknown = true }) end end return rows end
function NebbieDash.guiVisible() return NebbieDash._guiCreated == true and NebbieDash._guiHidden ~= true end
-- Legacy (pre-1.15.96 ripartizione Equip/Speedwalk): tenuti per nheights no-op / migrazione. NebbieDash.guiRatios = { equip = 1.0, manualEquip = false } NebbieDash.dividerPx = 4 NebbieDash.GUI_WINDOWS = { "NebbieDashEquip" } NebbieDash.ALL_GUI_ELEMENTS = { "NebbieDashEquip", -- Rimuovere residui di versioni precedenti: "NebbieDashSpeedwalks", "NebbieDashDivider", }
function NebbieDash.estimateEquipContentLines(data) local lines = 1 if not data or not data.eqUpdated then return lines + 1 end for _, row in ipairs(NebbieDash.buildEquipRows(data)) do if row.empty then lines = lines + 1 else lines = lines + 2 end end return lines end
function NebbieDash.estimateSpeedwalkContentLines() local lines = 1 if #(NebbieDash.speedwalkItems or {}) == 0 and #(NebbieDash.speedwalks or {}) == 0 then return lines + 1 end local descCols = NebbieDash.panelWrapCols("left", 0) local lineCols = NebbieDash.panelWrapCols("left", 2) local noteCols = NebbieDash.panelWrapCols("left", 4) for _, item in ipairs(NebbieDash.speedwalkItems or {}) do if item.kind == "section" then lines = lines + 1 elseif item.kind == "walk" then if item.sectionKey and NebbieDash.isSpeedwalkSectionCollapsed(item.sectionKey) then -- nascosto else lines = lines + #NebbieDash.wrapPanelText(item.desc or "", descCols) lines = lines + #NebbieDash.wrapPanelText(item.dirString or "", lineCols) if item.note and item.note ~= "" then lines = lines + #NebbieDash.wrapPanelText(item.note, noteCols) end end end end if lines <= 1 and #(NebbieDash.speedwalks or {}) > 0 then for _, entry in ipairs(NebbieDash.speedwalks) do lines = lines + 1 + (entry.dirString and 1 or 0) end end return math.max(lines, 2) end
function NebbieDash.computeSidebarEquipRatio(data) if NebbieDash.guiRatios and NebbieDash.guiRatios.manualEquip and NebbieDash.guiRatios.equip then return math.max(0.1, math.min(0.9, NebbieDash.guiRatios.equip)) end local eqLines = NebbieDash.estimateEquipContentLines(data) local swLines = NebbieDash.estimateSpeedwalkContentLines() local total = math.max(1, eqLines + swLines) return math.max(0.12, math.min(0.88, eqLines / total)) end
function NebbieDash.canUseFloatingSidebar() return type(Adjustable) == "table" and type(Adjustable.Container) == "table" and type(Geyser) == "table" and type(Geyser.MiniConsole) == "table" end
-- Package community (Edru): doppio-click su Adjustable.Container → UserWindow. -- ATTENZIONE: mudlet.github.io serve uno STUB senza ScriptPackage (install -- "ok" in Package Manager ma convertAdj assente) → NON usarlo. -- Vendiamo una copia buona in deps/ sul nostro repo; fallback = raw GitHub Mudlet. NebbieDash.CONVERT_TO_USERWINDOW_PKG = "convertToUserWindow" NebbieDash.CONVERT_TO_USERWINDOW_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/" .. PKG_REPO .. "/main/deps/convertToUserWindow.mpackage" NebbieDash.CONVERT_TO_USERWINDOW_URL_FALLBACK = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Mudlet/mudlet-package-repository/main/packages/convertToUserWindow.mpackage" NebbieDash.CTUW_MAX_ATTEMPTS = 2
function NebbieDash.convertToUserWindowListed() if type(getPackageInfo) ~= "function" then return false end local v = getPackageInfo(NebbieDash.CONVERT_TO_USERWINDOW_PKG, "version") return v ~= nil and tostring(v) ~= "" end
function NebbieDash.hasConvertToUserWindowPackage() -- Runtime reale: convertAdj.Init (script del package Edru). if type(convertAdj) == "table" and type(convertAdj.Init) == "function" then return true end return false end
function NebbieDash.echoConvertToUserWindowManualInstall() cecho("<grey>Installazione manuale:
") cecho(" <yellow>mpkg install convertToUserWindow
") cecho("<grey>oppure:
") cecho("<white>lua installPackage("" .. NebbieDash.CONVERT_TO_USERWINDOW_URL_FALLBACK .. "")
") cecho("<grey>Poi: doppio-click sulla barra titolo della finestra floating.
") cecho("<grey>Preferenza: <white>auto_install_convert_to_userwindow = off" .. "<grey> in nebbie-dash-preferences.txt per non installare da soli.
") end
function NebbieDash.ctuwMarkGaveUp(reason) NebbieDash._ctuwGaveUp = true NebbieDash._ctuwInstallPending = nil NebbieDash._ctuwDownloadSaveTo = nil cecho("<red>[NebbieDash] convertToUserWindow: interrompo auto-install" .. (reason and (" (" .. tostring(reason) .. ")") or "") .. ".
") NebbieDash.echoConvertToUserWindowManualInstall() cecho("<grey>─────────────────────────────────────
") end
function NebbieDash.onConvertToUserWindowInstalled(event, packageName) if packageName and packageName ~= NebbieDash.CONVERT_TO_USERWINDOW_PKG then return end NebbieDash._ctuwInstallPending = nil if type(tempTimer) == "function" then -- NON chiamare convertAdj.Init qui: il package lo fa gia' su sysInstall/ -- sysLoadEvent, e Init ri-wrappa Adjustable.Container.new a ogni chiamata -- (rompe nidentui/nswui dopo qualche reload). tempTimer(1.0, function() if NebbieDash.hasConvertToUserWindowPackage() then NebbieDash._ctuwGaveUp = nil NebbieDash._ctuwInstallAttempt = 0 cecho("<green>[NebbieDash] convertToUserWindow pronto su questo profilo. " .. "Doppio-click sulla barra titolo per staccare le finestre.
") return end local attempt = NebbieDash._ctuwInstallAttempt or 1 if NebbieDash._ctuwGaveUp or attempt >= (NebbieDash.CTUW_MAX_ATTEMPTS or 2) then NebbieDash.ctuwMarkGaveUp("package installato ma convertAdj assente") return end cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] convertToUserWindow in Package Manager ma " .. "senza convertAdj (package stub?) — un retry con URL alternativo...
") NebbieDash.installConvertToUserWindow({ force = true, url = NebbieDash.CONVERT_TO_USERWINDOW_URL_FALLBACK, }) end) else if NebbieDash.hasConvertToUserWindowPackage() then cecho("<green>[NebbieDash] convertToUserWindow installato su questo profilo.
") else NebbieDash.ctuwMarkGaveUp("convertAdj assente dopo install") end end end
function NebbieDash.ensureConvertToUserWindowHandlers() if NebbieDash._ctuwInstallHandlerReady then return end if type(registerAnonymousEventHandler) ~= "function" then return end registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysInstallPackage", "NebbieDash.onConvertToUserWindowInstalled") NebbieDash._ctuwInstallHandlerReady = true end
function NebbieDash.ctuwDownloadPath() local home = (type(getMudletHomeDir) == "function" and getMudletHomeDir()) or "/tmp" local n = NebbieDash._ctuwInstallAttempt or 1 return tostring(home):gsub("/+$", "") .. "/nebbie-dash-convertToUserWindow-" .. tostring(n) .. ".mpackage" end
function NebbieDash.onCtuwDownloadDone(_, saveTo) if not NebbieDash._ctuwInstallPending then return end if saveTo ~= NebbieDash._ctuwDownloadSaveTo then return end NebbieDash._ctuwDownloadSaveTo = nil if type(installPackage) ~= "function" then NebbieDash.ctuwMarkGaveUp("installPackage non disponibile") return end cecho("<grey>[NebbieDash] Installo convertToUserWindow dal file scaricato...
") local ok, err = pcall(installPackage, saveTo) if not ok then NebbieDash.ctuwMarkGaveUp("installPackage: " .. tostring(err)) end end
function NebbieDash.onCtuwDownloadError(_, msg, saveTo) if not NebbieDash._ctuwInstallPending then return end if saveTo and NebbieDash._ctuwDownloadSaveTo and saveTo ~= NebbieDash._ctuwDownloadSaveTo then return end NebbieDash._ctuwDownloadSaveTo = nil local attempt = NebbieDash._ctuwInstallAttempt or 1 if attempt < (NebbieDash.CTUW_MAX_ATTEMPTS or 2) then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Download CTUW fallito (" .. tostring(msg) .. ") — riprovo con URL alternativo...
") NebbieDash._ctuwInstallPending = nil NebbieDash.installConvertToUserWindow({ force = true, url = NebbieDash.CONVERT_TO_USERWINDOW_URL_FALLBACK, }) return end NebbieDash.ctuwMarkGaveUp("download: " .. tostring(msg)) end
function NebbieDash.ensureCtuwDownloadHandlers() if NebbieDash._ctuwDownloadHandlersReady then return end if type(registerAnonymousEventHandler) ~= "function" then return end registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDownloadDone", "NebbieDash.onCtuwDownloadDone") registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDownloadError", "NebbieDash.onCtuwDownloadError") NebbieDash._ctuwDownloadHandlersReady = true end
function NebbieDash.armCtuwInstallWatchdog() if type(tempTimer) ~= "function" then return end local attempt = NebbieDash._ctuwInstallAttempt or 1 tempTimer(20, function() if NebbieDash._ctuwGaveUp then return end if not NebbieDash._ctuwInstallPending then return end if NebbieDash.hasConvertToUserWindowPackage() then NebbieDash._ctuwInstallPending = nil return end NebbieDash._ctuwInstallPending = nil NebbieDash._ctuwDownloadSaveTo = nil if attempt < (NebbieDash.CTUW_MAX_ATTEMPTS or 2) then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] convertToUserWindow non pronto dopo 20s — " .. "un retry...
") NebbieDash.installConvertToUserWindow({ force = true, url = NebbieDash.CONVERT_TO_USERWINDOW_URL_FALLBACK, }) else NebbieDash.ctuwMarkGaveUp("timeout dopo " .. tostring(attempt) .. " tentativi") end end) end
-- force=true: uninstall (se listed) poi reinstall. Mai oltre CTUW_MAX_ATTEMPTS. function NebbieDash.installConvertToUserWindow(opts) opts = opts or {} local force = opts.force and true or false local url = opts.url or NebbieDash.CONVERT_TO_USERWINDOW_URL if NebbieDash.hasConvertToUserWindowPackage() and not force then return true end if NebbieDash._ctuwGaveUp and not opts.resetGaveUp then return false end if NebbieDash._ctuwInstallPending and not force then return false end local nextAttempt = (NebbieDash._ctuwInstallAttempt or 0) + 1 if nextAttempt > (NebbieDash.CTUW_MAX_ATTEMPTS or 2) then NebbieDash.ctuwMarkGaveUp("max " .. tostring(NebbieDash.CTUW_MAX_ATTEMPTS) .. " tentativi") return false end if type(installPackage) ~= "function" then NebbieDash.ctuwMarkGaveUp("installPackage non disponibile") return false end
NebbieDash.ensureConvertToUserWindowHandlers() NebbieDash.ensureCtuwDownloadHandlers() NebbieDash._ctuwInstallPending = true NebbieDash._ctuwInstallAttempt = nextAttempt NebbieDash._ctuwInstallStartedAt = os.time()
local function startDownloadOrUrlInstall() if NebbieDash._ctuwGaveUp then return end NebbieDash.armCtuwInstallWatchdog() if type(downloadFile) == "function" and type(getMudletHomeDir) == "function" then local saveTo = NebbieDash.ctuwDownloadPath() NebbieDash._ctuwDownloadSaveTo = saveTo -- Evita "Couldn't save to the destination file" su file ancora aperto. pcall(function() os.remove(saveTo) end) cecho("<grey>[NebbieDash] Scarico <white>convertToUserWindow<grey> " .. "(tentativo " .. tostring(NebbieDash._ctuwInstallAttempt) .. ")...
") local ok, err = pcall(downloadFile, saveTo, url) if not ok then NebbieDash._ctuwDownloadSaveTo = nil cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] downloadFile fallita (" .. tostring(err) .. ") — provo installPackage(URL)...
") local ok2, err2 = pcall(installPackage, url) if not ok2 then NebbieDash.ctuwMarkGaveUp("installPackage(URL): " .. tostring(err2)) end end return end cecho("<grey>[NebbieDash] installPackage(URL) convertToUserWindow...
") local ok, err = pcall(installPackage, url) if not ok then NebbieDash.ctuwMarkGaveUp("installPackage: " .. tostring(err)) end end
local listed = NebbieDash.convertToUserWindowListed() local broken = listed and not NebbieDash.hasConvertToUserWindowPackage() if listed and type(uninstallPackage) == "function" then cecho("<yellow>[NebbieDash] Disinstallo convertToUserWindow " .. (broken and "(senza convertAdj) " or "") .. "e reinstallo...
") pcall(uninstallPackage, NebbieDash.CONVERT_TO_USERWINDOW_PKG) if type(tempTimer) == "function" then tempTimer(0.9, startDownloadOrUrlInstall) else startDownloadOrUrlInstall() end else cecho("
<yellow>[NebbieDash] Installo <white>convertToUserWindow<yellow> " .. "su questo profilo (Mudlet: i package non sono condivisi tra profili)...
") startDownloadOrUrlInstall() end return true end
-- All'apertura profilo: se manca convertToUserWindow, installalo (default) o avvisa. -- Il debounce 90s vale SOLO per i messaggi (Adjustable / auto-off), NON per -- l'install CTUW: saltare l'install in silenzio era il bug visto in 1.15.97. function NebbieDash.warnMissingWindowMoveDeps(force) local missingAdj = not (type(Adjustable) == "table" and type(Adjustable.Container) == "table") local missingCtuw = not NebbieDash.hasConvertToUserWindowPackage() if not missingAdj and not missingCtuw then return false end
local announceMsg = force and true or false if not announceMsg then local t = os.time() if not (NebbieDash._windowMoveWarnAt and (t - NebbieDash._windowMoveWarnAt) < 90) then announceMsg = true NebbieDash._windowMoveWarnAt = t end else NebbieDash._windowMoveWarnAt = os.time() end
if missingAdj and announceMsg then cecho("
<orange>[NebbieDash] Manca <white>Adjustable.Container<orange> (Geyser). " .. "Aggiorna Mudlet (4.14+ consigliata).
") end
if not missingCtuw then return missingAdj end
local auto = not (NebbieDash.prefs and NebbieDash.prefs.auto_install_convert_to_userwindow == false) if not auto then if announceMsg then cecho("
<orange>[NebbieDash] Manca <white>convertToUserWindow<orange> " .. "(finestre staccabili). Auto-install disattivato.
") NebbieDash.echoConvertToUserWindowManualInstall() cecho("<grey>─────────────────────────────────────
") end return true end
if NebbieDash._ctuwGaveUp and not force then return true end if force then NebbieDash._ctuwGaveUp = nil NebbieDash._ctuwInstallAttempt = 0 end
local brokenListed = NebbieDash.convertToUserWindowListed() and missingCtuw NebbieDash._ctuwInstallStartedAt = os.time() NebbieDash.installConvertToUserWindow({ force = force or brokenListed or false, resetGaveUp = force and true or false, }) return true end
-- Chiamata su ogni boot (anche silenzioso): se manca CTUW, ritenta (max attempts). function NebbieDash.maybeEnsureConvertToUserWindow() if NebbieDash.hasConvertToUserWindowPackage() then return end if NebbieDash._ctuwGaveUp then return end local auto = not (NebbieDash.prefs and NebbieDash.prefs.auto_install_convert_to_userwindow == false) if not auto then return end if NebbieDash._ctuwInstallPending then local started = NebbieDash._ctuwInstallStartedAt or 0 if os.time() - started < 25 then return end NebbieDash._ctuwInstallPending = nil NebbieDash._ctuwDownloadSaveTo = nil end if (NebbieDash._ctuwInstallAttempt or 0) >= (NebbieDash.CTUW_MAX_ATTEMPTS or 2) then NebbieDash.ctuwMarkGaveUp("max tentativi gia' raggiunti") return end NebbieDash._ctuwInstallStartedAt = os.time() NebbieDash.installConvertToUserWindow({ force = NebbieDash.convertToUserWindowListed() and true or false, }) end
function NebbieDash.effectiveSidebarMode() -- Dock (bordo sinistro Mudlet): unico layout supportato in produzione — il float -- Geyser non riceveva cecho() globale e lasciava pannelli neri vuoti. return "dock" end
function NebbieDash.panelGeyser(win) if win == "NebbieDashEquip" then return NebbieDash._equipGeyser end if win == "NebbieDashSpeedwalks" then return NebbieDash._swGeyser end return nil end
function NebbieDash.panelCecho(win, text) local g = NebbieDash.panelGeyser(win) if g and type(g.cecho) == "function" then g:cecho(text) else cecho(win, text) end end
function NebbieDash.panelCechoLink(win, text, command, hint, paste) local g = NebbieDash.panelGeyser(win) if g and type(g.cechoLink) == "function" then g:cechoLink(text, command, hint, paste) else cechoLink(win, text, command, hint, paste) end end
function NebbieDash.destroyFloatSidebarArtifacts() local wasFloat = NebbieDash._floatSidebarCreated or NebbieDash._sidebarContainer ~= nil if NebbieDash._sidebarContainer then if type(NebbieDash._sidebarContainer.delete) == "function" then pcall(function() NebbieDash._sidebarContainer:delete() end) elseif type(NebbieDash._sidebarContainer.hide) == "function" then pcall(function() NebbieDash._sidebarContainer:hide() end) end end -- Non cancellare NebbieDashEquip del dock sinistro: solo artefatti float. local names = { "NebbieDashSidebarContainer", "NebbieDashSpeedwalks", "NebbieDashDivider" } if wasFloat then table.insert(names, "NebbieDashEquip") end for _, name in ipairs(names) do if type(deleteWindow) == "function" then pcall(deleteWindow, name) end end NebbieDash._sidebarContainer = nil NebbieDash._equipGeyser = nil NebbieDash._swGeyser = nil NebbieDash._dividerLabel = nil NebbieDash._floatSidebarCreated = false end
function NebbieDash.equipLocationCechoTag(location) local loc = (location or ""):lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") if loc == "impugnato" or loc == "tenuto" then return "yellow" end if loc == "sulla schiena" then return "cyan" end if loc == "davanti agli occhi" then return "magenta" end return "green" end
-- Miniconsole Mudlet/Geyser: solo tag cecho, non HTML (le <table> compaiono come testo grezzo). function NebbieDash.renderEquipPanel(name, data) NebbieDash.panelCecho("NebbieDashEquip", "<cyan><b>Equip — " .. name .. "</b>
") if not (data and data.eqUpdated) then NebbieDash.panelCecho("NebbieDashEquip", "<grey>(mai sincronizzato — esegui <yellow>neq<grey> o <yellow>nresync<grey>)
") return end for idx, row in ipairs(NebbieDash.buildEquipRows(data)) do if row.empty then NebbieDash.panelCecho("NebbieDashEquip", string.format( "<grey>[%2d] <yellow>%s
 <red><b>▢ VUOTO ▢</b>
", idx, row.location)) else local item = NebbieDash.truncate(row.item or "?", NebbieDash.itemMaxLen) local tag = NebbieDash.equipLocationCechoTag(row.location) NebbieDash.panelCecho("NebbieDashEquip", string.format( "<grey>[%2d] <%s>%s
 <white>%s
", idx, tag, row.location, item)) end end end
function NebbieDash.clearPanel(win) local g = NebbieDash.panelGeyser(win) if g and type(g.clear) == "function" then g:clear() return end if type(clearWindow) == "function" then pcall(clearWindow, win) end end
function NebbieDash.applySidebarBorder() if not NebbieDash._guiCreated then return end if NebbieDash._guiHidden then setBorderLeft(0) return end setBorderLeft(NebbieDash.guiWidthEquip or 260) end
function NebbieDash.maybeSanityResyncEq(charName) if not charName or charName == "" then return end if not (NebbieDash.prefs and NebbieDash.prefs.sanity_neq_on_login) then return end NebbieDash._sanityNeqForChar = NebbieDash._sanityNeqForChar or {} if NebbieDash._sanityNeqForChar[charName] then return end local data = NebbieDash.getCharData(charName) if not data.eqUpdated then return end if NebbieDash.countSlots(data.eq) > 0 then return end NebbieDash._sanityNeqForChar[charName] = true cecho("<yellow>[NebbieDash] Equip in cache vuoto per <white>" .. charName .. "<yellow> — invio automatico <white>eq<yellow> (sanity_neq_on_login).
") send("eq") NebbieDash.startEqCapture() end
function NebbieDash.teardownGui() for _, w in ipairs(NebbieDash.ALL_GUI_ELEMENTS or {}) do if type(deleteWindow) == "function" then pcall(deleteWindow, w) end end if NebbieDash._sidebarContainer then if type(NebbieDash._sidebarContainer.delete) == "function" then pcall(function() NebbieDash._sidebarContainer:delete() end) elseif type(NebbieDash._sidebarContainer.hide) == "function" then pcall(function() NebbieDash._sidebarContainer:hide() end) end end NebbieDash._sidebarContainer = nil NebbieDash._equipGeyser = nil NebbieDash._swGeyser = nil NebbieDash._dividerLabel = nil NebbieDash._guiCreated = false NebbieDash._floatSidebarCreated = false NebbieDash._equipRatioDragReady = false NebbieDash._equipRatioDrag = nil NebbieDash.destroyChatWindow() NebbieDash.destroyIdentUiWindow() pcall(setBorderLeft, 0) pcall(setBorderRight, 0) end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Finestra floating chat: raccoglie say / gtell / clantell / tell / whisper / -- ask / gossip / shout. Formati reali da act.comm.cpp (gtell/say/…) e canale -- clan/casata (parallelo a gtell; non c'e' comando "clantell" in myst). -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- NebbieDash.chatEnabled = true NebbieDash._chatTrigs = NebbieDash._chatTrigs or {} NebbieDash.CHAT_CHANNEL_COLORS = { say = "white", gossip = "yellow", gtell = "cyan", clantell = "orange", tell = "magenta", send = "violet", telep = "LightSkyBlue", think = "LightSteelBlue", sign = "LightCyan", whisper = "green", ask = "blue", shout = "red", }
function NebbieDash.canUseChatWindow() return type(Adjustable) == "table" and type(Adjustable.Container) == "table" and type(Geyser) == "table" and type(Geyser.MiniConsole) == "table" end
function NebbieDash.destroyChatWindow() if NebbieDash._chatContainer then if type(NebbieDash._chatContainer.hide) == "function" then pcall(function() NebbieDash._chatContainer:hide() end) end if type(NebbieDash._chatContainer.delete) == "function" then pcall(function() NebbieDash._chatContainer:delete() end) end end for _, name in ipairs({ "NebbieDashChatContainer", "NebbieDashChat" }) do if type(deleteWindow) == "function" then pcall(deleteWindow, name) end end NebbieDash._chatContainer = nil NebbieDash._chatGeyser = nil NebbieDash._chatCreated = false NebbieDash._chatHidden = false end
function NebbieDash.chatConsoleCecho(text) local g = NebbieDash._chatGeyser if g and type(g.cecho) == "function" then g:cecho(text) elseif type(cecho) == "function" then cecho("NebbieDashChat", text) end end
function NebbieDash.clearChatWindow() if NebbieDash._chatGeyser and type(NebbieDash._chatGeyser.clear) == "function" then pcall(function() NebbieDash._chatGeyser:clear() end) elseif type(clearWindow) == "function" then pcall(clearWindow, "NebbieDashChat") end end
function NebbieDash.showChatWindow() if NebbieDash._chatContainer and type(NebbieDash._chatContainer.show) == "function" then pcall(function() NebbieDash._chatContainer:show() end) elseif type(showWindow) == "function" then pcall(showWindow, "NebbieDashChatContainer") pcall(showWindow, "NebbieDashChat") end NebbieDash._chatHidden = false end
function NebbieDash.hideChatWindow() if NebbieDash._chatContainer and type(NebbieDash._chatContainer.hide) == "function" then pcall(function() NebbieDash._chatContainer:hide() end) elseif type(hideWindow) == "function" then pcall(hideWindow, "NebbieDashChatContainer") pcall(hideWindow, "NebbieDashChat") end NebbieDash._chatHidden = true end
function NebbieDash.initChatWindow() if NebbieDash.chatEnabled == false then return end if not NebbieDash.canUseChatWindow() then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Finestra chat non disponibile (serve Adjustable.Container / Geyser).
") return end if NebbieDash._chatCreated and NebbieDash._chatContainer then NebbieDash.showChatWindow() return end NebbieDash.destroyChatWindow() local w, h = 440, 300 NebbieDash._chatContainer = Adjustable.Container:new({ name = "NebbieDashChatContainer", x = "-460", y = 40, width = w, height = h, titleText = "Nebbie — Chat", titleTxtColor = "white", adjLabelstyle = [[ background-color: rgb(12, 12, 18); border: 2px solid rgb(70, 110, 70); border-radius: 6px; ]], }) local pad = 4 local titleH = 22 NebbieDash._chatGeyser = Geyser.MiniConsole:new({ name = "NebbieDashChat", x = pad, y = titleH, width = "100%-" .. tostring(pad * 2), height = "100%-" .. tostring(titleH + pad), }, NebbieDash._chatContainer) NebbieDash._chatGeyser:setColor(12, 12, 16, 255) if type(setMiniConsoleFontSize) == "function" then setMiniConsoleFontSize("NebbieDashChat", NebbieDash.fontSize or 10) end if type(enableScrollBar) == "function" then enableScrollBar("NebbieDashChat", true) end if type(setMaxLines) == "function" then setMaxLines("NebbieDashChat", 2000) end if type(NebbieDash._chatContainer.load) == "function" then pcall(function() NebbieDash._chatContainer:load() end) end NebbieDash._chatCreated = true NebbieDash._chatHidden = false NebbieDash.chatConsoleCecho( "<grey>Canali: say · gt · clan · tell · whisper · ask · gossip · shout
" .. "Comandi: <yellow>nchat<grey> (toggle) · <yellow>nchat clear<grey> · <yellow>nchat off
") end
-- Parser canali chat (testo già senza colori Mudlet). Ordine: casi più specifici prima. function NebbieDash.parseChatLine(text) text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if text == "" then return nil end
local msg = text:match("^Tu dici al gruppo '(.+)'%s*$") if msg then return { channel = "gtell", speaker = "Tu", message = msg, self = true } end -- Clantell / casata (parallelo a gtell; formati tipici IT se il canale e' attivo). msg = text:match("^Tu dici al clan '(.+)'%s*$") if msg then return { channel = "clantell", speaker = "Tu", message = msg, self = true } end msg = text:match("^Tu dici alla casata '(.+)'%s*$") if msg then return { channel = "clantell", speaker = "Tu", message = msg, self = true } end
local target target, msg = text:match("^Tu dici a (.+) %(che e' AFK%) '(.+)'%s*$") if target and msg then return { channel = "tell", speaker = "Tu", target = target, message = msg, self = true, afk = true } end target, msg = text:match("^Tu dici a (.+) '(.+)'%s*$") if target and msg then return { channel = "tell", speaker = "Tu", target = target, message = msg, self = true } end
-- Skill sending / messenger (skills.cpp do_sending): echo senza "Tu ". target, msg = text:match("^Mandi a (.+) %(che e' AFK%) il messaggio '(.+)'%s*$") if target and msg then return { channel = "send", speaker = "Tu", target = target, message = msg, self = true, afk = true } end target, msg = text:match("^Mandi a (.+) il messaggio '(.+)'%s*$") if target and msg then return { channel = "send", speaker = "Tu", target = target, message = msg, self = true } end
-- telepathy (act.comm.cpp telepathy_deliver): "Tu mandi a … il pensiero". target, msg = text:match("^Tu mandi a (.+) il pensiero '(.+)'%s*$") if target and msg then return { channel = "telep", speaker = "Tu", target = target, message = msg, self = true } end
-- Immortal think / " (do_commune): "Tu pensi :: '…'" oppure "Tu pensi || '…'". msg = text:match("^Tu pensi :: '(.+)'%s*$") if msg then return { channel = "think", speaker = "Tu", message = msg, self = true } end msg = text:match("^Tu pensi || '(.+)'%s*$") if msg then return { channel = "think", speaker = "Tu", message = msg, self = true, superni = true } end
target, msg = text:match("^Tu sussurri a (.+), '(.+)'%s*$") if target and msg then return { channel = "whisper", speaker = "Tu", target = target, message = msg, self = true } end
target, msg = text:match("^Tu chiedi a (.+), '(.+)'%s*$") if target and msg then return { channel = "ask", speaker = "Tu", target = target, message = msg, self = true } end
msg = text:match("^Tu gridi '(.+)'%s*$") if msg then return { channel = "shout", speaker = "Tu", message = msg, self = true } end
-- Skill sign (act.comm.cpp do_sign): echo parlante distinto da say. msg = text:match("^Tu hai detto '(.+)'%s*$") if msg then return { channel = "sign", speaker = "Tu", message = msg, self = true } end
-- Gossip e say: stesso echo parlante "Tu dici '…'" (gossip giallo in gioco). msg = text:match("^Tu dici '(.+)'%s*$") if msg then return { channel = "say", speaker = "Tu", message = msg, self = true, ambiguousGossip = true } end
local who who, msg = text:match("^%[(.-)%] dice al gruppo '(.+)'%s*$") if who and msg then return { channel = "gtell", speaker = who, message = msg } end who, msg = text:match("^%[(.-)%] dice al clan '(.+)'%s*$") if who and msg then return { channel = "clantell", speaker = who, message = msg } end who, msg = text:match("^%[(.-)%] dice alla casata '(.+)'%s*$") if who and msg then return { channel = "clantell", speaker = who, message = msg } end who, msg = text:match("^%[(.-)%] vi dice '(.+)'%s*$") if who and msg then return { channel = "gossip", speaker = who, message = msg } end who, msg = text:match("^%[(.-)%] ti dice '(.+)'%s*$") if who and msg then return { channel = "tell", speaker = who, message = msg } end who, msg = text:match("^%[(.-)%] ti manda il messaggio '(.+)'%s*$") if who and msg then return { channel = "send", speaker = who, message = msg } end who, msg = text:match("^%[(.-)%] ti manda il pensiero '(.+)'%s*$") if who and msg then return { channel = "telep", speaker = who, message = msg } end -- Immortal think ricevuto: "::Nome:: '…'" / "||Nome|| '…'" (do_commune). who, msg = text:match("^::(.+):: '(.+)'%s*$") if who and msg then return { channel = "think", speaker = who, message = msg } end who, msg = text:match("^||(.+)|| '(.+)'%s*$") if who and msg then return { channel = "think", speaker = who, message = msg, superni = true } end who, msg = text:match("^%[(.-)%] ti sussurra '(.+)'%s*$") if who and msg then return { channel = "whisper", speaker = who, message = msg } end who, msg = text:match("^%[(.-)%] ti chiede '(.+)'%s*$") if who and msg then return { channel = "ask", speaker = who, message = msg } end who, msg = text:match("^%[(.-)%] grida '(.+)'%s*$") if who and msg then return { channel = "shout", speaker = who, message = msg } end -- Sign language room broadcast (solo se il ricevente capisce i segni). who, msg = text:match("^%[(.-)%], con i segni, dice '(.+)'%s*$") if who and msg then return { channel = "sign", speaker = who, message = msg } end who, msg = text:match("^%[(.-)%] dice '(.+)'%s*$") if who and msg then return { channel = "say", speaker = who, message = msg } end return nil end
function NebbieDash.formatChatEcho(parsed) if not parsed then return nil end local color = NebbieDash.CHAT_CHANNEL_COLORS[parsed.channel] or "white" local who = parsed.speaker or "?" if parsed.self and parsed.target and parsed.target ~= "" then who = "Tu → " .. parsed.target end local chan = parsed.channel or "?" if parsed.ambiguousGossip then chan = "say" end return string.format("<%s>[%s]<white> %s: %s
", color, chan, who, parsed.message or "") end
function NebbieDash.appendChatParsed(parsed) if not parsed or NebbieDash.chatEnabled == false then return end if not NebbieDash._chatCreated then NebbieDash.initChatWindow() end if NebbieDash._chatHidden then return end local echo = NebbieDash.formatChatEcho(parsed) if echo then NebbieDash.chatConsoleCecho(echo) end end
function NebbieDash.onChatCaptureLine() if NebbieDash.chatEnabled == false then return end local text = line or (type(getCurrentLine) == "function" and getCurrentLine()) or "" local parsed = NebbieDash.parseChatLine(text) if parsed then NebbieDash.appendChatParsed(parsed) end end
function NebbieDash.teardownChatTriggers() for _, id in ipairs(NebbieDash._chatTrigs or {}) do if id then pcall(function() killTrigger(id) end) end end NebbieDash._chatTrigs = {} end
function NebbieDash.installChatTriggers() NebbieDash.teardownChatTriggers() if NebbieDash.chatEnabled == false then return end if type(tempTrigger) ~= "function" then return end local patterns = { "Tu dici al gruppo '", "Tu dici al clan '", "Tu dici alla casata '", "Tu dici a ", "Mandi a ", "Tu mandi a ", "Tu sussurri a ", "Tu chiedi a ", "Tu gridi '", "Tu hai detto '", "Tu dici '", "] dice al gruppo '", "] dice al clan '", "] dice alla casata '", "] vi dice '", "] ti dice '", "] ti manda il messaggio '", "] ti manda il pensiero '", "] ti sussurra '", "] ti chiede '", "] grida '", "], con i segni, dice '", "] dice '", -- think immortali/superni (un solo trigger a canale: copre self e ricevuto) ":: '", "|| '", } for _, pat in ipairs(patterns) do local id = tempTrigger(pat, [[NebbieDash.onChatCaptureLine()]]) table.insert(NebbieDash._chatTrigs, id) end end
function NebbieDash.cmdChat(argStr) argStr = (argStr or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" local mode = argStr:lower() if mode == "" or mode == "toggle" then if not NebbieDash._chatCreated then NebbieDash.chatEnabled = true NebbieDash.prefs = NebbieDash.prefs or {} NebbieDash.prefs.chat_window = true NebbieDash.savePreferencesFile() NebbieDash.initChatWindow() NebbieDash.installChatTriggers() cecho("<green>[NebbieDash] Finestra chat aperta (<yellow>nchat clear<green> / <yellow>nchat off<green>).
") return end if NebbieDash._chatHidden then NebbieDash.showChatWindow() cecho("<green>[NebbieDash] Finestra chat mostrata.
") else NebbieDash.hideChatWindow() cecho("<grey>[NebbieDash] Finestra chat nascosta (<yellow>nchat<grey> per riaprire).
") end return end if mode == "on" or mode == "show" then NebbieDash.chatEnabled = true NebbieDash.prefs = NebbieDash.prefs or {} NebbieDash.prefs.chat_window = true NebbieDash.savePreferencesFile() NebbieDash.initChatWindow() NebbieDash.installChatTriggers() NebbieDash.showChatWindow() cecho("<green>[NebbieDash] Chat window on.
") return end if mode == "off" or mode == "hide" then NebbieDash.hideChatWindow() if mode == "off" then NebbieDash.chatEnabled = false NebbieDash.prefs = NebbieDash.prefs or {} NebbieDash.prefs.chat_window = false NebbieDash.savePreferencesFile() NebbieDash.teardownChatTriggers() cecho("<grey>[NebbieDash] Chat window off (preferenza salvata).
") else cecho("<grey>[NebbieDash] Chat window nascosta.
") end return end if mode == "clear" or mode == "cls" then NebbieDash.clearChatWindow() cecho("<green>[NebbieDash] Chat window svuotata.
") return end cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Uso: <yellow>nchat<orange> | <yellow>nchat on|off|clear
") cecho("<grey>Raccoglie: say, gt/gtell, clantell/casata, tell, whisper, ask, gossip, shout.
") end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Achievement per toon (port da Nebbie Achievement): nach / nachievements. -- File: ndashboard/achievement/<PG>.lua (migra da getMudletHomeDir()/achievement). -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- NebbieDash._ach = NebbieDash._ach or { dati = {}, vista = { pg = nil, cat = "Tutte", ordine = "perc", completi = false, page = 1 }, lettura = nil, visible = false, created = false, trigIds = {}, keyId = nil, endTimer = nil, }
NebbieDash.ACH_CATEGORIES = { "Tutte", "Race", "Boss", "Skill", "Quest", "Other" } NebbieDash.ACH_PAGE_SIZE = 20
function NebbieDash.achState() NebbieDash._ach = NebbieDash._ach or { dati = {}, vista = { pg = nil, cat = "Tutte", ordine = "perc", completi = false, page = 1 }, lettura = nil, visible = false, created = false, trigIds = {}, } local st = NebbieDash._ach st.dati = st.dati or {} st.vista = st.vista or { pg = nil, cat = "Tutte", ordine = "perc", completi = false, page = 1 } if st.vista.page == nil then st.vista.page = 1 end st.trigIds = st.trigIds or {} return st end
function NebbieDash.achActivePg() local name = NebbieDash.currentChar if name and name ~= "" then return name end return nil end
function NebbieDash.achTrim(s) return (tostring(s or ""):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")) end
function NebbieDash.achParseNum(s) return tonumber((tostring(s or ""):gsub("%.", ""))) or 0 end
function NebbieDash.achFmtNum(n) local s = tostring(math.floor(n or 0)) local r = s:reverse():gsub("(%d%d%d)", "%1."):reverse() return (r:gsub("^%.", "")) end
-- Contatore senza singolare/plurale: "Re Salomone ucciso" ~ "Re Salomone uccisi" function NebbieDash.achCounterKey(cat, cont) local w = {} for p in tostring(cont or ""):lower():gmatch("%S+") do w[#w + 1] = (#p > 3) and p:gsub("[aeio]$", "") or p end return tostring(cat or "") .. "|" .. table.concat(w, " ") end
function NebbieDash.achDir() return NebbieDash.configPath("achievement") end
function NebbieDash.achFile(pg) return NebbieDash.achDir() .. "/" .. tostring(pg) .. ".lua" end
function NebbieDash.ensureAchDir() if type(NebbieDash.ensureConfigDir) == "function" then NebbieDash.ensureConfigDir() end local d = NebbieDash.achDir() if type(lfs) == "table" and type(lfs.mkdir) == "function" then pcall(lfs.mkdir, d) end return d end
function NebbieDash.achLegacyPaths(pg) local out = {} if type(getMudletHomeDir) == "function" then local home = getMudletHomeDir() if home and home ~= "" then out[#out + 1] = home .. "/achievement/" .. pg .. ".lua" end end if type(NebbieDash.mudletProfileHome) == "function" then local ph = NebbieDash.mudletProfileHome() if ph and ph ~= "" then out[#out + 1] = ph .. "/achievement/" .. pg .. ".lua" end end return out end
function NebbieDash.achMigrateLegacyIfNeeded(pg) if not pg or pg == "" then return end NebbieDash.ensureAchDir() local newPath = NebbieDash.achFile(pg) if type(io.exists) == "function" and io.exists(newPath) then return end local fcheck = io.open(newPath, "rb") if fcheck then fcheck:close(); return end for _, oldPath in ipairs(NebbieDash.achLegacyPaths(pg)) do local rf = io.open(oldPath, "rb") if rf then local content = rf:read("*a") rf:close() local wf = io.open(newPath, "wb") if wf then wf:write(content or "") wf:close() cecho("<yellow>[NebbieDash] Ach: migrato <white>" .. oldPath .. "<yellow> -> ndashboard/achievement/
") end return end end end
function NebbieDash.achLoad(pg) if not pg or pg == "" then return nil end local st = NebbieDash.achState() NebbieDash.achMigrateLegacyIfNeeded(pg) local t = {} if type(table.load) == "function" then local ok = pcall(table.load, NebbieDash.achFile(pg), t) if ok and type(t.lista) == "table" then st.dati[pg] = t end end st.dati[pg] = st.dati[pg] or { lista = {} } st.dati[pg].lista = st.dati[pg].lista or {} return st.dati[pg] end
function NebbieDash.achSave(pg) local st = NebbieDash.achState() local d = pg and st.dati[pg] if not d then return end NebbieDash.ensureAchDir() d.aggiornato = os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") if type(table.save) == "function" then pcall(table.save, NebbieDash.achFile(pg), d) end end
function NebbieDash.achKnownPgs() local out, seen = {}, {} local dir = NebbieDash.achDir() if type(lfs) == "table" and type(lfs.dir) == "function" then pcall(function() for f in lfs.dir(dir) do local n = tostring(f):match("^(.+)%.lua$") if n and not seen[n] then seen[n] = true out[#out + 1] = n end end end) end local active = NebbieDash.achActivePg() if active and not seen[active] then out[#out + 1] = active end table.sort(out) return out end
function NebbieDash.achParseListLine(rawLine, state) state = state or {} local l = NebbieDash.achTrim(NebbieDash.stripColors(rawLine or "")) local cat = l:match("^%-%-%-+%s+(%a+)%s+Achievements%s+%-%-%-+%s*$") if cat then state.cat = cat state.nuove = (state.nuove or 0) + 1 return true, "cat" end local n, nome, p, m, cont = l:match("^%[%s*(%d+)%]%s+(.-)%s+([%d%.]+)/([%d%.]+)%s+(.-)%s*$") if n then state.nuove = (state.nuove or 0) + 1 state.lista = state.lista or {} local nomeT = NebbieDash.achTrim(nome) state.lista[nomeT] = { num = tonumber(n), nome = nomeT, cat = state.cat or "", prog = NebbieDash.achParseNum(p), max = NebbieDash.achParseNum(m), cont = NebbieDash.achTrim(cont), t = os.time(), } return true, "row" end return false end
function NebbieDash.achBeginRead() local st = NebbieDash.achState() local pg = NebbieDash.achActivePg() if not pg then if not st.silentRefresh then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Ach: nessun PG attivo — attendi il prompt o nchar.
") end st.lettura = nil st.silentRefresh = false return end st.lettura = { pg = pg, cat = "", lista = {}, nuove = 0, silent = st.silentRefresh and true or false } end
function NebbieDash.achFinishRead() local st = NebbieDash.achState() local r = st.lettura local wasSilent = st.silentRefresh or (r and r.silent) st.lettura = nil st.silentRefresh = false if st.endTimer and type(killTimer) == "function" then pcall(killTimer, st.endTimer) end st.endTimer = nil if not (r and r.pg and type(r.lista) == "table" and next(r.lista)) then return end local d = NebbieDash.achLoad(r.pg) d.lista = r.lista NebbieDash.achSave(r.pg) local n = 0 for _ in pairs(r.lista) do n = n + 1 end if wasSilent then cecho(string.format( "<grey>[NebbieDash] Ach: %s aggiornato in silenzio (%d).
", r.pg, n)) else cecho(string.format( "
<cyan>[NebbieDash] Ach: <yellow>%s<cyan>: %d achievement memorizzati.
", r.pg, n)) end if st.visible then NebbieDash.achDraw() end if type(NebbieDash.achSyncPushToon) == "function" then NebbieDash.achSyncPushToon(r.pg, { quiet = true }) end end
function NebbieDash.achUpdateLive(cat, nome, prog, maxv) local pg = NebbieDash.achActivePg() if not pg then return end nome = NebbieDash.achTrim(nome) if nome == "" then return end local st = NebbieDash.achState() local d = st.dati[pg] or NebbieDash.achLoad(pg) local v = d.lista[nome] if not v then v = { nome = nome, cat = cat, cont = "", max = maxv } d.lista[nome] = v end v.prog, v.max, v.t = prog, maxv, os.time() if v.cat == nil or v.cat == "" then v.cat = cat end if v.cont ~= "" then local k = NebbieDash.achCounterKey(v.cat, v.cont) for _, x in pairs(d.lista) do if x ~= v and x.cont ~= "" and NebbieDash.achCounterKey(x.cat, x.cont) == k and x.prog < x.max then x.prog = math.min(prog, x.max) end end end NebbieDash.achSave(pg) if st.visible then NebbieDash.achDraw() end if type(NebbieDash.achScheduleSyncPush) == "function" then NebbieDash.achScheduleSyncPush(pg) end end
function NebbieDash.achScheduleSyncPush(pg) if not pg or pg == "" then return end if type(NebbieDash.achSyncEnabled) ~= "function" or not NebbieDash.achSyncEnabled() then return end local st = NebbieDash.achState() st.pushPending = pg if st.pushTimer and type(killTimer) == "function" then pcall(killTimer, st.pushTimer) end if type(tempTimer) ~= "function" then NebbieDash.achSyncPushToon(pg, { quiet = true }) return end st.pushTimer = tempTimer(20, function() local s = NebbieDash.achState() s.pushTimer = nil local who = s.pushPending s.pushPending = nil if who then NebbieDash.achSyncPushToon(who, { quiet = true }) end end) end
function NebbieDash.achOnPrompt() local st = NebbieDash.achState() if st.lettura then tempTimer(0.2, function() if NebbieDash.achState().lettura then NebbieDash.achFinishRead() end end) end end
function NebbieDash.achOnCharacterChanged(name) local st = NebbieDash.achState() if name and name ~= "" then if st.visible then st.vista.pg = name NebbieDash.achLoad(name) NebbieDash.achDraw() end if type(NebbieDash.achMaybeAutoOnLogin) == "function" then NebbieDash.achMaybeAutoOnLogin(name, "char") end end end
-- Un elemento per contatore: prossimo scalino. function NebbieDash.achBuildRows(pg) local st = NebbieDash.achState() local d = st.dati[pg] or NebbieDash.achLoad(pg) local gruppi = {} for _, v in pairs(d.lista or {}) do local k = (v.cont and v.cont ~= "") and NebbieDash.achCounterKey(v.cat, v.cont) or ("nome|" .. tostring(v.nome)) local g = gruppi[k] or { voci = {} } gruppi[k] = g g.voci[#g.voci + 1] = v end local out = {} for _, g in pairs(gruppi) do table.sort(g.voci, function(a, b) return (a.max or 0) < (b.max or 0) end) local prossimo, fatti = nil, 0 for _, v in ipairs(g.voci) do if (v.prog or 0) >= (v.max or 0) then fatti = fatti + 1 elseif not prossimo then prossimo = v end end local v = prossimo or g.voci[#g.voci] if v and (st.vista.cat == "Tutte" or v.cat == st.vista.cat) and (prossimo or st.vista.completi) then out[#out + 1] = { v = v, scalino = fatti + (prossimo and 1 or 0), tot = #g.voci, completo = not prossimo, perc = (v.max or 0) > 0 and math.min((v.prog or 0) / v.max, 1) or 0, mancano = math.max((v.max or 0) - (v.prog or 0), 0), } end end table.sort(out, function(a, b) if a.completo ~= b.completo then return not a.completo end if st.vista.ordine == "mancano" then if a.mancano ~= b.mancano then return a.mancano < b.mancano end elseif a.perc ~= b.perc then return a.perc > b.perc end return tostring(a.v.nome) < tostring(b.v.nome) end) return out, d end
function NebbieDash.achBar(perc, larg) larg = larg or 20 local pieni = math.floor((perc or 0) * larg + 0.5) if pieni < 0 then pieni = 0 end if pieni > larg then pieni = larg end local col = perc >= 0.75 and "<green>" or (perc >= 0.4 and "<gold>" or "<grey>") -- Blocchi pieni/vuoti (leggibili in MiniConsole Mudlet). return col .. string.rep("█", pieni) .. "<dim_grey>" .. string.rep("░", larg - pieni) .. "<reset>" end
function NebbieDash.canUseAchWindow() return type(Adjustable) == "table" and type(Adjustable.Container) == "table" and type(Geyser) == "table" and type(Geyser.MiniConsole) == "table" end
function NebbieDash.destroyAchWindow() local st = NebbieDash.achState() if st.container then if type(st.container.hide) == "function" then pcall(function() st.container:hide() end) end if type(st.container.delete) == "function" then pcall(function() st.container:delete() end) end end for _, name in ipairs({ "NebbieDashAchContainer", "NebbieDashAch" }) do if type(deleteWindow) == "function" then pcall(deleteWindow, name) end end st.container = nil st.console = nil st.created = false st.visible = false end
function NebbieDash.achCecho(text) local g = NebbieDash.achState().console if g and type(g.cecho) == "function" then pcall(function() g:cecho(text) end) end end
function NebbieDash.achCechoLink(text, command, hint) local g = NebbieDash.achState().console if g and type(g.cechoLink) == "function" then pcall(function() g:cechoLink(text, command, hint or "", true) end) elseif type(cechoLink) == "function" then pcall(cechoLink, "NebbieDashAch", text, command, hint or "", true) end end
function NebbieDash.achButton(label, active, command, hint) if active then NebbieDash.achCechoLink("<black:yellow> " .. label .. " <reset>", command, hint) else NebbieDash.achCechoLink("<cyan>" .. label .. "<reset>", command, hint) end NebbieDash.achCecho(" ") end
function NebbieDash.initAchWindow() local st = NebbieDash.achState() if not NebbieDash.canUseAchWindow() then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Ach: finestra non disponibile (Adjustable/Geyser).
") return false end if st.created and st.container then if type(st.container.show) == "function" then pcall(function() st.container:show() end) end st.visible = true return true end NebbieDash.destroyAchWindow() st.container = Adjustable.Container:new({ name = "NebbieDashAchContainer", x = "20%", y = "8%", width = 640, height = 560, titleText = "Nebbie — Achievement", titleTxtColor = "white", adjLabelstyle = [[ background-color: rgb(12, 12, 18); border: 2px solid rgb(90, 90, 40); border-radius: 6px; ]], }) local pad, titleH = 4, 22 st.console = Geyser.MiniConsole:new({ name = "NebbieDashAch", x = pad, y = titleH, width = "100%-" .. tostring(pad * 2), height = "100%-" .. tostring(titleH + pad), }, st.container) st.console:setColor(12, 12, 16, 255) if type(setMiniConsoleFontSize) == "function" then setMiniConsoleFontSize("NebbieDashAch", NebbieDash.fontSize or 10) end if type(enableScrollBar) == "function" then enableScrollBar("NebbieDashAch", true) end if type(setMaxLines) == "function" then setMaxLines("NebbieDashAch", 5000) end if type(st.container.load) == "function" then pcall(function() st.container:load() end) end st.created = true st.visible = true return true end
function NebbieDash.achSetVistaPg(pg) local st = NebbieDash.achState() st.vista.pg = pg st.vista.page = 1 NebbieDash.achLoad(pg) NebbieDash.achDraw() end
function NebbieDash.achSetVistaCat(cat) local st = NebbieDash.achState() st.vista.cat = cat st.vista.page = 1 NebbieDash.achDraw() end
function NebbieDash.achSetVistaOrdine(ord) local st = NebbieDash.achState() st.vista.ordine = ord st.vista.page = 1 NebbieDash.achDraw() end
function NebbieDash.achToggleCompleti() local st = NebbieDash.achState() st.vista.completi = not st.vista.completi st.vista.page = 1 NebbieDash.achDraw() end
function NebbieDash.achGotoPage(n) local st = NebbieDash.achState() st.vista.page = math.max(1, tonumber(n) or 1) NebbieDash.achDraw() end
function NebbieDash.achPage(delta) local st = NebbieDash.achState() st.vista.page = math.max(1, (st.vista.page or 1) + (tonumber(delta) or 0)) NebbieDash.achDraw() end
