function NebbieDash.achToggle() local st = NebbieDash.achState() if st.visible and st.created then if st.container and type(st.container.hide) == "function" then pcall(function() st.container:hide() end) end st.visible = false cecho("<grey>[NebbieDash] Ach: finestra nascosta (<yellow>nach<grey> per riaprire).
") return end if not NebbieDash.initAchWindow() then return end st.vista.pg = st.vista.pg or NebbieDash.achActivePg() if st.vista.pg then NebbieDash.achLoad(st.vista.pg) end NebbieDash.achDraw() cecho("<green>[NebbieDash] Ach: finestra aperta (<yellow>nach refresh<green> / Ctrl+Shift+A).
") end
function NebbieDash.onAchListHeaderLine() NebbieDash.achBeginRead() end
function NebbieDash.onAchPagerLine() local st = NebbieDash.achState() local r = st.lettura if r and (r.nuove or 0) > 0 then r.nuove = 0 send("", false) end end
function NebbieDash.onAchListBodyLine() local st = NebbieDash.achState() if not st.lettura then return end local text = line or (type(getCurrentLine) == "function" and getCurrentLine()) or "" NebbieDash.achParseListLine(text, st.lettura) if st.endTimer and type(killTimer) == "function" then pcall(killTimer, st.endTimer) end st.endTimer = tempTimer(4, function() local s = NebbieDash.achState() s.endTimer = nil if s.lettura then NebbieDash.achFinishRead() end end) end
function NebbieDash.onAchLiveUpdateLine() local text = line or (type(getCurrentLine) == "function" and getCurrentLine()) or "" text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text or "") local cat, nome, p, m = text:match( "^(Race|Boss|Skill|Quest|Other) Achievement #%d+ '(.+)' ([%d%.]+)/([%d%.]+)") if not cat then return end NebbieDash.achUpdateLive(cat, nome, NebbieDash.achParseNum(p), NebbieDash.achParseNum(m)) end
function NebbieDash.teardownAchTriggers() local st = NebbieDash.achState() for _, id in ipairs(st.trigIds or {}) do if id then pcall(function() killTrigger(id) end) end end st.trigIds = {} if st.keyId then pcall(function() killKey(st.keyId) end) st.keyId = nil end if st.endTimer and type(killTimer) == "function" then pcall(killTimer, st.endTimer) st.endTimer = nil end end
function NebbieDash.installAchTriggers() NebbieDash.teardownAchTriggers() local st = NebbieDash.achState() st.trigIds = {} local function addTrig(id) if id then table.insert(st.trigIds, id) end end if type(tempRegexTrigger) == "function" then addTrig(tempRegexTrigger([[^Ecco tutti i tuoi achievements:]], [[NebbieDash.onAchListHeaderLine()]])) addTrig(tempRegexTrigger([=[^\[Batti INVIO per continuare/Q per uscire\]]=], [[NebbieDash.onAchPagerLine()]])) addTrig(tempRegexTrigger([=[^(?:\[\s*\d+\]|-{3,}\s+\w+\s+Achievements)]=], [[NebbieDash.onAchListBodyLine()]])) addTrig(tempRegexTrigger( [[^(Race|Boss|Skill|Quest|Other) Achievement #\d+ '(.+)' ([\d.]+)/([\d.]+)]], [[NebbieDash.onAchLiveUpdateLine()]])) elseif type(tempTrigger) == "function" then addTrig(tempTrigger("Ecco tutti i tuoi achievements:", [[NebbieDash.onAchListHeaderLine()]])) addTrig(tempTrigger("Achievement #", [[NebbieDash.onAchLiveUpdateLine()]])) end if type(tempKey) == "function" and mudlet and mudlet.keymodifier and mudlet.key then st.keyId = tempKey( mudlet.keymodifier.Control + mudlet.keymodifier.Shift, mudlet.key.A, [[NebbieDash.cmdAch("")]]) end end
function NebbieDash.printAchHelp() cecho("<cyan>[NebbieDash] nach — achievement per toon
") cecho("<yellow> nach<white> Mostra/nasconde la finestra.
") cecho("<yellow> nach refresh<white> Manda achievements all (PG attivo).
") cecho("<yellow> nach status<white> PG attivo, file, conteggio.
") cecho("<yellow> nach pg <nome><white> Mostra i dati di un altro toon.
") cecho("<yellow> nach sync|pull|push<white> Sync VPS (stesso token di nidentsync).
") cecho("<grey> Hotkey: Ctrl+Shift+A. File: ndashboard/achievement/<PG>.lua
") cecho("<grey> Al login: pull VPS + refresh silenzioso (ach_auto_refresh / ach_sync).
") end
function NebbieDash.cmdAch(argStr) argStr = (argStr or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" local mode, rest = argStr:match("^(%S+)%s*(.-)%s*$") mode = (mode or ""):lower() rest = rest or "" if mode == "" or mode == "toggle" or mode == "on" or mode == "show" then NebbieDash.achToggle() return end if mode == "help" or mode == "?" then NebbieDash.printAchHelp() return end if mode == "off" or mode == "hide" then local st = NebbieDash.achState() if st.visible then NebbieDash.achToggle() end return end if mode == "refresh" or mode == "update" or mode == "reload" then local pg = NebbieDash.achActivePg() if not pg then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Ach: nessun PG attivo.
") return end if not NebbieDash.achState().visible then NebbieDash.initAchWindow() end NebbieDash.achRequestRefresh() cecho("<green>[NebbieDash] Ach: chiedo achievements all per <yellow>" .. pg .. "
") return end if mode == "status" or mode == "info" then local st = NebbieDash.achState() local pg = NebbieDash.achActivePg() or "(nessuno)" local view = st.vista.pg or "(nessuno)" local n = 0 if st.vista.pg and st.dati[st.vista.pg] and st.dati[st.vista.pg].lista then for _ in pairs(st.dati[st.vista.pg].lista) do n = n + 1 end elseif st.vista.pg then local d = NebbieDash.achLoad(st.vista.pg) for _ in pairs(d.lista or {}) do n = n + 1 end end cecho(string.format( "<green>[NebbieDash] Ach: attivo=<white>%s<green> vista=<white>%s<green> voci=%d visible=%s
", tostring(pg), tostring(view), n, tostring(st.visible))) cecho("<grey>[NebbieDash] Dir: " .. NebbieDash.achDir() .. "
") return end if mode == "pg" or mode == "char" or mode == "toon" then if rest == "" then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Uso: nach pg <nome>
") return end NebbieDash.achSetVistaPg(rest) if not NebbieDash.achState().visible then NebbieDash.achToggle() end return end if mode == "sync" then local pg = NebbieDash.achActivePg() if not pg then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Ach: nessun PG attivo.
") return end NebbieDash.achSyncPullToon(pg, function() NebbieDash.achSyncPushToon(pg, { quiet = false }) end) return end if mode == "pull" then local pg = NebbieDash.achActivePg() or rest if not pg or pg == "" then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Ach: nessun PG.
") return end NebbieDash.achSyncPullToon(pg) return end if mode == "push" then local pg = NebbieDash.achActivePg() or rest if not pg or pg == "" then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Ach: nessun PG.
") return end NebbieDash.achSyncPushToon(pg, { quiet = false }) return end NebbieDash.printAchHelp() end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Achievement VPS sync (/v1/ach) + refresh silenzioso al login toon. -- Stesso hub/token di nidentsync. Merge: prog piu' alto vince. -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- NebbieDash.ACH_SYNC_PAGE_SIZE = 30
function NebbieDash.achSyncEnabled() NebbieDash.prefs = NebbieDash.prefs or {} if NebbieDash.prefs.ach_sync == false then return false end return NebbieDash.identSyncConfigured() and true or false end
function NebbieDash.achSyncBusy() return NebbieDash._achSync and NebbieDash._achSync.active and true or false end
function NebbieDash.achSyncAbort(msg) if NebbieDash._achSync then NebbieDash._achSync.active = false end if msg and msg ~= "" then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Ach sync: " .. tostring(msg) .. "
") end end
function NebbieDash.ensureAchSyncHttpHandlers() if NebbieDash._achSyncHttpHandlers then return end if type(registerAnonymousEventHandler) ~= "function" then return end registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysGetHttpDone", "NebbieDash.onAchSyncGetDone") registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysGetHttpError", "NebbieDash.onAchSyncGetError") registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysPostHttpDone", "NebbieDash.onAchSyncPostDone") registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysPostHttpError", "NebbieDash.onAchSyncPostError") NebbieDash._achSyncHttpHandlers = true end
function NebbieDash.achSyncIsOurUrl(url) local st = NebbieDash._achSync if not (st and st.base and type(url) == "string") then return false end return url:find(st.base, 1, true) ~= nil and url:find("/v1/ach", 1, true) ~= nil end
function NebbieDash.achNormalizeEntry(e) if type(e) ~= "table" then return nil end local nome = NebbieDash.achTrim(e.nome or "") if nome == "" then return nil end return { num = tonumber(e.num) or 0, nome = nome, cat = tostring(e.cat or ""), prog = tonumber(e.prog) or 0, max = tonumber(e.max) or 0, cont = tostring(e.cont or ""), t = tonumber(e.t) or 0, } end
function NebbieDash.achMergeEntryLocal(existing, incoming) local a = NebbieDash.achNormalizeEntry(existing) local b = NebbieDash.achNormalizeEntry(incoming) if not a and not b then return nil, "skip" end if not a then return b, "inserted" end if not b then return a, "unchanged" end if b.prog > a.prog or (b.prog == a.prog and b.t > a.t) then local out = b out.max = math.max(a.max, b.max) if out.cat == "" and a.cat ~= "" then out.cat = a.cat end if out.cont == "" and a.cont ~= "" then out.cont = a.cont end return out, "updated" end local out = a out.max = math.max(a.max, b.max) if out.cat == "" and b.cat ~= "" then out.cat = b.cat end if out.cont == "" and b.cont ~= "" then out.cont = b.cont end return out, "unchanged" end
function NebbieDash.achMergeListaIntoLocal(pg, remoteLista, meta) if not pg or type(remoteLista) ~= "table" then return 0, 0 end local d = NebbieDash.achLoad(pg) d.lista = d.lista or {} local ins, upd = 0, 0 for nome, entry in pairs(remoteLista) do local key = NebbieDash.achTrim(nome) if key ~= "" then local merged, status = NebbieDash.achMergeEntryLocal(d.lista[key], entry) if merged then if status == "inserted" then ins = ins + 1 elseif status == "updated" then upd = upd + 1 end d.lista[key] = merged end end end if meta and meta.aggiornato and meta.aggiornato ~= "" then if not d.aggiornato or d.aggiornato == "" or ins > 0 or upd > 0 then d.aggiornato = meta.aggiornato end end if ins > 0 or upd > 0 then NebbieDash.achSave(pg) end return ins, upd end
function NebbieDash.achExportToonPayload(pg) local d = NebbieDash.achLoad(pg) local lista = {} for nome, e in pairs(d.lista or {}) do local ne = NebbieDash.achNormalizeEntry(e) if ne then lista[nome] = ne end end return { aggiornato = d.aggiornato or "", updated_at = os.time(), lista = lista, } end
function NebbieDash.achStartSilentRefresh(pg) local st = NebbieDash.achState() if st.lettura then return end if NebbieDash.achActivePg() ~= pg then return end st.silentRefresh = true send("achievements all", false) end
function NebbieDash.achMaybeAutoOnLogin(pg, reason) if not pg or pg == "" then return end NebbieDash.prefs = NebbieDash.prefs or {} if NebbieDash.prefs.ach_auto_refresh == false then return end local st = NebbieDash.achState() st.autoDone = st.autoDone or {} if st.autoDone[pg] then return end if st.lettura then return end st.autoDone[pg] = true if type(tempTimer) ~= "function" then NebbieDash.achLoginPipeline(pg) return end tempTimer(3.0, function() if NebbieDash.achActivePg() ~= pg then return end NebbieDash.achLoginPipeline(pg) end) end
function NebbieDash.achLoginPipeline(pg) local function afterPull() NebbieDash.achStartSilentRefresh(pg) end if NebbieDash.achSyncEnabled() then NebbieDash.achSyncPullToon(pg, afterPull, { quiet = true }) else afterPull() end end
function NebbieDash.achSyncPullToon(pg, onDone, opts) opts = opts or {} if not pg or pg == "" then if onDone then onDone(false) end return end if not NebbieDash.achSyncEnabled() then if not opts.quiet then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Ach sync: token/URL assenti (nidentsync) o ach_sync=off.
") end if onDone then onDone(false) end return end if NebbieDash.achSyncBusy() then if not opts.quiet then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Ach sync: gia' in corso.
") end if onDone then onDone(false) end return end local okCfg, base = NebbieDash.identSyncConfigured() if not okCfg then if onDone then onDone(false) end return end NebbieDash.ensureAchSyncHttpHandlers() NebbieDash._achSync = { active = true, mode = "pull", base = base, pg = pg, page = 1, inserted = 0, updated = 0, onDone = onDone, quiet = opts.quiet and true or false, } if not opts.quiet then cecho("<grey>[NebbieDash] Ach: pull VPS per <white>" .. pg .. "<grey>...
") end NebbieDash.achSyncRequestPage(pg, 1) end
function NebbieDash.achSyncRequestPage(pg, page) local st = NebbieDash._achSync if not (st and st.active) then return end local url = string.format( "%s/v1/ach?toon=%s&page=%d&page_size=%d", st.base, (tostring(pg):gsub("[^%w_%-]", function(c) return string.format("%%%02X", string.byte(c)) end)), page, NebbieDash.ACH_SYNC_PAGE_SIZE or 30) st.expectUrl = url local headers = NebbieDash.identSyncHeaders() if type(getHTTP) ~= "function" then NebbieDash.achSyncAbort("getHTTP non disponibile") if st.onDone then st.onDone(false) end return end local ok, err = pcall(getHTTP, url, headers) if not ok then NebbieDash.achSyncAbort("getHTTP fallita: " .. tostring(err)) if st.onDone then st.onDone(false) end end end
function NebbieDash.onAchSyncGetDone(event, url, body) if not NebbieDash.achSyncIsOurUrl(url) then return end local st = NebbieDash._achSync if not (st and st.active and st.mode == "pull") then return end local data = NebbieDash.jsonDecode(body or "") if type(data) ~= "table" or data.ok == false then NebbieDash.achSyncAbort("risposta pull non valida") if st.onDone then st.onDone(false) end return end local ins, upd = NebbieDash.achMergeListaIntoLocal( st.pg, data.lista or {}, { aggiornato = data.aggiornato }) st.inserted = (st.inserted or 0) + (ins or 0) st.updated = (st.updated or 0) + (upd or 0) local page = tonumber(data.page) or 1 local pages = tonumber(data.pages) or 1 if page < pages then NebbieDash.achSyncRequestPage(st.pg, page + 1) return end st.active = false if not st.quiet then cecho(string.format( "<green>[NebbieDash] Ach pull %s: +%d nuovi, %d aggiornati.
", st.pg, st.inserted or 0, st.updated or 0)) end local cb = st.onDone st.onDone = nil if NebbieDash.achState().visible then NebbieDash.achDraw() end if cb then cb(true) end end
function NebbieDash.onAchSyncGetError(event, url, err) if url and not NebbieDash.achSyncIsOurUrl(url) then return end local st = NebbieDash._achSync if not (st and st.active and st.mode == "pull") then return end NebbieDash.achSyncAbort("errore GET: " .. tostring(err)) if st.onDone then st.onDone(false) end end
function NebbieDash.achSyncPushToon(pg, opts) opts = opts or {} if not pg or pg == "" then return end if not NebbieDash.achSyncEnabled() then if not opts.quiet then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Ach sync: non configurato.
") end return end if type(postHTTP) ~= "function" then if not opts.quiet then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Ach sync: postHTTP non disponibile.
") end return end local okCfg, base = NebbieDash.identSyncConfigured() if not okCfg then return end NebbieDash.ensureAchSyncHttpHandlers() local payload = { toons = { [pg] = NebbieDash.achExportToonPayload(pg), }, } local body = NebbieDash.jsonEncode(payload) if not body then if not opts.quiet then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Ach sync: JSON encode fallita.
") end return end NebbieDash._achSync = { active = true, mode = "push", base = base, pg = pg, quiet = opts.quiet and true or false, } local url = base .. "/v1/ach/merge" local headers = NebbieDash.identSyncHeaders() local ok, err = pcall(postHTTP, body, url, headers) if not ok then NebbieDash.achSyncAbort("postHTTP fallita: " .. tostring(err)) elseif not opts.quiet then cecho("<grey>[NebbieDash] Ach: push VPS <white>" .. pg .. "<grey>...
") end end
function NebbieDash.onAchSyncPostDone(event, url, body) if not NebbieDash.achSyncIsOurUrl(url) then return end local st = NebbieDash._achSync if not (st and st.active and st.mode == "push") then return end st.active = false local data = NebbieDash.jsonDecode(body or "") if not st.quiet then if type(data) == "table" and data.ok then cecho(string.format( "<green>[NebbieDash] Ach push ok (+%s / ~%s).
", tostring(data.inserted or 0), tostring(data.updated or 0))) else cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Ach push: risposta anomala.
") end end end
function NebbieDash.onAchSyncPostError(event, url, err) if url and not NebbieDash.achSyncIsOurUrl(url) then return end local st = NebbieDash._achSync if not (st and st.active and st.mode == "push") then return end NebbieDash.achSyncAbort("errore POST: " .. tostring(err)) end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Finestra floating gestione archivio identify (nidentui). -- Lista filtrabile + dettaglio con azioni (elimina, cedibile, possesso, export). -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- NebbieDash._identUiState = NebbieDash._identUiState or { filter = "", charFilter = "", slotFilter = "", onlyCedibile = false, sort = "name", -- name | recent | type | slot page = 1, pageSize = 12, view = "list", -- list | detail | slots tab = "active", -- active | deleted (Archiviati) selectedKey = nil, pendingDeleteKey = nil, }
-- Completa i default se lo stato proviene da una versione senza `tab` -- (altrimenti tab=nil e comportamenti ambigui). function NebbieDash.ensureIdentUiState() local st = NebbieDash._identUiState if type(st) ~= "table" then NebbieDash._identUiState = { filter = "", charFilter = "", slotFilter = "", onlyCedibile = false, sort = "name", page = 1, pageSize = 12, view = "list", tab = "active", selectedKey = nil, pendingDeleteKey = nil, } return NebbieDash._identUiState end if st.filter == nil then st.filter = "" end if st.charFilter == nil then st.charFilter = "" end if st.slotFilter == nil then st.slotFilter = "" end if st.onlyCedibile == nil then st.onlyCedibile = false end if st.sort == nil then st.sort = "name" end if st.page == nil then st.page = 1 end if st.pageSize == nil then st.pageSize = 12 end if st.view == nil then st.view = "list" end -- "all" non e' piu' supportato: gli archiviati stanno SOLO in Archiviati. if st.tab == nil or st.tab == "" or st.tab == "all" then st.tab = "active" end return st end
function NebbieDash.canUseIdentUiWindow() if type(Geyser) ~= "table" or type(Geyser.MiniConsole) ~= "table" then return false end if type(Adjustable) == "table" and type(Adjustable.Container) == "table" then return true end -- Fallback senza Adjustable (o se CTUW ha rotto Container:new). return type(Geyser.UserWindow) == "table" end
-- Nome NUOVO (1.16.9): evita collisioni con UserWindow OS vuote create da -- openUserWindow("NebbieDashIdentUiContainer") in 1.16.4–1.16.8. NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_CONTAINER = "NebbieDashIdentUiPanel" NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_CONSOLE = "NebbieDashIdentUi" -- convertToUserWindow crea "<name>userWindow" al doppio-click. NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_USERWINDOW = "NebbieDashIdentUiPaneluserWindow" NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_LEGACY_WINDOWS = { "NebbieDashIdentUiContainer", "NebbieDashIdentUiContaineruserWindow", "NebbieDashIdentUiPaneluserWindow", } -- Size/pos di default. Preferiamo Adjustable.Container (dentro Mudlet); -- UserWindow (finestra OS "fuori") solo come fallback. NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_W = 560 NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_H = 480 NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_X = 80 NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_Y = 80 -- Ancoraggio destro tipico Adjustable (come nswui), resta nel main frame. NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_ADJ_X = "-580px" NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_ADJ_Y = "80px"
-- true se i riferimenti Lua puntano ancora a window Geyser vive. -- Probe get_width prima di Geyser.windowList: con CTUW il container puo' -- vivere dentro un UserWindow e non risultare come chiave top-level. function NebbieDash.identUiWindowAlive() if not NebbieDash._identUiCreated then return false end if not NebbieDash._identUiContainer or not NebbieDash._identUiGeyser then return false end if type(NebbieDash._identUiGeyser.get_width) == "function" then local ok, w = pcall(function() return NebbieDash._identUiGeyser:get_width() end) if ok and tonumber(w) ~= nil then return true end return false end if type(Geyser) == "table" and type(Geyser.windowList) == "table" then local list = Geyser.windowList return list[NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_CONTAINER] ~= nil or list[NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_CONSOLE] ~= nil or list[NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_USERWINDOW] ~= nil end return true end
-- Solo per Adjustable convertito da CTUW (non per Geyser.UserWindow nativo: -- lì isUserWindow=true e unlock/changeContainer/delete del parent crashano Mudlet). function NebbieDash.detachIdentUiFromUserWindow() if NebbieDash._identUiBackend == "userwindow" then return end local c = NebbieDash._identUiContainer if not c then return end pcall(function() if c.isUserWindow then if type(c.unlockContainer) == "function" then c:unlockContainer() end if type(c.changeContainer) == "function" and type(Geyser) == "table" then c:changeContainer(Geyser) end if type(c.setPercent) == "function" then c:setPercent(true, true) end c.isUserWindow = false end local uw = c.userwindow if uw and uw ~= c then if type(uw.hide) == "function" then pcall(function() uw:hide() end) end if type(uw.delete) == "function" then pcall(function() uw:delete() end) end end c.userwindow = nil end) end
-- Chiude SOLO UserWindow orfane legacy/CTUW. Mai closeUserWindow sul nome -- dell'Adjustable vivo: su diversi Mudlet appende o freeza il client. function NebbieDash.closeIdentUiOrphanUserWindows() if type(closeUserWindow) ~= "function" then return end for _, name in ipairs(NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_LEGACY_WINDOWS or {}) do pcall(closeUserWindow, name) end end
function NebbieDash.cancelIdentUiRebuildTimer() if NebbieDash._identUiRebuildTimer and type(killTimer) == "function" then pcall(killTimer, NebbieDash._identUiRebuildTimer) end NebbieDash._identUiRebuildTimer = nil NebbieDash._identUiRebuildPending = false end
-- Teardown sicuro: su UserWindow nativo NON combinare :delete + deleteWindow + -- closeUserWindow sullo stesso nome (double-free Qt → crash Mudlet). function NebbieDash.destroyIdentUiWindow() NebbieDash.cancelIdentUiRebuildTimer() if NebbieDash._identUiResizeTimer and type(killTimer) == "function" then pcall(killTimer, NebbieDash._identUiResizeTimer) end NebbieDash._identUiResizeTimer = nil
local backend = NebbieDash._identUiBackend local container = NebbieDash._identUiContainer local name = NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_CONTAINER local console = NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_CONSOLE
-- Scollega i ref Lua subito: timer/refresh non devono toccare widget in delete. NebbieDash._identUiContainer = nil NebbieDash._identUiGeyser = nil NebbieDash._identUiCreated = false NebbieDash._identUiHidden = true NebbieDash._identUiBackend = nil NebbieDash._identUiRows = nil NebbieDash._identUiLastW = nil
if backend == "userwindow" then if container and type(container.hide) == "function" then pcall(function() container:hide() end) end -- Una sola API di chiusura per la UserWindow nativa (solo quel nome). if type(closeUserWindow) == "function" then pcall(closeUserWindow, name) elseif container and type(container.delete) == "function" then pcall(function() container:delete() end) elseif type(deleteWindow) == "function" then pcall(deleteWindow, name) end if type(deleteWindow) == "function" then pcall(deleteWindow, console) end NebbieDash.closeIdentUiOrphanUserWindows() return end
-- Adjustable / CTUW / sconosciuto: detach CTUW poi hide+delete (come nswui). NebbieDash._identUiBackend = backend NebbieDash._identUiContainer = container NebbieDash.detachIdentUiFromUserWindow() NebbieDash._identUiContainer = nil NebbieDash._identUiBackend = nil
if container then if type(container.hide) == "function" then pcall(function() container:hide() end) end if type(container.delete) == "function" then pcall(function() container:delete() end) end end for _, winName in ipairs({ name, console }) do if type(deleteWindow) == "function" then pcall(deleteWindow, winName) end end -- Solo legacy/CTUW orfane — mai closeUserWindow(name) sull'Adjustable. NebbieDash.closeIdentUiOrphanUserWindows() end
-- Wrap colonne della mini-console Ident in base alla larghezza pixel corrente. function NebbieDash.updateIdentUiWrap() local name = "NebbieDashIdentUi" local w = nil local g = NebbieDash._identUiGeyser if g and type(g.get_width) == "function" then local ok, gw = pcall(function() return g:get_width() end) if ok then w = tonumber(gw) end end if not w and type(getWindowSize) == "function" then local ok, a = pcall(getWindowSize, name) if ok then w = tonumber(a) end end w = w or 560 local fw = 8 if type(calcFontSize) == "function" then local ok, a = pcall(calcFontSize, name) if ok and tonumber(a) and tonumber(a) > 0 then fw = tonumber(a) else ok, a = pcall(calcFontSize, NebbieDash.fontSize or 10) if ok and tonumber(a) and tonumber(a) > 0 then fw = tonumber(a) end end end local cols = math.max(40, math.floor(w / math.max(fw, 1)) - 2) if type(setWindowWrap) == "function" then pcall(setWindowWrap, name, cols) end if g and type(g.setWrap) == "function" then pcall(function() g:setWrap(cols) end) end NebbieDash._identUiWrapCols = cols return cols, w end
-- Poll leggero: Adjustable.Container non ha un resize event portabile su tutte -- le versioni Mudlet. Se la larghezza cambia, rifa wrap + refresh. function NebbieDash.armIdentUiResizeWatch() if NebbieDash._identUiResizeTimer then return end if not NebbieDash._identUiCreated or NebbieDash._identUiHidden then return end NebbieDash._identUiResizeTimer = tempTimer(0.4, function() NebbieDash._identUiResizeTimer = nil if not NebbieDash._identUiCreated or NebbieDash._identUiHidden then return end local _, w = NebbieDash.updateIdentUiWrap() w = tonumber(w) or 0 local last = tonumber(NebbieDash._identUiLastW) or 0 if math.abs(w - last) >= 8 then NebbieDash._identUiLastW = w NebbieDash.refreshIdentUi() return end NebbieDash.armIdentUiResizeWatch() end) end
function NebbieDash.identUiCecho(text) local g = NebbieDash._identUiGeyser if g and type(g.cecho) == "function" then g:cecho(text) elseif type(cecho) == "function" then cecho("NebbieDashIdentUi", text) end end
function NebbieDash.identUiCechoLink(text, command, hint) local g = NebbieDash._identUiGeyser if g and type(g.cechoLink) == "function" then g:cechoLink(text, command, hint or "", true) elseif type(cechoLink) == "function" then cechoLink("NebbieDashIdentUi", text, command, hint or "", true) else NebbieDash.identUiCecho(text) end end
function NebbieDash.clearIdentUiWindow() if NebbieDash._identUiGeyser and type(NebbieDash._identUiGeyser.clear) == "function" then pcall(function() NebbieDash._identUiGeyser:clear() end) elseif type(clearWindow) == "function" then pcall(clearWindow, "NebbieDashIdentUi") end end
function NebbieDash.wipeIdentUiSavedState() -- Adjustable.Container:load() ripristina pos/size/hidden da file e con CTUW -- puo' lasciare la UI "viva" ma invisibile (il tuo debug: alive=true adjustable). local home = (type(getMudletHomeDir) == "function" and getMudletHomeDir()) or nil if not home or home == "" then return end home = tostring(home):gsub("/+$", "") local name = NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_CONTAINER local paths = { home .. "/AdjustableContainer/" .. name .. ".lua", home .. "/AdjustableContainers/" .. name .. ".lua", home .. "/adjustable_container_" .. name .. ".lua", } for _, p in ipairs(paths) do pcall(os.remove, p) end end
function NebbieDash.forceIdentUiGeometry(w, h, x, y) w = tonumber(w) or NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_W or 560 h = tonumber(h) or NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_H or 480 local c = NebbieDash._identUiContainer if not c then return end local ws, hs = w .. "px", h .. "px" local xs, ys if NebbieDash._identUiBackend == "adjustable" then xs = (type(x) == "string" and x) or NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_ADJ_X or "-580px" ys = (type(y) == "string" and y) or NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_ADJ_Y or "80px" else x = tonumber(x) or NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_X or 80 y = tonumber(y) or NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_Y or 80 xs, ys = x .. "px", y .. "px" end -- Geyser preferisce stringhe con unita' ("560px"). pcall(function() if type(c.resize) == "function" then c:resize(ws, hs) end if type(c.move) == "function" then c:move(xs, ys) end end) if type(resizeWindow) == "function" then pcall(resizeWindow, NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_CONTAINER, w, h) end if NebbieDash._identUiBackend ~= "adjustable" and type(moveWindow) == "function" then pcall(moveWindow, NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_CONTAINER, tonumber(x) or NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_X or 80, tonumber(y) or NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_Y or 80) end end
-- true se w/h sono inutilizzabili (stato sballato post-chiusura Mudlet). function NebbieDash.identUiGeometryLooksBroken() local c = NebbieDash._identUiContainer if not c then return true end local w, h = nil, nil pcall(function() if type(c.get_width) == "function" then w = tonumber(c:get_width()) end if type(c.get_height) == "function" then h = tonumber(c:get_height()) end end) if not w or not h then return false end return w < 120 or h < 80 or w > 4000 or h > 3000 end
function NebbieDash.showIdentUiWindow(opts) opts = opts or {} local c = NebbieDash._identUiContainer if opts.resetGeom or NebbieDash.identUiGeometryLooksBroken() then NebbieDash.forceIdentUiGeometry() end -- Se CTUW ha staccato l'Adjustable, mostra il parent UserWindow reale -- (oggetto Geyser), NON openUserWindow(nome) — crea shell OS VUOTE. local ctuwParent = c and c.isUserWindow and c.userwindow if ctuwParent and type(ctuwParent.show) == "function" then pcall(function() ctuwParent:show() end) end if c and type(c.show) == "function" then pcall(function() c:show() end) end if type(showWindow) == "function" then pcall(showWindow, NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_CONTAINER) pcall(showWindow, NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_CONSOLE) if ctuwParent then pcall(showWindow, NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_USERWINDOW) end end if c and type(c.raise) == "function" then pcall(function() c:raise() end) end if type(raiseWindow) == "function" then pcall(raiseWindow, NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_CONTAINER) pcall(raiseWindow, NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_CONSOLE) if ctuwParent then pcall(raiseWindow, NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_USERWINDOW) end end -- openUserWindow SOLO per backend UserWindow nativo (Geyser.UserWindow:new). -- Su Adjustable NON chiamarlo mai: apre finestre OS vuote omonime e, con -- doppio-clic CTUW, ne restano due. if NebbieDash._identUiBackend == "userwindow" and type(openUserWindow) == "function" and (opts.forceOpen or NebbieDash._identUiHidden) then pcall(openUserWindow, NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_CONTAINER) end NebbieDash._identUiHidden = false NebbieDash.armIdentUiResizeWatch() end
function NebbieDash.hideIdentUiWindow() local c = NebbieDash._identUiContainer if c and c.isUserWindow and c.userwindow and type(c.userwindow.hide) == "function" then pcall(function() c.userwindow:hide() end) end if c and type(c.hide) == "function" then pcall(function() c:hide() end) elseif type(hideWindow) == "function" then pcall(hideWindow, NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_CONTAINER) pcall(hideWindow, NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_CONSOLE) pcall(hideWindow, NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_USERWINDOW) end NebbieDash._identUiHidden = true if NebbieDash._identUiResizeTimer and type(killTimer) == "function" then pcall(killTimer, NebbieDash._identUiResizeTimer) end NebbieDash._identUiResizeTimer = nil end
function NebbieDash.createIdentUiShell(w, h) w = tonumber(w) or NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_W or 560 h = tonumber(h) or NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_H or 480 local x = tonumber(NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_X) or 80 local y = tonumber(NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_Y) or 80 local adjX = NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_ADJ_X or "-580px" local adjY = NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_ADJ_Y or "80px" -- "Npx" per UserWindow; Adjustable usa ancoraggio relativo (dentro Mudlet). local xs, ys, ws, hs = x .. "px", y .. "px", w .. "px", h .. "px" local backend = nil local container = nil local errUw, errAdj = nil, nil
-- Preferisci Adjustable: resta DENTRO Mudlet (nswui-like). Mai :load() — -- era la causa della UI "alive ma invisibile" con CTUW. -- UserWindow (finestra OS) solo se Adjustable non e' disponibile/rotto. if type(Adjustable) == "table" and type(Adjustable.Container) == "table" then local ok, res = pcall(function() return Adjustable.Container:new({ name = NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_CONTAINER, x = adjX, y = adjY, width = w, height = h, titleText = "Nebbie — Ident DB", titleTxtColor = "white", adjLabelstyle = [[ background-color: rgb(14, 14, 20); border: 2px solid rgb(120, 90, 50); border-radius: 6px; ]], }) end) if ok and res then container = res backend = "adjustable" else errAdj = tostring(res) end end
if not container and type(Geyser) == "table" and type(Geyser.UserWindow) == "table" then local ok, res = pcall(function() return Geyser.UserWindow:new({ name = NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_CONTAINER, x = xs, y = ys, width = ws, height = hs, }) end) if ok and res then container = res backend = "userwindow" pcall(function() if type(res.setTitle) == "function" then res:setTitle("Nebbie — Ident DB") end end) else errUw = tostring(res) end end
if not container then return nil, nil, "Adjustable=" .. tostring(errAdj) .. " UserWindow=" .. tostring(errUw) end
-- Doppio-clic: convertToUserWindow (se installato) stacca in UserWindow OS -- e un secondo doppio-clic la riporta dentro. Non sovrascrivere il callback -- CTUW (in 1.16.8 era azzerato per le shell vuote; ora openUserWindow non -- gira più su Adjustable, quindi il dblclick è di nuovo sicuro).
local pad = 4 local titleH = (backend == "adjustable") and 22 or 4 local okMc, mcOrErr = pcall(function() return Geyser.MiniConsole:new({ name = NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_CONSOLE, x = pad, y = titleH, width = "100%-" .. tostring(pad * 2), height = "100%-" .. tostring(titleH + pad), }, container) end) if not okMc or not mcOrErr then pcall(function() if type(container.delete) == "function" then container:delete() end end) return nil, nil, "MiniConsole=" .. tostring(mcOrErr) end return container, mcOrErr, backend end

Se e' ancora UserWindow nativo -- (sessioni 1.16.4–1.16.8) o Adjustable staccato da CTUW, ricrea Adjustable. if NebbieDash.identUiWindowAlive() and NebbieDash._identUiBackend == "adjustable" then local c = NebbieDash._identUiContainer if not (c and c.isUserWindow) then NebbieDash.showIdentUiWindow() NebbieDash.refreshIdentUi() return true end end NebbieDash.destroyIdentUiWindow() NebbieDash.wipeIdentUiSavedState() local container, mc, backendOrErr = NebbieDash.createIdentUiShell( NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_W, NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_H) if not container or not mc then cecho("<red>[NebbieDash] Creazione Ident UI fallita: " .. tostring(backendOrErr) .. "
") cecho("<grey>Prova <yellow>nidentui rebuild<grey>.
") NebbieDash.destroyIdentUiWindow() return false end NebbieDash._identUiContainer = container NebbieDash._identUiGeyser = mc NebbieDash._identUiBackend = backendOrErr pcall(function() NebbieDash._identUiGeyser:setColor(14, 14, 18, 255) end) if type(setMiniConsoleFontSize) == "function" then pcall(setMiniConsoleFontSize, NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_CONSOLE, NebbieDash.fontSize or 10) end if type(enableScrollBar) == "function" then pcall(enableScrollBar, NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_CONSOLE, true) end if type(setMaxLines) == "function" then pcall(setMaxLines, NebbieDash.IDENT_UI_CONSOLE, 4000) end -- Mai Adjustable:load() su Ident UI (fonte dello stato invisibile). NebbieDash._identUiCreated = true NebbieDash.showIdentUiWindow({ resetGeom = true }) NebbieDash.updateIdentUiWrap() NebbieDash.refreshIdentUi() NebbieDash.armIdentUiResizeWatch() return true end
function NebbieDash.isIdentArchived(entry) if type(entry) ~= "table" then return false end -- Qualsiasi truthy (true/1/"true") da sync/JSON; non solo == true. local a = entry.archived if a == true or a == 1 or a == "1" or a == "true" or a == "yes" then return true end local st = entry.possession and entry.possession.status if st == "archived" or st == "destroyed" then return true end return false end
function NebbieDash.identLifecycleStatus(entry) if not entry then return "unknown" end if entry.archived then local via = entry.archiveVia or (entry.possession and entry.possession.via) if via == "destroy" or (entry.possession and entry.possession.status == "destroyed") then return "destroyed" end return "archived" end local st = entry.possession and entry.possession.status return st or "unknown" end
-- Soft-delete: tiene la scheda identify, la nasconde da Attivi (tab Deleted). function NebbieDash.archiveIdentEntry(key, reason, via) key = key or "" if key == "" then return false, "chiave vuota" end NebbieDash.identDb = NebbieDash.identDb or { entries = {} } NebbieDash.identDb.entries = NebbieDash.identDb.entries or {} local entry = NebbieDash.identDb.entries[key] if not entry then return false, "non trovato" end local now = os.time() entry.archived = true entry.archivedAt = now entry.archiveReason = reason or "manual" entry.archiveVia = via or "manual" entry.lastAt = math.max(tonumber(entry.lastAt) or 0, now) local prevChar = entry.possession and entry.possession.character entry.possession = { status = (via == "destroy") and "destroyed" or "archived", character = nil, at = now, via = via or "archive", from = prevChar, displaySeen = entry.possession and entry.possession.displaySeen, } if NebbieDash._identDropPending and NebbieDash._identDropPending.key == key then NebbieDash._identDropPending = nil end local st = NebbieDash._identUiState if st and st.selectedKey == key then st.selectedKey = nil st.view = "list" end if st and st.pendingDeleteKey == key then st.pendingDeleteKey = nil end NebbieDash.scheduleIdentDbSave() return true, entry end
function NebbieDash.restoreIdentEntry(key) key = key or "" local entry = NebbieDash.identDb and NebbieDash.identDb.entries and NebbieDash.identDb.entries[key] if not entry then return false, "non trovato" end local now = os.time() entry.archived = false entry.archivedAt = nil entry.archiveReason = nil entry.archiveVia = nil entry.lastAt = math.max(tonumber(entry.lastAt) or 0, now) entry.possession = { status = "unknown", character = nil, at = now, via = "restore", from = nil, displaySeen = entry.possession and entry.possession.displaySeen, } NebbieDash.scheduleIdentDbSave() return true, entry end
-- Hard purge (solo esplicito): rimuove del tutto dal DB. function NebbieDash.purgeIdentEntry(key) key = key or "" if key == "" then return false, "chiave vuota" end NebbieDash.identDb = NebbieDash.identDb or { entries = {} } NebbieDash.identDb.entries = NebbieDash.identDb.entries or {} if not NebbieDash.identDb.entries[key] then return false, "non trovato" end NebbieDash.identDb.entries[key] = nil if NebbieDash._identDropPending and NebbieDash._identDropPending.key == key then NebbieDash._identDropPending = nil end local st = NebbieDash._identUiState if st and st.selectedKey == key then st.selectedKey = nil st.view = "list" end if st and st.pendingDeleteKey == key then st.pendingDeleteKey = nil end NebbieDash.scheduleIdentDbSave() return true end
-- Retrocompat: delete = soft archive (non purge). function NebbieDash.deleteIdentEntry(key) return NebbieDash.archiveIdentEntry(key, "manual", "manual") end
function NebbieDash.markIdentDestroyedByItemText(itemText) itemText = itemText or "" local entry = select(1, NebbieDash.matchIdentEntryByItemText(itemText, { preferChar = NebbieDash.currentChar, includeArchived = false, })) if not entry then -- prova anche senza filtro cedibile / preferChar largo entry = select(1, NebbieDash.matchIdentEntryByItemText(itemText, { preferChar = NebbieDash.currentChar, onlyCedibile = false, })) end if not entry or not entry.key then return nil end NebbieDash.archiveIdentEntry(entry.key, "destroyed", "destroy") return entry end
function NebbieDash.onIdentDestroyLine() local text = line or (type(getCurrentLine) == "function" and getCurrentLine()) or "" text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" local item = text:match("^Distruggi%s+(.+)%.%s*$") if not item then return end local entry = NebbieDash.markIdentDestroyedByItemText(item) if entry then cecho(string.format( "<orange>[NebbieDash] Ident: <white>%s<orange> → distrutto (tab Deleted, ripristinabile).\n", entry.objectName or item)) if NebbieDash._identUiCreated and not NebbieDash._identUiHidden then NebbieDash.refreshIdentUi() end end end
function NebbieDash.getIdentEntryByKey(key) return NebbieDash.identDb and NebbieDash.identDb.entries and NebbieDash.identDb.entries[key] end
function NebbieDash.collectIdentUiEntries() local st = NebbieDash.ensureIdentUiState() local tab = st.tab or "active" if tab ~= "deleted" then tab = "active" end st.tab = tab -- Archiviati SOLO nel tab deleted/Archiviati; Attivi non li include mai. local includeArch = (tab == "deleted") local listOpts = { includeArchived = includeArch } local results if st.charFilter and st.charFilter ~= "" then results = NebbieDash.listIdentDbByCharacter(st.charFilter, listOpts) else results = NebbieDash.searchIdentDb(st.filter or "", listOpts) end local filtered = {} for _, e in ipairs(results) do local arch = NebbieDash.isIdentArchived(e) if tab == "deleted" then if arch then table.insert(filtered, e) end else if not arch then table.insert(filtered, e) end end end results = filtered if st.charFilter and st.charFilter ~= "" and st.filter and st.filter ~= "" then local q = st.filter:lower() filtered = {} for _, e in ipairs(results) do local hay = table.concat({ e.objectName or "", e.objectType or "", e.flags or "", table.concat(e.affects or {}, " "), table.concat(NebbieDash.identWearSlotsList(e), " "), }, " "):lower() if hay:find(q, 1, true) then table.insert(filtered, e) end end results = filtered end if st.onlyCedibile then filtered = {} for _, e in ipairs(results) do if e.cedibile then table.insert(filtered, e) end end results = filtered end if st.slotFilter and st.slotFilter ~= "" then local needle = st.slotFilter:lower() filtered = {} for _, e in ipairs(results) do if NebbieDash.identEntryMatchesWearSlotFilter(e, needle) then table.insert(filtered, e) end end results = filtered end local sort = st.sort or "name" table.sort(results, function(a, b) if sort == "recent" then return (a.lastAt or 0) > (b.lastAt or 0) end if sort == "type" then local ta, tb = a.objectType or "", b.objectType or "" if ta ~= tb then return ta < tb end end if sort == "slot" then local sa = NebbieDash.primaryIdentWearSlot(a) or "\xff" local sb = NebbieDash.primaryIdentWearSlot(b) or "\xff" if sa ~= sb then return sa < sb end end return (a.objectName or "") < (b.objectName or "") end) return results end

" <grey>| filtro: <yellow>" .. ((st.filter ~= "" and st.filter) or "(nessuno)") .. " <grey>| PG: <yellow>" .. ((st.charFilter ~= "" and st.charFilter) or "tutti") .. ") NebbieDash.swUiCechoLink("<orange>[Pausa]", "NebbieDash.cmdNsw("pause")", "nsw pause", true) NebbieDash.swUiCecho(" ") NebbieDash.swUiCechoLink("<green>[Riprendi]", "NebbieDash.cmdNsw("resume")", "nsw resume", true) NebbieDash.swUiCecho(" ") NebbieDash.swUiCechoLink("<yellow>[Skip]", "NebbieDash.cmdNsw("skip")", "nsw skip", true) NebbieDash.swUiCecho(" ") NebbieDash.swUiCechoLink("<red>[Stop]", "NebbieDash.cmdNsw("stop")", "nsw stop", true) NebbieDash.swUiCecho(" ") NebbieDash.swUiCechoLink("<cyan>[Ricarica]", "NebbieDash.cmdReloadSpeedwalks()", "nspeedwalks", true) NebbieDash.swUiCecho("
<grey>────────────────────────────────────

function NebbieDash.equipDividerPointerY(event) if type(getMousePosition) == "function" then local _x, y = getMousePosition() if type(y) == "number" then return y end end if type(event) == "table" then return event.y or event.yPos or event["y-pos"] or 0 end return 0 end
function NebbieDash.setEquipHeightRatioFromPointerY(y) local _w, h = getMainWindowSize() h = h or 600 local usableH = math.max(1, h - (NebbieDash.dividerPx or 4)) local ratio = math.max(0.1, math.min(0.9, (y or 0) / usableH)) NebbieDash.guiRatios = NebbieDash.guiRatios or {} NebbieDash.guiRatios.equip = ratio NebbieDash.guiRatios.manualEquip = true NebbieDash.positionGUI() end
function NebbieDash.onEquipDividerPress(event) if event and event.button and event.button ~= "LeftButton" then return end NebbieDash._equipRatioDrag = true NebbieDash.setEquipHeightRatioFromPointerY(NebbieDash.equipDividerPointerY(event)) end
function NebbieDash.onEquipDividerMove(event) if not NebbieDash._equipRatioDrag then return end NebbieDash.setEquipHeightRatioFromPointerY(NebbieDash.equipDividerPointerY(event)) end
function NebbieDash.onEquipDividerRelease(_event) if not NebbieDash._equipRatioDrag then return end NebbieDash._equipRatioDrag = nil NebbieDash.persistGuiRatios() end
function NebbieDash.setupEquipDividerDrag() if NebbieDash._equipRatioDragReady then return end if type(setLabelClickCallback) ~= "function" or type(setLabelMoveCallback) ~= "function" or type(setLabelReleaseCallback) ~= "function" then return end if type(setLabelCursor) == "function" then pcall(setLabelCursor, "NebbieDashDivider", "splitVCursor") end if type(setLabelToolTip) == "function" then setLabelToolTip("NebbieDashDivider", "Trascina per regolare altezza Equip / Speedwalk (oppure nheights)") end setLabelClickCallback("NebbieDashDivider", "NebbieDash.onEquipDividerPress") setLabelMoveCallback("NebbieDashDivider", "NebbieDash.onEquipDividerMove") setLabelReleaseCallback("NebbieDashDivider", "NebbieDash.onEquipDividerRelease") NebbieDash._equipRatioDragReady = true end
function NebbieDash.initDockSidebar() setBorderLeft(NebbieDash.guiWidthEquip) setBorderRight(0) createMiniConsole("NebbieDashEquip", 0, 0, NebbieDash.guiWidthEquip, 0) if type(enableScrollBar) == "function" then enableScrollBar("NebbieDashEquip", true) end if type(setMaxLines) == "function" then setMaxLines("NebbieDashEquip", 400) end -- Rimuovi pannello speedwalk / divider di versioni precedenti (ora c'e' nswui). for _, win in ipairs({ "NebbieDashSpeedwalks", "NebbieDashDivider" }) do if type(deleteWindow) == "function" then pcall(deleteWindow, win) elseif type(hideWindow) == "function" then pcall(hideWindow, win) end end end
function NebbieDash.initFloatSidebar() setBorderLeft(0) setBorderRight(0) if NebbieDash._floatSidebarCreated and NebbieDash._sidebarContainer then return end local sideW = NebbieDash.guiWidthEquip or 280 NebbieDash._sidebarContainer = Adjustable.Container:new({ name = "NebbieDashSidebarContainer", x = 0, y = 0, width = sideW, height = "100%", titleText = "Nebbie — Equip + Speedwalk", titleTxtColor = "white", adjLabelstyle = [[ background-color: rgb(10, 10, 16); border: 2px solid rgb(70, 70, 100); border-radius: 8px; ]], }) local pad = 4 local titleH = 26 NebbieDash._equipGeyser = Geyser.MiniConsole:new({ name = "NebbieDashEquip", x = pad, y = titleH, width = sideW - pad * 2, height = 200, }, NebbieDash._sidebarContainer) NebbieDash._equipGeyser:setColor(15, 15, 15, 255) if type(enableScrollBar) == "function" then enableScrollBar("NebbieDashEquip", true) end NebbieDash._dividerLabel = Geyser.Label:new({ name = "NebbieDashDivider", x = pad, y = titleH + 200, width = sideW - pad * 2, height = NebbieDash.dividerPx, }, NebbieDash._sidebarContainer) NebbieDash._dividerLabel:setStyleSheet("background-color: rgb(90, 90, 100);") NebbieDash._swGeyser = Geyser.MiniConsole:new({ name = "NebbieDashSpeedwalks", x = pad, y = titleH + 200 + NebbieDash.dividerPx, width = sideW - pad * 2, height = 200, }, NebbieDash._sidebarContainer) NebbieDash._swGeyser:setColor(15, 15, 15, 255) if type(enableScrollBar) == "function" then enableScrollBar("NebbieDashSpeedwalks", true) end NebbieDash._floatSidebarCreated = true end
function NebbieDash.destroyLegacyGuiWindows() if NebbieDash._floatSidebarCreated or NebbieDash._sidebarContainer then NebbieDash.destroyFloatSidebarArtifacts() end local legacy = { "NebbieDashSpells", "NebbieDashWeapons", "NebbieDashDividerLeft", "NebbieDashAttrib", "NebbieDashSidebarContainer", "NebbieDashSpeedwalks", "NebbieDashDivider", } for _, win in ipairs(legacy) do if type(deleteWindow) == "function" then pcall(deleteWindow, win) elseif type(hideWindow) == "function" then pcall(hideWindow, win) end end if type(setBorderRight) == "function" then pcall(setBorderRight, 0) end end
function NebbieDash.initGUI() if NebbieDash._guiCreated then return end NebbieDash.destroyFloatSidebarArtifacts() NebbieDash.sidebarMode = "dock" NebbieDash.initDockSidebar() for _, win in ipairs(NebbieDash.GUI_WINDOWS) do setMiniConsoleFontSize(win, NebbieDash.fontSize) setBackgroundColor(win, 15, 15, 15, 255) end NebbieDash._guiCreated = true NebbieDash.destroyLegacyGuiWindows() NebbieDash.positionGUI() NebbieDash.refreshDashboard() -- getMainWindowSize() puo' non essere ancora affidabile nello stesso istante -- in cui la GUI viene creata (geometria Qt non ancora assestata all'avvio -- del profilo): riesegui il posizionamento un istante dopo per evitare che -- un pannello resti a altezza 0 (visto come "una sola barra" a schermo). tempTimer(0, [[NebbieDash.positionGUI()]]) end
-- Calcola quanti caratteri servono per mostrare senza andare a capo tutto il -- contenuto del pannello equip (colonna sinistra): titolo + una riga per ogni -- posizione nota (occupata o "(vuoto)"). function NebbieDash.computeEquipMaxChars(data) local maxChars = 20 local name = NebbieDash.currentChar if name then maxChars = math.max(maxChars, #("Equip — " .. name)) end if data and data.eqUpdated then for _, row in ipairs(NebbieDash.buildEquipRows(data)) do if row.empty then maxChars = math.max(maxChars, #row.location + 14) -- "[NN] " + " (vuoto)" else local item = NebbieDash.truncate(row.item or "?", NebbieDash.itemMaxLen) maxChars = math.max(maxChars, #row.location + 5, #item + 5) end end end return maxChars end
-- Larghezza bordo sinistro da contenuto Equip. function NebbieDash.computeSidebarMaxChars(data) local maxChars = NebbieDash.computeEquipMaxChars(data) return math.min(maxChars, NebbieDash.autoWidthRightMaxChars or 58) end
function NebbieDash.applyAutoWidth() if not NebbieDash._guiCreated then return end local name = NebbieDash.currentChar local data = name and NebbieDash.getCharData(name) or nil local charW = calcFontSize(NebbieDash.fontSize) or 8 local mainW = select(1, getMainWindowSize()) or 1024 local maxSidebar = math.floor(mainW * (NebbieDash.autoWidthSidebarMaxWindowPct or 0.38))
if NebbieDash.autoWidthEquip or NebbieDash.autoWidthRight then local chars = NebbieDash.computeSidebarMaxChars(data) + 3 local cap = NebbieDash.autoWidthRightMaxChars or 58 local w = math.floor(charW * math.min(chars, cap)) w = math.max(NebbieDash.autoWidthMin, math.min(w, maxSidebar)) if w ~= NebbieDash.guiWidthEquip then NebbieDash.guiWidthEquip = w end end NebbieDash.applySidebarBorder() setBorderRight(0) end
function NebbieDash.positionGUI() if not NebbieDash._guiCreated then return end local _w, h = getMainWindowSize() h = h or 600 local sideW = NebbieDash.guiWidthEquip or 260 moveWindow("NebbieDashEquip", 0, 0) resizeWindow("NebbieDashEquip", sideW, h) NebbieDash.positionHelpButton() end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Tasto "Comandi" — richiesto esplicitamente ("tasto custom nell'interfaccia -- di mudlet che mostri una finestra di testo con tutti i comandi"). Mudlet -- non offre un modo affidabile per creare/verificare da script una vera voce -- di toolbar nativa (quella si configura solo via editor pacchetti/XML -- "Action", non testabile qui senza un'istanza Mudlet reale): usiamo invece -- una label fluttuante ancorata in cima allo schermo, cliccabile come un -- pulsante, sempre visibile (anche con `ngui` disattivato) — vedi -- MUDLET-WIKI-NOTES.md per i dettagli. -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- NebbieDash.helpButtonW = 90 NebbieDash.helpButtonH = 22
function NebbieDash.initHelpButton() if NebbieDash._helpButtonCreated then return end createLabel("NebbieDashHelpBtn", 0, 0, NebbieDash.helpButtonW, NebbieDash.helpButtonH, 1) setBackgroundColor("NebbieDashHelpBtn", 60, 60, 90, 255) cecho("NebbieDashHelpBtn", "<center><white><b>? Comandi</b>") setLabelClickCallback("NebbieDashHelpBtn", "NebbieDash.toggleHelp") setLabelToolTip("NebbieDashHelpBtn", "Mostra/nascondi l'elenco dei comandi NebbieDash") NebbieDash._helpButtonCreated = true NebbieDash.positionHelpButton() end
function NebbieDash.positionHelpButton() if not NebbieDash._helpButtonCreated then return end local w = select(1, getMainWindowSize()) or 800 -- Centrato in orizzontale sull'area di testo centrale (tra bordo sinistro -- equip e bordo destro spell/speedwalk), cosi' non si sovrappone mai ai -- nostri pannelli anche quando sono ridimensionati. local leftW = 0 if NebbieDash._guiCreated and NebbieDash._guiHidden ~= true then leftW = NebbieDash.guiWidthEquip or 0 end local centerAreaW = math.max(0, w - leftW) local x = leftW + math.max(0, math.floor((centerAreaW - NebbieDash.helpButtonW) / 2)) moveWindow("NebbieDashHelpBtn", x, 2) if NebbieDash._helpWinCreated then NebbieDash.positionHelpWindow() end end
function NebbieDash.positionHelpWindow() local w, h = getMainWindowSize() w, h = w or 800, h or 600 local winW = math.min(600, math.max(300, math.floor(w * 0.6))) local winH = math.min(500, math.max(200, math.floor(h * 0.6))) moveWindow("NebbieDashHelpWin", math.floor((w - winW) / 2), NebbieDash.helpButtonH + 6) resizeWindow("NebbieDashHelpWin", winW, winH) end

-- Rimuove manualmente una spell dall'elenco "conosciuto" del personaggio -- attivo (richiesto esplicitamente, 2026-08-10: l'utente ha segnalato che, -- passando da un personaggio all'altro, restavano visibili spell che quel -- personaggio non puo' lanciare — es. "mirror images"/"shield" mai -- realmente appartenenti a lui, probabilmente salvate per errore in una -- sessione precedente al fix del cambio-personaggio del Round 13, e MAI -- rimosse dall'elenco cumulativo perche' l'elenco "conosciuto" persistente -- non si ripulisce mai da solo). Nessuna euristica per classe qui: e' -- l'utente a sapere quali spell non gli appartengono, l'elenco delle spell -- per classe non e' un dato che abbiamo/possiamo inventare. function NebbieDash.cmdForgetSpell(argStr) local query = (argStr or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") local name = NebbieDash.currentChar if not name then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Nessun personaggio attivo.
") return end if query == "" then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Uso: nforgetspell <nome spell> — rimuove una spell " .. "memorizzata per errore dall'elenco del personaggio attivo (es. nforgetspell mirror images).
") return end local data = NebbieDash.getCharData(name) local matched = nil for i, s in ipairs(NebbieDash.castSpellPanelList or {}) do if s:lower() == query:lower() then matched = s table.remove(NebbieDash.castSpellPanelList, i) break end end if not matched then for i, s in ipairs(data.knownSpellOrder or {}) do if s:lower() == query:lower() then matched = s table.remove(data.knownSpellOrder, i) break end end end if not matched then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] '" .. query .. "' non e' nel pannello spell ne nell'elenco di " .. name .. ".
") return end if data.activeSpells then data.activeSpells[matched] = nil end NebbieDash.saveStore() NebbieDash.refreshDashboard() cecho("<green>[NebbieDash] Rimossa '" .. matched .. "' (pannello/elenco). " .. "Aggiorna anche " .. NebbieDash.castSpellsPath() .. " se serve.
") end

Con -- questi trigger diventa rossa SUBITO al messaggio di scadenza reale, senza -- aspettare che l'utente rilanci `attrib`. Testi REALI forniti dall'utente -- (uno per spell, nessuno inventato). Esplicitamente ESCLUSO dall'utente: -- "Senti i tuoi movimenti accellerare rapidamente." — e' la scadenza di -- "slowness", un DEBUFF (rallentamento subito, non un buff lanciato da noi), -- quindi non va trattato come le altre. -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- NebbieDash.SPELL_EXPIRY_PATTERNS = { { text = "Non ti senti piu' cosi' invulnerabile.", spell = "sanctuary" }, { text = "Perdi la tua armatura Divina.", spell = "armor" }, { text = "Perdi l'aiuto Divino.", spell = "aid" }, { text = "L'alone d'argento nei tuoi occhi scompare.", spell = "true sight" }, { text = "Il globo di oscurita' che ti avvolgeva scompare.", spell = "darkness" }, }

-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Allarme monete sottratte (prompt G: e/o GMCP char.base.gold) -- -- Il furto riuscito (do_steal) e' SILENZIOSO per la vittima. Segnali: -- 1) campo G:/g: sul prompt (serve G:%g o g:%g nel prompt del PG) -- 2) GMCP char.base.gold (inviato dal server a ogni prompt se GMCP e' on) -- Sopprimiamo i cali attesi da azioni volontarie (split, give coin, drop coin, -- pagamenti shop/asta) sia dai comandi inviati sia dagli echo di conferma. -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- NebbieDash.goldAlert = true NebbieDash.GOLD_SPEND_GRACE_SEC = 3.0 -- Rent: addebito pensione avviene al rientro in gioco (menu), oltre la grace breve. NebbieDash.GOLD_CHARGE_TTL_SEC = 1800
function NebbieDash.armGoldSpendExpected(reason, seconds) local sec = tonumber(seconds) or NebbieDash.GOLD_SPEND_GRACE_SEC or 3.0 local untilAt = os.clock() + sec if (NebbieDash._goldSpendExpectedUntil or 0) < untilAt then NebbieDash._goldSpendExpectedUntil = untilAt end NebbieDash._goldSpendReason = reason or NebbieDash._goldSpendReason end
function NebbieDash.goldSpendExpectedNow() local untilAt = NebbieDash._goldSpendExpectedUntil or 0 return os.clock() <= untilAt end
function NebbieDash.enqueueExpectedGoldCharge(amount, reason, ttlSec) amount = tonumber(amount) if not amount or amount <= 0 then return end local ttl = tonumber(ttlSec) or NebbieDash.GOLD_CHARGE_TTL_SEC or 1800 local entry = { amount = amount, reason = reason or "charge", expires = os.time() + ttl, } NebbieDash._expectedGoldCharges = NebbieDash._expectedGoldCharges or {} table.insert(NebbieDash._expectedGoldCharges, entry) -- Retrocompat: ultimo addebito anche in forma singola (rent/status). NebbieDash._expectedGoldCharge = entry end
function NebbieDash.noteExpectedGoldCharge(amount, reason, ttlSec) NebbieDash.enqueueExpectedGoldCharge(amount, reason, ttlSec) end
function NebbieDash.consumeExpectedGoldCharge(delta) delta = tonumber(delta) if not delta then return false end local now = os.time() local q = NebbieDash._expectedGoldCharges if type(q) == "table" then for i = #q, 1, -1 do local e = q[i] if not e or (e.expires and now > e.expires) then table.remove(q, i) end end for i, exp in ipairs(q) do if exp.amount == delta then table.remove(q, i) NebbieDash._expectedGoldCharge = q[#q] return true end end end local exp = NebbieDash._expectedGoldCharge if not exp or not exp.amount then return false end if exp.expires and now > exp.expires then NebbieDash._expectedGoldCharge = nil return false end if delta ~= exp.amount then return false end NebbieDash._expectedGoldCharge = nil return true end
function NebbieDash.resetGoldAlertBaseline(gold) NebbieDash._lastPromptGold = gold NebbieDash._goldAlertReady = (gold ~= nil) end
function NebbieDash.isVoluntaryGoldCommand(cmd) cmd = (cmd or ""):lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if cmd == "" then return false end -- togli eventuale prefisso di ripetizione tipo ".3 give ..." cmd = cmd:gsub("^%.%d+%s*", "") if cmd:match("^split%s+") or cmd == "split" then return true end if cmd:match("^nsplit%s+") then return true end -- give 100 coin bob / give 100 monet ... if cmd:match("^give%s+%d+%s+coin") or cmd:match("^give%s+%d+%s+monet") then return true end if cmd:match("^give%s+all%.?coin") or cmd:match("^give%s+all%.?monet") then return true end if cmd:match("^drop%s+%d+%s+coin") or cmd:match("^drop%s+%d+%s+monet") then return true end if cmd:match("^drop%s+all%.?coin") or cmd:match("^drop%s+all%.?monet") then return true end if cmd:match("^drop%s+coin") or cmd:match("^drop%s+monet") then return true end if cmd:match("^buy%s+") or cmd:match("^purchase%s+") then return true end -- Cassetta account (es. "account buy platino unico") — non inizia con buy. if cmd:match("^account%s+buy") or cmd:match("^account%s+purchase") then return true end if cmd:match("^offer%s+") or cmd:match("^bid%s+") then return true end if cmd:match("^asta%s+") or cmd:match("^auction%s+") then return true end -- rent: l'addebito reale arriva dopo il menu; vedi noteExpectedGoldCharge sulla riga pensione if cmd == "rent" or cmd:match("^rent%s+") then return true end if cmd:match("^deposit%s+") or cmd == "deposit" then return true end -- Sage / practice (prac learning = COSTO_PRAC 1e6, altre lezioni a pagamento) if cmd:match("^prac%s+") or cmd == "prac" then return true end if cmd:match("^practice%s+") or cmd == "practice" then return true end if cmd:match("^practise%s+") or cmd == "practise" then return true end -- Altri acquisti / spese volontarie (server) if cmd:match("^associa%s+") or cmd == "associa" then return true end if cmd:match("^associate%s+") or cmd == "associate" then return true end if cmd:match("^mail%s+") or cmd == "mail" then return true end -- Resurrect (magic2.cpp) costa oro al cast if cmd:match("resurrect") then return true end return false end
-- Importo da conferma pagamento (es. cassetta account): -- "Hai pagato 6.000.000 monete." function NebbieDash.parseHaiPagatoAmount(text) text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if text == "" then return nil end local raw = text:match("^Hai pagato ([%d%.,]+) monete") return NebbieDash.parseGroupedInt(raw) end
-- Importo offerta asta (auction.cpp + talk_auction Banditore). -- Server: "Un offerta di N monete e' stata ricevuta per ..." -- Linea reale: "[Il Banditore] 'Un offerta di 100 monete e' stata ricevuta..." -- (anche "Un'offerta" con apostrofo). Non ancorare a ^: c'e' il prefisso Banditore. function NebbieDash.parseAuctionBidAmount(text) text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if text == "" then return nil end -- Server: "Un offerta" (spazio); italiano corretto / display: "Un'offerta". local raw = text:match("Un'?%s*offerta di ([%d%.,]+) monete e' stata ricevuta") return NebbieDash.parseGroupedInt(raw) end
-- Importo da tell shopkeeper (shop.cpp message_buy / myst.shp). -- Es. "[Gwynyar] ti dice 'That'll be 3.750 coins, please.'" function NebbieDash.parseShopBuyGoldAmount(text) text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if text == "" then return nil end local raw = text:match("[Tt]hat'll be%s+%-+%s*say%s+([%d%.,]+)%s+coins") or text:match("[Tt]hat'll be%s+([%d%.,]+)%s+coins") or text:match("[Pp]er sole%s+([%d%.,]+)%s+monete") or text:match("[Ii]n totale fanno%s+([%d%.,]+)%s+monete") or text:match("[Ss]ono%s+([%d%.,]+)%s+monete") or text:match("sono solo%s*([%d%.,]+)%.?%s*monete") or text:match("[Pp]er%s+([%d%.,]+)%s+monete ti ho rifilato") or text:match("Derubato ancora una volta%.%.%. solo%s+([%d%.,]+)%s+monete") or text:match("Mia moglie mi bastonera'%.%.%.%.%.(%d[%d%.,]*)%s+monete") return NebbieDash.parseGroupedInt(raw) end
function NebbieDash.isVoluntaryGoldSpendLine(text) text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if text == "" then return false end if text:match("^Hai diviso ") then return true end if text:match("^Dai una moneta ") then return true end -- Importi con migliaia: "Dai 3.500 monete d'oro a Leoven..." (give oro) if text:match("^Dai [%d%.,]+ monete") then return true end -- Riparazione / servizi: "Dai a X N monete d'oro." if text:match("^Dai a .+ [%d%.,]+ monete") then return true end if text:match("^Posi una moneta%.%s*$") then return true end if text:match("^Posi alcune monete%.%s*$") then return true end if text:match("^Paghi [%d%.,]+ monete") then return true end -- Cassetta account / pagamenti: "Hai pagato 6.000.000 monete." if NebbieDash.parseHaiPagatoAmount(text) then return true end if text:match("^Hai pagato ") then return true end -- Conferma cassetta di sicurezza account (anche senza importo sulla stessa riga) if text:match("cassetta di sicurezza di account") then return true end if text:match("forziere di platino") or text:match("forziere di oro") or text:match("forziere di argento") or text:match("forziere di ferro") then return true end -- Asta: tell Banditore — vedi parseAuctionBidAmount if NebbieDash.parseAuctionBidAmount(text) then return true end -- Shop buy (EN/IT): tell del mercante — vedi parseShopBuyGoldAmount if NebbieDash.parseShopBuyGoldAmount(text) then return true end if text:match("^You now have ") then return true end -- Sage: acquisto sessioni practice (spec_procs2.cpp learning) if text:match("Adesso puoi imparare di nuovo") then return true end if text:match("Per te un prezzo di favore") then return true end -- Principe: associa vassallo (act.off.cpp) if text:match("Il che ti costa [%d%.,]+ monete") then return true end -- Resurrect (magic2.cpp) if text:match("Con un arcano rituale") then return true end -- Rent editor (pedit.cpp) if text:match("ho abbassato il costo d'affitto") then return true end -- Banca gilda (gilde.cpp) if text:match("contribuito alla prosperita' della gilda") then return true end if text:match("deposita [%d%.,]+ monete nelle casse della gilda") then return true end -- Slot machine (spec_procs2.cpp) if text:match("tira la leva della slot machine") then return true end if text:match("Gli slot cominciano a girare") then return true end -- Guildmaster: monete → XP (prac <numero>) if text:match("Hai scelto di usare: [%d%.,]+ monete") then return true end -- Posta (mail.cpp, messaggi spesso in inglese) if text:match("I'll take [%d%.,]+ coins for the delivery") then return true end if text:match("starts to write a note") then return true end -- Banca normale (spec_procs.cpp) if text:match("^La ringraziamo%.") then return true end if text:match("^Tassa applicata alla sua operazione:") then return true end return false end
function NebbieDash.parseRentPensionAmount(text) text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" -- reception.cpp: "Il conto della pensione e' di %ld monete." local raw = text:match("^Il conto della pensione e' di ([%d%.,]+) monete") return NebbieDash.parseGroupedInt(raw) end
function NebbieDash.onGoldSpendConfirmLine() local text = line or (type(getCurrentLine) == "function" and getCurrentLine()) or "" local auctionAmt = NebbieDash.parseAuctionBidAmount(text) if auctionAmt then NebbieDash.enqueueExpectedGoldCharge(auctionAmt, "auction", 120) NebbieDash.armGoldSpendExpected("auction", 30) return end local shopAmt = NebbieDash.parseShopBuyGoldAmount(text) if shopAmt then -- G: puo' aggiornarsi solo al prossimo comando/prompt (oltre 3.5s). NebbieDash.enqueueExpectedGoldCharge(shopAmt, "shop", 120) NebbieDash.armGoldSpendExpected("shop", 30) return end local paidAmt = NebbieDash.parseHaiPagatoAmount(text) if paidAmt then -- Cassetta account / pagamenti con importo esplicito. NebbieDash.enqueueExpectedGoldCharge(paidAmt, "hai-pagato", 120) NebbieDash.armGoldSpendExpected("hai-pagato", 30) return end if NebbieDash.isVoluntaryGoldSpendLine(text) then NebbieDash.armGoldSpendExpected("echo", 8) end end
function NebbieDash.onRentPensionLine() local text = line or (type(getCurrentLine) == "function" and getCurrentLine()) or "" local amt = NebbieDash.parseRentPensionAmount(text) if amt then -- Sopravvive al menu rent → rientro (grace a clock non basta). NebbieDash.noteExpectedGoldCharge(amt, "rent", NebbieDash.GOLD_CHARGE_TTL_SEC) end end
function NebbieDash.isDigCommand(cmd) local c = tostring(cmd or ""):gsub("[
]+$", "") c = c:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" return c:lower() == "dig" end
function NebbieDash.onDataSendRequest(_, cmd) do if NebbieDash.isDigCommand(cmd) and type(NebbieDash.digAutoActivateFromDigCommand) == "function" then NebbieDash.digAutoActivateFromDigCommand() end end local run = NebbieDash._swRun if run and run.status == "running" then local c = (cmd or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if c ~= "" and c ~= (run.lastSentCmd or "") then -- Controllo manuale durante la corsa → pausa (non i nostri send del motore). local low = c:lower() if low:match("^[neswud]$") or low:match("^[nesw][ew]$") or low:match("^enter ") or low:match("^apri ") or low:match("^open ") or low:match("^north") or low:match("^south") or low:match("^east") or low:match("^west") or low:match("^up") or low:match("^down") then NebbieDash.swRunPause("comando manuale: " .. c) end end end if NebbieDash.isVoluntaryGoldCommand(cmd) then local low = (cmd or ""):lower() -- rent: grace lunga di cortesia; l'importo preciso arriva dalla riga pensione if low:match("^%s*rent") then NebbieDash.armGoldSpendExpected("rent", 120) elseif low:match("^%s*buy%s+") or low:match("^%s*purchase%s+") or low:match("^%s*account%s+buy") or low:match("^%s*account%s+purchase") then -- Shop / cassetta account: G: spesso al prompt successivo. NebbieDash.armGoldSpendExpected("buy", 30) elseif low:match("^%s*bid%s+") or low:match("^%s*offer%s+") or low:match("^%s*asta%s+") or low:match("^%s*auction%s+") then NebbieDash.armGoldSpendExpected("bid", 30) else NebbieDash.armGoldSpendExpected("cmd", 3.5) end end end
function NebbieDash.readGmcpCharBase() if type(gmcp) ~= "table" then return nil end if type(gmcp.char) == "table" and type(gmcp.char.base) == "table" then return gmcp.char.base end if type(gmcp.Char) == "table" and type(gmcp.Char.Base) == "table" then return gmcp.Char.Base end return nil end
function NebbieDash.readGmcpCharBaseGold() local base = NebbieDash.readGmcpCharBase() if not base then return nil end local g = base.gold or base.Gold if g == nil then return nil end return tonumber(g) end
function NebbieDash.readGmcpCharBaseName() local base = NebbieDash.readGmcpCharBase() if not base then return nil end local n = base.name or base.Name if type(n) ~= "string" then return nil end n = n:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if n == "" then return nil end if not n:match("^[%a][%w_%-]*$") then return nil end return n end
function NebbieDash.onGmcpCharBase() -- Nome PG: affidabile al login da menu / riconnessione (anche se il prompt -- immortale e' senza %N, es. prompt #40/#41, o il trigger testo non scatta). local name = NebbieDash.readGmcpCharBaseName() if name then NebbieDash.setCurrentCharacter(name, false) NebbieDash._awaitingPromptAfterConnect = false end local gold = NebbieDash.readGmcpCharBaseGold() if gold == nil then return end NebbieDash._goldSeenVia = "gmcp" NebbieDash.checkGoldAlertFromPrompt(gold) end
function NebbieDash.hideGoldTheftBanner() if NebbieDash._goldAlertLabelTimer and type(killTimer) == "function" then pcall(killTimer, NebbieDash._goldAlertLabelTimer) end NebbieDash._goldAlertLabelTimer = nil local name = "NebbieDashGoldAlert" if type(hideWindow) == "function" then pcall(hideWindow, name) end if type(deleteLabel) == "function" then pcall(deleteLabel, name) elseif type(deleteWindow) == "function" then pcall(deleteWindow, name) end end
-- Banner floating centrato: l'avviso in coda al prompt si perde nel flusso. function NebbieDash.showGoldTheftBanner(prev, gold, delta) if type(createLabel) ~= "function" then return end NebbieDash.hideGoldTheftBanner() local name = "NebbieDashGoldAlert" local mw, mh = 1024, 768 if type(getMainWindowSize) == "function" then local ok, a, b = pcall(getMainWindowSize) if ok and a and b then mw, mh = a, b end end local w, h = 460, 78 local x = math.max(8, math.floor((mw - w) / 2)) local y = math.max(8, math.floor(mh * 0.12)) local okCreate = pcall(createLabel, name, x, y, w, h, 1) if not okCreate then return end if type(setLabelStyleSheet) == "function" then pcall(setLabelStyleSheet, name, [[ background-color: rgba(150, 18, 18, 235); border: 3px solid rgb(255, 210, 60); border-radius: 10px; font-size: 15px; font-weight: bold; color: white; qproperty-alignment: 'AlignCenter'; padding: 10px; ]]) end local body = string.format("MONETE SOTTRATTE!
G:%d → %d (-%d)", prev, gold, delta) if type(echo) == "function" then pcall(echo, name, body) end if type(showWindow) == "function" then pcall(showWindow, name) end if type(moveWindow) == "function" then pcall(moveWindow, name, x, y) end if type(resizeWindow) == "function" then pcall(resizeWindow, name, w, h) end if type(tempTimer) == "function" then NebbieDash._goldAlertLabelTimer = tempTimer(7, [[NebbieDash.hideGoldTheftBanner()]]) end end
function NebbieDash.announceGoldTheft(prev, gold, delta) -- Differito a fine tick: cosi' non resta attaccato in coda alla riga del prompt. local function paint() if type(moveCursorEnd) == "function" then pcall(moveCursorEnd, "main") end cecho("
") cecho("<red>########################################################
") cecho(string.format( "<yellow>[NebbieDash] <white>*** <red>MONETE SOTTRATTE <white>*** G:%d → %d <red>(-%d)
", prev, gold, delta)) cecho("<red>########################################################
") cecho("
") NebbieDash.showGoldTheftBanner(prev, gold, delta) if type(NebbieDash.playHighlightSound) == "function" then pcall(NebbieDash.playHighlightSound, "gold_loss") end -- Anche nella finestra chat, se aperta (piu' facile da notare). if NebbieDash.chatEnabled ~= false and type(NebbieDash.chatConsoleCecho) == "function" then pcall(NebbieDash.chatConsoleCecho, string.format("<red>[GOLD] sottratte: G:%d → %d (-%d)
", prev, gold, delta)) end end if type(tempTimer) == "function" then tempTimer(0, paint) else paint() end end
function NebbieDash.checkGoldAlertFromPrompt(gold) if NebbieDash.goldAlert == false then NebbieDash._lastPromptGold = gold return end if gold == nil then return end if not NebbieDash._goldAlertReady or NebbieDash._lastPromptGold == nil then NebbieDash.resetGoldAlertBaseline(gold) return end local prev = NebbieDash._lastPromptGold NebbieDash._lastPromptGold = gold if gold >= prev then return end local delta = prev - gold -- Morte: make_corpse azzera GET_GOLD (fight.cpp) → G:0. Non e' un furto. if gold == 0 then return end if NebbieDash.goldSpendExpectedNow() then return end -- Rent/pensione (o altri addebiti con importo noto) anche dopo menu/login. if NebbieDash.consumeExpectedGoldCharge(delta) then return end NebbieDash.announceGoldTheft(prev, gold, delta) end
function NebbieDash.printGoldAlertStatus() local on = NebbieDash.goldAlert ~= false cecho("<yellow>[NebbieDash] Allarme monete: <white>" .. (on and "on" or "off") .. "
") if NebbieDash._goldAlertReady and NebbieDash._lastPromptGold ~= nil then cecho("<grey>Ultimo G: monitorato: <white>" .. tostring(NebbieDash._lastPromptGold) .. "<grey> (via " .. tostring(NebbieDash._goldSeenVia or "prompt") .. ")
") else cecho("<orange>Nessun valore oro visto ancora.
") cecho("<grey>Serve <white>G:%g<grey> (o <white>g:%g<grey>) nel prompt, oppure GMCP attivo ") cecho("<grey>(il server manda <white>char.base.gold<grey> a ogni prompt).
") cecho("<grey>Esempio prompt: <white>prompt %N H:%h/%H M:%m/%M V:%v/%V x:%x G:%g >>
") end if NebbieDash.goldSpendExpectedNow() then cecho("<grey>Grace spesa volontaria attiva (split/give/drop/acquisto recenti).
") end end
function NebbieDash.cmdSetGoldAlert(argStr) argStr = (argStr or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"):lower() if argStr == "on" then NebbieDash.goldAlert = true elseif argStr == "off" then NebbieDash.goldAlert = false elseif argStr == "" or argStr == "status" or argStr == "stato" then NebbieDash.printGoldAlertStatus() cecho("<grey>Uso: ngoldalert <on|off|status>
") return else cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Uso: ngoldalert <on|off|status>
") NebbieDash.printGoldAlertStatus() return end NebbieDash.prefs = NebbieDash.prefs or {} NebbieDash.prefs.gold_alert = NebbieDash.goldAlert and true or false NebbieDash.savePreferencesFile() cecho("<green>[NebbieDash] Allarme monete sottratte: " .. ((NebbieDash.goldAlert ~= false) and "on" or "off") .. " <grey>(salvato).
") NebbieDash.printGoldAlertStatus() end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Loot (soldi dal cadavere) + split automatico col gruppo. -- Prima automazione di gioco (oltre a equip/spell/speedwalk), richiesta -- esplicitamente dall'utente con testi REALI copiati dal gioco (nessuna -- regex qui e' inventata): -- - `get all.coin corp` su un cadavere: 1 mucchio → "Prendi … da $p." + -- "C'erano N monete." (o "C'era una miserabile moneta."); ≥2 mucchi → -- una sola riga di riepilogo (NebbieArcane Server act.obj_get.cpp): -- "Raccogli da $p K mucchi di monete, TOT monete in tutto." -- (da terra: "Raccogli K mucchi di monete, TOT monete in tutto.") -- Gli altri in stanza vedono "$n raccoglie …" SENZA "in tutto" → no split. -- - `get all.coin pile` per non-morti ("pile of bones"), stessa dinamica. -- - `group` risponde "But you are a member of no group?!" da soli, oppure -- un blocco che inizia con `Your group "<nome>" consists of:` se in -- gruppo. -- - Fine combattimento (testo REALE fornito dall'utente il 2026-08-10): -- "Uno Spazzino is dead! R.I.P." seguito da "La tua parte di esperienza -- e' di N punti." (anche con N=0/1, sempre presente se hai contribuito -- al combattimento — usato come segnale per il loot automatico invece -- della riga "is dead!" perche' quest'ultima si vede anche per uccisioni -- altrui a cui non hai partecipato). -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- NebbieDash.autoSplit = true NebbieDash.autoLoot = true
function NebbieDash.stripColors(text) if not text then return "" end text = text:gsub("%$c%d%d%d%d", "") text = text:gsub("\27%[[%d;]*m", "") return text end
function NebbieDash.parseLootCoinAmount(text) text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text or "") text = text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" -- Echo stanza / tell: "Qualcuno C'erano …" o "$n raccoglie …" if text:match("^%S+%s+C'erano") or text:match("^%S+%s+C'era") then return nil end if text:match("^%S+%s+[Rr]accoglie") then return nil end -- Migliaia con . o , (stesso problema di exp 28.845): altrimenti autosplit -- non parte dopo get riuscito, es. "C'erano 60.000 monete." local raw = text:match("^C'erano%s+([%d%.,]+)%s+monete%.%s*$") if raw then return NebbieDash.parseGroupedInt(raw) end if text:match("^C'era una miserabile moneta%.%s*$") then return 1 end -- ≥2 mucchi nello stesso get (riepilogo server, senza riga C'erano): -- "Raccogli da il corpo di … 2 mucchi di monete, 60.000 monete in tutto." local _piles, total = text:match( "^Raccogli da .- (%d+) mucchi di monete, ([%d%.,]+) monete in tutto%.?%s*$") if total then return NebbieDash.parseGroupedInt(total) end _piles, total = text:match( "^Raccogli (%d+) mucchi di monete, ([%d%.,]+) monete in tutto%.?%s*$") if total then return NebbieDash.parseGroupedInt(total) end return nil end
function NebbieDash.isGroupSoloLine(text) text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text or "") return text:match("^But you are a member of no group") ~= nil end
function NebbieDash.isGroupHeaderLine(text) text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text or "") return text:match("^Your group .-consists of:") ~= nil end
-- Solo le due righe di fine combattimento reali (non "La tua parte e' di N monete" -- dello split altrui, achievement, ecc.). -- N puo' avere punti/virgole migliaia (es. "28.845") anche se il server sprintf -- usa %d: alcuni client/proxy o formati locali li mostrano raggruppati; senza -- [%d%.,]+ isCombatExpLine falliva e nautoloot non partiva (caso Sauron). function NebbieDash.isCombatExpLine(text) text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if text:match("^La tua parte di esperienza e' di [%d%.,]+ punti%.%s*$") then return true end -- Variante senza "punti" (fight.cpp) if text:match("^La tua parte di esperienza e' di [%d%.,]+%.%s*$") then return true end if text:match("^La tua esperienza e' aumentata di [%d%.,]+ punti%.%s*$") then return true end return false end
-- Segnale di fine combattimento: due formati REALI confermati dall'utente — -- "La tua parte di esperienza e' di N punti." (quota di gruppo) e "La tua -- esperienza e' aumentata di N punti." (uccisione in solitaria, testo -- fornito il 2026-08-10 con "Gwynyar is dead!"/"A mindflayer is dead!" ecc. -- — senza questo secondo shield l'autoloot non scattava affatto per le -- uccisioni in solitaria con questa frase). Entrambi sempre attivi (stesso -- principio degli altri trigger a riga singola). Fanno scattare `nloot` da -- solo se `nautoloot` e' attivo, cosi' non serve piu' digitarlo manualmente -- dopo ogni uccisione. function NebbieDash.onCombatEndLine() if not NebbieDash.autoLoot then return end local text = line or (type(getCurrentLine) == "function" and getCurrentLine()) or "" if not NebbieDash.isCombatExpLine(text) then return end NebbieDash.scheduleAutoLoot() end
