function NebbieDash.scheduleAutoLoot() local now = os.clock() if NebbieDash._lastAutoLootClock and (now - NebbieDash._lastAutoLootClock) < 0.6 then return end NebbieDash._lastAutoLootClock = now if NebbieDash._autoLootDelayTimer and type(killTimer) == "function" then pcall(killTimer, NebbieDash._autoLootDelayTimer) end -- Breve attesa: il cadavere compare spesso un attimo dopo la riga exp; evita -- get a vuoto e riduce i doppi invii se piu' trigger scattano sulla stessa riga. NebbieDash._autoLootDelayTimer = tempTimer(0.35, function() NebbieDash._autoLootDelayTimer = nil NebbieDash.cmdLoot() end) end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Rialzarsi da terra e recupero arma dopo un disarmo — richiesti esplicita- -- mente come "unico trigger di combattimento" che serve ora (2026-08-10), -- basati su testi REALI forniti dall'utente: -- - Caduta: "Illyari schiva il tuo urto. Inciampi e cadi per terra." → la -- parte fissa e' "Inciampi e cadi per terra." (il resto della frase -- varia in base a chi/cosa causa la caduta — l'utente segnala che -- questo e' SOLO UNO dei possibili messaggi di caduta: se ce ne sono -- altri andranno aggiunti quando forniti, non li invento). -- - Disarmo (arma a terra): "Ti disarmano e la Flamberga di Boris vola dalla tua presa." -- — get + wield dopo breve delay (oggetto caduto). -- - Disarmo (resta in mano, rune): es. "Ti disarmano e Nordagh, La rosa spinosa dei Noor ti sfugge -- dalle mani, ma le rune del luogo non la lasciano cadere." — solo wield (override da -- nebbie-item-keywords.txt se il nome in riga non coincide con le keyword MUD). -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- NebbieDash.autoStand = true NebbieDash.autoDisarmRecover = true
-- Parole italiane da scartare per ottenere le parole chiave dell'oggetto dal -- suo nome descrittivo (articoli, preposizioni semplici/articolate, -- congiunzioni). Elenco deliberatamente conservativo: in caso di dubbio è -- meglio lasciare una parola di troppo (il gioco la ignorerebbe comunque se -- non è un suo keyword) che scartarne una che serve. NebbieDash.ITEM_STOPWORDS = { ["il"] = true, ["lo"] = true, ["la"] = true, ["i"] = true, ["gli"] = true, ["le"] = true, ["un"] = true, ["uno"] = true, ["una"] = true, ["di"] = true, ["da"] = true, ["in"] = true, ["con"] = true, ["su"] = true, ["per"] = true, ["tra"] = true, ["fra"] = true, ["e"] = true, ["ed"] = true, ["a"] = true, ["ad"] = true, ["del"] = true, ["dello"] = true, ["della"] = true, ["dei"] = true, ["degli"] = true, ["delle"] = true, ["al"] = true, ["allo"] = true, ["alla"] = true, ["ai"] = true, ["agli"] = true, ["alle"] = true, ["dal"] = true, ["dallo"] = true, ["dalla"] = true, ["dai"] = true, ["dagli"] = true, ["dalle"] = true, ["nel"] = true, ["nello"] = true, ["nella"] = true, ["nei"] = true, ["negli"] = true, ["nelle"] = true, ["sul"] = true, ["sullo"] = true, ["sulla"] = true, ["sui"] = true, ["sugli"] = true, ["sulle"] = true, -- Forme troncate davanti apostrofo (l'apostrofo viene sostituito da uno -- spazio prima del filtro, quindi "dell'Infinito" arriva come due parole -- separate "dell" e "infinito"). ["l"] = true, ["d"] = true, ["dell"] = true, ["nell"] = true, ["sull"] = true, ["dall"] = true, ["all"] = true, }
-- Rimuove suffissi tra parentesi dall'eq (condizioni, alone luminoso, ecc.): -- non fanno parte delle keyword MUD per get/rem/wield. function NebbieDash.stripItemParentheticals(name) name = name or "" name = name:gsub("%s*%b()", "") name = name:gsub("%s+", " ") return name:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" end
-- Estrae le parole chiave "significative" da un nome oggetto descrittivo, -- scartando gli articoli/preposizioni sopra (anche nella forma con -- apostrofo, es. "l'Infinito" → "infinito"). Restituisce una stringa -- minuscola pronta per essere usata come argomento di `get`/`wield`. function NebbieDash.extractItemKeywords(name) name = NebbieDash.stripItemParentheticals(name) name = (name or ""):lower():gsub("'", " "):gsub("[%.,!]", "") local words = {} for word in name:gmatch("%S+") do if not NebbieDash.ITEM_STOPWORDS[word] then table.insert(words, word) end end return table.concat(words, " ") end
-- Shield su substring fissa (sempre attivo, riga singola, stesso principio -- degli altri trigger a riga singola di questo file). function NebbieDash.onFallLine() NebbieDash.swRunOnFail("caduta") if not NebbieDash.autoStand then return end send("stand", false) end
-- Parole chiave per get/wield dopo disarmo (nome preso dalla riga di gioco). function NebbieDash.resolveDisarmKeywords(weaponName) local override = NebbieDash.findItemKeywordOverride(weaponName) if override and override ~= "" then return override, true end local stripped = NebbieDash.stripItemParentheticals(weaponName):lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if stripped == "" then return "", false end -- Oggetti con articolo inglese (es. "the ebony kris"): tenere il nome intero. -- `get ebony kris` altrimenti e' interpretato come "prendi ebony dal contenitore kris". if stripped:match("^the ") or stripped:match("^a ") or stripped:match("^an ") then return stripped, false end return NebbieDash.extractItemKeywords(weaponName), false end
function NebbieDash.onDisarmLine() NebbieDash.swRunOnFail("disarmato") if not NebbieDash.autoDisarmRecover then return end local text = line or (type(getCurrentLine) == "function" and getCurrentLine()) or "" text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" local weaponName, wieldOnly weaponName = text:match("^Ti disarmano e (.-) ti sfugge dalle mani") if weaponName then wieldOnly = true else weaponName = text:match("^Ti disarmano e (.+) vola dalla tua presa%.?%s*$") wieldOnly = false end if not weaponName then return end weaponName = weaponName:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") local keywords = NebbieDash.resolveDisarmKeywords(weaponName) if keywords == "" then return end if wieldOnly then send("wield " .. keywords, false) else send("get " .. keywords, false) tempTimer(0.5, function() send("wield " .. keywords, false) end) end end
function NebbieDash.cmdSetAutoStand(argStr) argStr = (argStr or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"):lower() if argStr == "on" then NebbieDash.autoStand = true elseif argStr == "off" then NebbieDash.autoStand = false else cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Uso: nautostand <on|off> (attuale: " .. (NebbieDash.autoStand and "on" or "off") .. ")
") return end cecho("<green>[NebbieDash] Rialzarsi automaticamente da terra: " .. (NebbieDash.autoStand and "on" or "off") .. ".
") end
function NebbieDash.cmdSetAutoDisarmRecover(argStr) argStr = (argStr or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$"):lower() if argStr == "on" then NebbieDash.autoDisarmRecover = true elseif argStr == "off" then NebbieDash.autoDisarmRecover = false else cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Uso: nautodisarm <on|off> (attuale: " .. (NebbieDash.autoDisarmRecover and "on" or "off") .. ")
") return end cecho("<green>[NebbieDash] Recupero automatico arma dopo disarmo: " .. (NebbieDash.autoDisarmRecover and "on" or "off") .. ".
") end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Gestione armi: elenco persistente per personaggio, con tipo di danno -- (slash/blunt/pierce) e cambio con un click (2026-08-10). -- Testi REALI forniti dall'utente: -- - Impugnare: si presume "Impugni <nome arma>." (confermato dall'utente -- via risposta a scelta multipla "generic_wield", non con un copia-incolla -- letterale — se in gioco il testo risultasse diverso, va corretto qui). -- - `identify` (spell/comando che l'utente esegue lui stesso quando vuole, -- NON automatizzato: costa una "ondata di stanchezza", quindi non va -- scatenato in automatico ad ogni wield) risponde su piu' righe, dove le -- due che servono sono: -- Oggetto: 'spada elf slayer', Tipo di Oggetto WEAPON -- Tipo di danno: 'SLASH' -- (viste separatamente, senza bisogno di una capture multi-riga con -- inizio/fine: bastano due trigger a riga singola che si "passano" il -- dato tra una riga e l'altra). -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Vero se due parole chiave condividono almeno una parola (case-insensitive): -- usato per collegare la keyword vista al wield (euristica/override da -- nebbie-item-keywords.txt) con quella "canonica" riportata da `identify`, -- che nella pratica raramente coincidono parola per parola. function NebbieDash.keywordsOverlap(a, b) local wordsB = {} for w in (b or ""):lower():gmatch("%S+") do wordsB[w] = true end for w in (a or ""):lower():gmatch("%S+") do if wordsB[w] then return true end end return false end
function NebbieDash.findWeaponByKeyword(data, keyword) keyword = (keyword or ""):lower() if keyword == "" then return nil end for _, w in ipairs(data.weapons or {}) do if (w.keyword or ""):lower() == keyword then return w end end for _, w in ipairs(data.weapons or {}) do if NebbieDash.keywordsOverlap(w.keyword or "", keyword) then return w end end return nil end
-- Legge lo slot "impugnato" dal pannello equip gia' sincronizzato (nessuna -- chiamata aggiuntiva al gioco) e ne restituisce la parola chiave risolta, -- oppure stringa vuota se non impugni nulla o l'equip non e' sincronizzato. function NebbieDash.currentWieldedKeyword(data) if not data or not data.eqUpdated then return "" end for _, row in ipairs(NebbieDash.buildEquipRows(data)) do if not row.empty and row.location == "impugnato" then return NebbieDash.resolveItemKeywords(row.item) end end return "" end
function NebbieDash.eqItemNamesMatch(cachedItem, gameName) if not cachedItem or cachedItem == "" or not gameName or gameName == "" then return false end local a = NebbieDash.stripItemParentheticals(cachedItem):lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") local b = NebbieDash.stripItemParentheticals(gameName):lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") if a == b then return true end return NebbieDash.keywordsOverlap(a, b) end
-- Aggiorna la cache equip (da `eq`) senza rifare neq: usato su messaggi MUD di -- rem/wield/wear durante il cambio arma automatico. local function eqEntryLocationCanon(entry) if not entry then return "" end return (entry.location or ""):lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" end
function NebbieDash.patchCachedEqLocation(data, locationLabel, itemText) if not data or not data.eqUpdated then return false end data.eq = data.eq or {} local canon = (locationLabel or ""):lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") if canon == "" then return false end local canonLabel, orderIdx = nil, nil for idx, label in ipairs(NebbieDash.EQ_SLOT_ORDER) do if label:lower() == canon then canonLabel = label orderIdx = idx break end end if not canonLabel then return false end
local matchingSlots = {} for slot, entry in pairs(data.eq) do if eqEntryLocationCanon(entry) == canon then table.insert(matchingSlots, slot) end end table.sort(matchingSlots, function(a, b) return a < b end)
if itemText == nil or itemText == "" then for _, slot in ipairs(matchingSlots) do data.eq[slot] = nil end else local item = itemText:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") local preferSlot = (#matchingSlots > 0) and matchingSlots[1] or nil for slot, entry in pairs(data.eq) do if eqEntryLocationCanon(entry) == canon then data.eq[slot] = nil end end -- I numeri di slot in cache seguono l'output di `eq` del gioco (es. 16 = -- tenuto), non l'indice in EQ_SLOT_ORDER (16 = impugnato): non sovrascrivere -- un'altra posizione se l'indice canonico e' già occupato. local slotIdx = preferSlot if not slotIdx and orderIdx then local occupant = data.eq[orderIdx] if not occupant or eqEntryLocationCanon(occupant) == canon then slotIdx = orderIdx end end if not slotIdx then local maxK = 0 for slot in pairs(data.eq) do if type(slot) == "number" and slot > maxK then maxK = slot end end slotIdx = maxK + 1 if slotIdx < 1 then slotIdx = orderIdx or 1 end end data.eq[slotIdx] = { location = canonLabel, item = item } end data.eqUpdated = os.time() NebbieDash.saveStore() NebbieDash.refreshDashboard() return true end
-- Guard cambio arma / fame: evita che un "Smetti di usare <zaino>" in ritardo -- (dopo che _weaponSwapBusy e' gia' sceso) svuoti lo slot «sulla schiena» -- quando il wear e' gia' avvenuto o e' ancora in volo. function NebbieDash.beginWeaponSwapGuard(data) NebbieDash._weaponSwapBusy = true NebbieDash._weaponSwapGen = (NebbieDash._weaponSwapGen or 0) + 1 NebbieDash._weaponSwapBackItem = nil if data and data.eqUpdated then for _, row in ipairs(NebbieDash.buildEquipRows(data)) do if not row.empty and row.location == "sulla schiena" then NebbieDash._weaponSwapBackItem = row.item break end end end return NebbieDash._weaponSwapGen end
function NebbieDash.endWeaponSwapGuard(gen, restoreIfEmpty) if gen and NebbieDash._weaponSwapGen ~= gen then return end -- Chiude busy subito (nuovo `usa` permesso), ma lo stash resta finche' -- restoreIfEmpty=true: altrimenti onWearBackLine → end(..., false) azzera lo -- stash e un "Smetti di usare" in ritardo svuota «sulla schiena». NebbieDash._weaponSwapBusy = false if NebbieDash._hungerMacroPending and type(NebbieDash.runHungerMacro) == "function" then NebbieDash._hungerMacroPending = false tempTimer(0.35, function() NebbieDash.runHungerMacro() end) end if not restoreIfEmpty then return end local stash = NebbieDash._weaponSwapBackItem NebbieDash._weaponSwapBackItem = nil if not stash or stash == "" then return end local name = NebbieDash.currentChar if not name then return end local data = NebbieDash.getCharData(name) if not data or not data.eqUpdated then return end for _, row in ipairs(NebbieDash.buildEquipRows(data)) do if not row.empty and row.location == "sulla schiena" then return end end NebbieDash.patchCachedEqLocation(data, "sulla schiena", stash) end
function NebbieDash.shouldPreserveBackSlot(_itemName) if NebbieDash._hungerMacroBusy or NebbieDash._weaponSwapBusy then return true end -- Finche' resta lo stash del cambio arma, NON svuotare la schiena su rem: -- anche se il nome $p non matcha perfettamente la cache (eqItemNamesMatch). local stash = NebbieDash._weaponSwapBackItem if stash and stash ~= "" then return true end return false end
function NebbieDash.onStopUsingLine() local text = line or (type(getCurrentLine) == "function" and getCurrentLine()) or "" local itemName = text:match("^Smetti di usare (.+)%.%s*$") if not itemName then return end local name = NebbieDash.currentChar if not name then return end local data = NebbieDash.getCharData(name) if not data.eqUpdated then return end for _, row in ipairs(NebbieDash.buildEquipRows(data)) do if not row.empty and row.location == "impugnato" then if NebbieDash.eqItemNamesMatch(row.item, itemName) then NebbieDash.patchCachedEqLocation(data, "impugnato", nil) return end end end for _, row in ipairs(NebbieDash.buildEquipRows(data)) do if not row.empty and row.location == "sulla schiena" then if NebbieDash.eqItemNamesMatch(row.item, itemName) then -- Durante usa/fame il rem zaino non deve lasciare lo slot vuoto: il wear -- ripristina, e un rem in ritardo dopo il wear non deve ri-svuotare. if not NebbieDash.shouldPreserveBackSlot(itemName) then NebbieDash.patchCachedEqLocation(data, "sulla schiena", nil) end return end end end end
function NebbieDash.onWearBackLine() local text = line or (type(getCurrentLine) == "function" and getCurrentLine()) or "" text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text) local itemName = text:match("^Ti metti (.+) sulle spalle%.%s*$") if not itemName then return end local name = NebbieDash.currentChar if not name then return end local data = NebbieDash.getCharData(name) if not data.eqUpdated then return end NebbieDash.patchCachedEqLocation(data, "sulla schiena", itemName) if NebbieDash._weaponSwapBusy then NebbieDash._weaponSwapBackItem = itemName NebbieDash.endWeaponSwapGuard(NebbieDash._weaponSwapGen, false) end end
function NebbieDash.onWieldLine() local text = line or (type(getCurrentLine) == "function" and getCurrentLine()) or "" local weaponName = text:match("^Impugni (.+)%.%s*$") if not weaponName then return end local name = NebbieDash.currentChar if not name then return end local data = NebbieDash.getCharData(name) data.weapons = data.weapons or {} local keyword = NebbieDash.resolveItemKeywords(weaponName) local existing = NebbieDash.findWeaponByKeyword(data, keyword) if not existing then table.insert(data.weapons, { displayName = weaponName, keyword = keyword, type = nil }) NebbieDash.saveStore() NebbieDash.refreshDashboard() elseif existing.displayName ~= weaponName then existing.displayName = weaponName NebbieDash.saveStore() NebbieDash.refreshDashboard() end NebbieDash.patchCachedEqLocation(data, "impugnato", weaponName) end
-- Vedi nota sopra: aggiornata/creata solo quando l'utente esegue `identify` -- di sua iniziativa, mai in automatico. function NebbieDash.onIdentifyObjectLine() local text = line or (type(getCurrentLine) == "function" and getCurrentLine()) or "" local keyword, objType = text:match("^Oggetto: '([^']+)', Tipo di Oggetto (%S+)$") if not keyword then return end NebbieDash._pendingIdentify = { keyword = keyword:lower(), isWeapon = (objType == "WEAPON") } end
function NebbieDash.onIdentifyDamageLine() local pending = NebbieDash._pendingIdentify NebbieDash._pendingIdentify = nil if not pending or not pending.isWeapon then return end local text = line or (type(getCurrentLine) == "function" and getCurrentLine()) or "" local dmgType = text:match("^Tipo di danno: '([^']+)'") if not dmgType then return end local name = NebbieDash.currentChar if not name then return end local data = NebbieDash.getCharData(name) data.weapons = data.weapons or {} local entry = NebbieDash.findWeaponByKeyword(data, pending.keyword) if entry then entry.type = dmgType:lower() entry.keyword = pending.keyword -- la keyword di `identify` e' quella "canonica" riportata dal gioco: la preferiamo. else table.insert(data.weapons, { displayName = pending.keyword, keyword = pending.keyword, type = dmgType:lower() }) end NebbieDash.saveStore() NebbieDash.refreshDashboard() end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Archivio identify condiviso (profiles/ndashboard/nebbie-ident-db.lua) -- -- Ogni volta che un personaggio fa identify (spell o pergamena), il blocco -- "La conoscenza ti pervade: … Vieni sopraffatt…" viene catturato e salvato -- in un DB comune a tutti i profili Mudlet. Persistenza deferred/coalesced -- (tempTimer) per non lagare il gioco; i trigger catch-all (^) restano -- disabilitati fuori dalla cattura (stesso schema di eq/attrib). -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- NebbieDash.identDb = NebbieDash.identDb or { entries = {} } NebbieDash.IDENT_DB_SAVE_DELAY = 0.2 NebbieDash.IDENT_CAPTURE_TIMEOUT = 3 -- Hint fonte (spell/scroll) valido solo pochi secondi prima di "La conoscenza…". NebbieDash.IDENT_SOURCE_HINT_TTL = 8
function NebbieDash.identDbPath() return NebbieDash.configPath("nebbie-ident-db.lua") end
function NebbieDash.migrateIdentCedibileFlags() for _, entry in pairs((NebbieDash.identDb and NebbieDash.identDb.entries) or {}) do if entry.cedibile == nil and not entry.cedibileManual then NebbieDash.applyCedibileFromFlags(entry, entry.flags) end end end
-- Personaggi esclusi dall'archivio identify (default: Sirio, immortale batch). -- Non salvano identify, non compaiono in GUI/filtri, non entrano in sync; -- le entry gia' "di Sirio" vengono archiviate in Deleted. NebbieDash.IDENT_EXCLUDED_CHARS_DEFAULT = { "Sirio" }
function NebbieDash.identExcludedCharSet() local set = {} local raw = (NebbieDash.prefs and NebbieDash.prefs.ident_exclude_chars) or "" if raw == "" then for _, name in ipairs(NebbieDash.IDENT_EXCLUDED_CHARS_DEFAULT or {}) do set[tostring(name):lower()] = true end return set end for name in tostring(raw):gmatch("[^,]+") do name = name:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if name ~= "" then set[name:lower()] = true end end return set end
function NebbieDash.isIdentExcludedChar(name) name = tostring(name or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if name == "" then return false end return NebbieDash.identExcludedCharSet()[name:lower()] == true end
function NebbieDash.isIdentEntryFromExcludedChar(entry) if type(entry) ~= "table" then return false end if NebbieDash.isIdentExcludedChar(entry.lastCharacter) then return true end local by = entry.byCharacter if type(by) == "table" then local n, allEx = 0, true for who, _ in pairs(by) do n = n + 1 if not NebbieDash.isIdentExcludedChar(who) then allEx = false end end if n > 0 and allEx then return true end end return false end
-- Archivia entry identate (solo) da esclusi; toglie Sirio da byCharacter/possesso residui. function NebbieDash.purgeIdentEntriesFromExcludedChars() NebbieDash.identDb = NebbieDash.identDb or { entries = {} } NebbieDash.identDb.entries = NebbieDash.identDb.entries or {} local toArchive = {} for key, entry in pairs(NebbieDash.identDb.entries) do if type(entry) == "table" and NebbieDash.isIdentEntryFromExcludedChar(entry) then table.insert(toArchive, key) end end local archived = 0 for _, key in ipairs(toArchive) do local entry = NebbieDash.identDb.entries[key] if entry and not entry.archived then NebbieDash.archiveIdentEntry(key, "excluded-char", "exclude-char") archived = archived + 1 end end local scrubbed = 0 for _, entry in pairs(NebbieDash.identDb.entries) do if type(entry) == "table" then -- Non toccare entry gia' archiviate come excluded-char: restano -- riconoscibili (lastCharacter/byCharacter Sirio) e restano fuori sync. if entry.archiveReason == "excluded-char" then -- leave as-is else local changed = false if type(entry.byCharacter) == "table" then for who, _ in pairs(entry.byCharacter) do if NebbieDash.isIdentExcludedChar(who) then entry.byCharacter[who] = nil changed = true end end end if NebbieDash.isIdentExcludedChar(entry.lastCharacter) then entry.lastCharacter = "unknown" changed = true end local poss = entry.possession if poss and NebbieDash.isIdentExcludedChar(poss.character) then entry.possession = { status = "unknown", character = nil, at = os.time(), via = "exclude-char", from = poss.character, displaySeen = poss.displaySeen, } changed = true end if changed then scrubbed = scrubbed + 1 end end end end if archived > 0 or scrubbed > 0 then NebbieDash.scheduleIdentDbSave() end return archived, scrubbed end
function NebbieDash.copyIdentEntriesForSync() local out = {} for key, entry in pairs((NebbieDash.identDb and NebbieDash.identDb.entries) or {}) do if type(entry) == "table" and entry.archiveReason ~= "excluded-char" and not NebbieDash.isIdentEntryFromExcludedChar(entry) then local copy = NebbieDash.deepCopyTable(entry) if type(copy.byCharacter) == "table" then for who, _ in pairs(copy.byCharacter) do if NebbieDash.isIdentExcludedChar(who) then copy.byCharacter[who] = nil end end end if copy.possession and NebbieDash.isIdentExcludedChar(copy.possession.character) then copy.possession = { status = "unknown", character = nil, at = copy.possession.at, via = "exclude-char", from = copy.possession.character, displaySeen = copy.possession.displaySeen, } end if NebbieDash.isIdentExcludedChar(copy.lastCharacter) then copy.lastCharacter = "unknown" end out[key] = copy end end return out end
function NebbieDash.loadIdentDb() NebbieDash.ensureConfigDir() NebbieDash.identDb = NebbieDash.identDb or { entries = {} } NebbieDash.identDb.entries = NebbieDash.identDb.entries or {} local path = NebbieDash.identDbPath() if type(io.exists) == "function" and io.exists(path) then local loaded = {} local ok = pcall(function() table.load(path, loaded) end) if ok and type(loaded.entries) == "table" then NebbieDash.identDb = loaded NebbieDash.identDb.entries = NebbieDash.identDb.entries or {} NebbieDash.migrateIdentCedibileFlags() NebbieDash.purgeIdentEntriesFromExcludedChars() NebbieDash.repairManualWearSlotsOverflow() elseif ok and type(loaded) == "table" and loaded.objectName then -- file corrotto/parziale: ignora end end -- Riprendi slot da cache eq gia' nota (A), senza attendere un nuovo neq. -- (salta entry con wearSlotsManual — vedi syncIdentWearSlotsFromEqSlots). for _, data in pairs(NebbieDash.chars or {}) do if data and data.eq then NebbieDash.syncIdentWearSlotsFromEqSlots(data.eq) end end end
-- Il sync eq pre-1.16.13 poteva aggiungere slot a entry gia' taggate a mano. -- Il picker manuale imposta un solo slot: se manuale e N>1, tieni il primo. function NebbieDash.repairManualWearSlotsOverflow() local entries = NebbieDash.identDb and NebbieDash.identDb.entries if type(entries) ~= "table" then return 0 end local fixed = 0 for _, entry in pairs(entries) do if entry and entry.wearSlotsManual then local list = NebbieDash.identWearSlotsList(entry) if #list > 1 then entry.wearSlots = { list[1] } entry.wearSlotsSource = "manual" fixed = fixed + 1 end end end if fixed > 0 then NebbieDash.scheduleIdentDbSave() end return fixed end
function NebbieDash.saveIdentDb() if not NebbieDash.persistEnabled then return end NebbieDash.ensureConfigDir() NebbieDash.identDb = NebbieDash.identDb or { entries = {} } pcall(function() table.save(NebbieDash.identDbPath(), NebbieDash.identDb) end) end
function NebbieDash.flushIdentDbSave() NebbieDash._identDbSavePending = false NebbieDash._identDbSaveTimer = nil NebbieDash.saveIdentDb() end
function NebbieDash.scheduleIdentDbSave() if NebbieDash._identDbSavePending then return end NebbieDash._identDbSavePending = true if type(tempTimer) == "function" then NebbieDash._identDbSaveTimer = tempTimer(NebbieDash.IDENT_DB_SAVE_DELAY or 0.2, function() NebbieDash.flushIdentDbSave() end) else NebbieDash.flushIdentDbSave() end end
function NebbieDash.normalizeIdentObjectKey(name) return ((name or ""):lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")) or "" end
-- Chiave archivio senza suffisso #N (es. "mantello ...#2" → "mantello ..."). function NebbieDash.identBaseKeyFromKey(key) key = NebbieDash.normalizeIdentObjectKey(key) return (key:match("^(.-)#%d+$")) or key end
function NebbieDash.identAffectsSignature(affects) local parts = {} for _, a in ipairs(affects or {}) do local t = (a or ""):lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if t ~= "" then table.insert(parts, t) end end table.sort(parts) return table.concat(parts, " | ") end
-- Firma delle caratteristiche immagazzinate: stesso nome + stessa firma = stesso -- pezzo (upsert). Stesso nome + firma diversa = nuova entry con suffisso #2, #3… function NebbieDash.identStatsSignature(entry) if not entry then return "" end local function n(v) if v == nil then return "" end return tostring(v) end return table.concat({ n(entry.objectType):lower(), n(entry.flags):lower(), n(entry.vnumOriginario), n(entry.weight), n(entry.value), n(entry.rent), entry.rare and "1" or "0", n(entry.acApply), n(entry.damageDice):lower(), n(entry.damageType):lower(), NebbieDash.identAffectsSignature(entry.affects), }, "
") end
function NebbieDash.identStatsEqual(a, b) return NebbieDash.identStatsSignature(a) == NebbieDash.identStatsSignature(b) end
-- Cerca entry con stesso nome oggetto e stesse caratteristiche; altrimenti nil. function NebbieDash.findIdentEntryMatchingStats(parsed) if not parsed or not parsed.objectName then return nil, nil end local base = NebbieDash.normalizeIdentObjectKey(parsed.objectName) if base == "" then return nil, nil end for key, entry in pairs((NebbieDash.identDb and NebbieDash.identDb.entries) or {}) do local entryBase = entry.baseKey or NebbieDash.identBaseKeyFromKey(key) or NebbieDash.normalizeIdentObjectKey(entry.objectName) if entryBase == base and NebbieDash.identStatsEqual(entry, parsed) then return key, entry end end return nil, nil end
-- Alloca chiave: nome normalizzato, oppure nome#2, nome#3… se già preso da -- un pezzo con caratteristiche diverse. function NebbieDash.allocIdentDbKey(baseKey) baseKey = NebbieDash.normalizeIdentObjectKey(baseKey) local entries = (NebbieDash.identDb and NebbieDash.identDb.entries) or {} if not entries[baseKey] then return baseKey end local n = 2 while entries[baseKey .. "#" .. n] do n = n + 1 end return baseKey .. "#" .. n end
-- Parser completo del blocco identify (spell o pergamena). Accetta sia il -- formato mortale (senza V-Number) sia quello immortale/batch. function NebbieDash.parseIdentifyFull(lines) local entry = { objectName = nil, objectType = nil, flags = nil, vnumOriginario = nil, weight = nil, value = nil, rent = nil, rare = false, acApply = nil, damageDice = nil, damageType = nil, affects = {}, } for _, raw in ipairs(lines or {}) do local text = NebbieDash.stripColors(raw or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if text == "" then -- skip else if not entry.objectName then local n, t, v = text:match( "^Oggetto: '([^']+)', Tipo di Oggetto (%S+) V%-Number Originario: (%d+)%s*$") if n then entry.objectName, entry.objectType, entry.vnumOriginario = n, t, v else n, t = text:match("^Oggetto: '([^']+)', Tipo di Oggetto (%S+)%s*$") if n then entry.objectName, entry.objectType = n, t end end end if not entry.vnumOriginario then entry.vnumOriginario = text:match("V%-Number Originario:%s*(%d+)") end if not entry.flags then entry.flags = text:match("^L'oggetto e':%s*(.-)%s*$") if entry.flags then entry.flags = entry.flags:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") end end local w, val, rent = text:match( "^Peso:%s*([%d%.]+),%s*Valore:%s*([%d%.]+),%s*Costo di rent:%s*([%d%.]+)") if w then entry.weight = tonumber(w) entry.value = tonumber(val) entry.rent = tonumber(rent) if text:find("%[RARO%]", 1) then entry.rare = true end end local ac = text:match("^AC%-apply di ([%d%.]+)%.%s*$") if ac then entry.acApply = tonumber(ac) end local dice = text:match("^Dado di danno:%s*'([^']+)'") if dice then entry.damageDice = dice end local dmg = text:match("^Tipo di danno:%s*'([^']+)'") if dmg then entry.damageType = dmg end local aff = text:match("Ti puo' dare%s*:%s*(.-)%s*$") if aff and aff ~= "" then table.insert(entry.affects, aff) end end end if not entry.objectName or entry.objectName == "" then return nil end if not entry.objectType or entry.objectType == "" then return nil end return entry end
function NebbieDash.upsertIdentRecord(parsed, character, source) if not parsed or not parsed.objectName then return nil end if NebbieDash.isIdentExcludedChar(character) then return nil end local baseKey = NebbieDash.normalizeIdentObjectKey(parsed.objectName) if baseKey == "" then return nil end NebbieDash.identDb = NebbieDash.identDb or { entries = {} } NebbieDash.identDb.entries = NebbieDash.identDb.entries or {} local now = os.time() local key, existing = NebbieDash.findIdentEntryMatchingStats(parsed) -- Rename oedit: stesso vnum+stats ma nome diverso → riusa entry e tiene formerNames. if not key and parsed.vnumOriginario then for k, e in pairs(NebbieDash.identDb.entries) do if tostring(e.vnumOriginario or "") == tostring(parsed.vnumOriginario) and NebbieDash.identStatsEqual(e, parsed) then key, existing = k, e break end end end if not key then key = NebbieDash.allocIdentDbKey(baseKey) existing = {} end existing.key = key existing.baseKey = baseKey if existing.objectName and existing.objectName ~= "" and existing.objectName ~= parsed.objectName then existing.formerNames = existing.formerNames or {} local seen = false for _, n in ipairs(existing.formerNames) do if n == existing.objectName then seen = true break end end if not seen then table.insert(existing.formerNames, existing.objectName) end end existing.objectName = parsed.objectName -- Re-identify di pezzo archiviato → ripristina in Attivi. if existing.archived then existing.archived = false existing.archivedAt = nil existing.archiveReason = nil existing.archiveVia = nil end existing.objectType = parsed.objectType existing.flags = parsed.flags existing.vnumOriginario = parsed.vnumOriginario existing.weight = parsed.weight existing.value = parsed.value existing.rent = parsed.rent existing.rare = parsed.rare and true or false existing.acApply = parsed.acApply existing.damageDice = parsed.damageDice existing.damageType = parsed.damageType existing.affects = parsed.affects or {} existing.statsSig = NebbieDash.identStatsSignature(parsed) existing.lastAt = now existing.lastSource = source or existing.lastSource existing.byCharacter = existing.byCharacter or {} local who = character or NebbieDash.currentChar or "unknown" if who == "" then who = "unknown" end existing.lastCharacter = who existing.byCharacter[who] = { at = now, source = source or (existing.byCharacter[who] and existing.byCharacter[who].source), } -- Identify = pezzo di chi lo identa: sposta possesso anche se era di un altro toon. local prevHolder = existing.possession and existing.possession.character NebbieDash.setIdentPossession(existing, "held", who, "identify", nil, prevHolder) if prevHolder and prevHolder ~= "" and prevHolder:lower() ~= tostring(who):lower() and not NebbieDash.isIdentExcludedChar(prevHolder) then cecho(string.format( "<grey>[NebbieDash] Ident: <white>%s<grey> possesso <yellow>%s<grey> → <green>%s
", existing.objectName or key, prevHolder, who)) end NebbieDash.applyCedibileFromFlags(existing, existing.flags) NebbieDash.identDb.entries[key] = existing if NebbieDash._identUiCreated and not NebbieDash._identUiHidden then NebbieDash.refreshIdentUi() end return existing end
-- PROCAREA-REWARD → cedibile automatico (inventario trasferibile). Override -- manuale con nidentdb cedibile / noncedibile (cedibileManual). function NebbieDash.flagsHaveProcareReward(flags) return (flags or ""):upper():find("PROCAREA%-REWARD", 1, false) ~= nil end
function NebbieDash.applyCedibileFromFlags(entry, flags) if not entry then return end if entry.cedibileManual then return end entry.cedibile = NebbieDash.flagsHaveProcareReward(flags) and true or false end
function NebbieDash.setIdentCedibile(entry, cedibile, manual) if not entry then return nil end entry.cedibile = cedibile and true or false if manual then entry.cedibileManual = true end NebbieDash.scheduleIdentDbSave() return entry end
function NebbieDash.isIdentEntryCedibile(entry) return entry and entry.cedibile == true end
-- Normalizza il nome oggetto da messaggi give/drop (articoli, dall'/dell', …) -- per poterlo confrontare con la keyword da identify. function NebbieDash.normalizeIdentItemText(text) text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text or ""):lower() text = text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" text = text:gsub("^l'", ""):gsub("^un'", "") text = text:gsub("^il%s+", ""):gsub("^la%s+", ""):gsub("^lo%s+", "") text = text:gsub("^un%s+", ""):gsub("^una%s+", ""):gsub("^uno%s+", "") text = text:gsub("^gli%s+", ""):gsub("^le%s+", ""):gsub("^i%s+", "") text = text:gsub("dall'", " "):gsub("dell'", " "):gsub("all'", " "):gsub("nell'", " ") text = text:gsub("%sdal%s+", " "):gsub("%sdel%s+", " "):gsub("%sal%s+", " ") text = text:gsub("%sdei%s+", " "):gsub("%sdegli%s+", " "):gsub("%sdelle%s+", " ") text = text:gsub("%sdi%s+", " "):gsub("%sda%s+", " ") text = text:gsub("%s+", " ") return text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" end
function NebbieDash.identTokenSet(text) local set = {} for w in NebbieDash.normalizeIdentItemText(text):gmatch("%S+") do if #w >= 3 then set[w] = true end end return set end
function NebbieDash.identTokenCount(set) local n = 0 for _ in pairs(set or {}) do n = n + 1 end return n end
function NebbieDash.identTokenOverlapScore(a, b) local sa, sb = NebbieDash.identTokenSet(a), NebbieDash.identTokenSet(b) local n = 0 for w, _ in pairs(sa) do if sb[w] then n = n + 1 end end return n end
-- Score stretto: niente match su un solo token generico (es. "anello" → -- "anello varco…"). Richiede copertura alta sul set piu' corto. function NebbieDash.identMatchQuality(itemText, entryName) local needle = NebbieDash.normalizeIdentItemText(itemText) local hay = NebbieDash.normalizeIdentItemText(entryName) if needle == "" or hay == "" then return 0 end if needle == hay then return 100 end local sa, sb = NebbieDash.identTokenSet(needle), NebbieDash.identTokenSet(hay) local na, nb = NebbieDash.identTokenCount(sa), NebbieDash.identTokenCount(sb) if na == 0 or nb == 0 then return 0 end local score = 0 for w, _ in pairs(sa) do if sb[w] then score = score + 1 end end if score == 0 then return 0 end -- Un solo token nel messaggio: accetta solo se anche l'entry e' mono-token -- e coincide (altrimenti "anello" agganciava pezzi lunghi omonimi). if na == 1 then if nb == 1 and score == 1 then return score end return 0 end local shorter = math.min(na, nb) local need = math.max(2, math.ceil(shorter * 0.75)) if score < need then return 0 end return score end
-- Trova la migliore entry in archivio per un testo give/drop/eq. -- opts.onlyCedibile: solo entry marcate cedibili (give/drop automatici). -- opts.preferChar: preferisci possesso di quel PG in caso di parita'. function NebbieDash.matchIdentEntryByItemText(itemText, opts) opts = opts or {} local needle = NebbieDash.normalizeIdentItemText(itemText) if needle == "" then return nil, 0 end local preferChar = opts.preferChar and tostring(opts.preferChar):lower() or nil local best, bestScore, secondScore = nil, 0, 0 for _, entry in pairs((NebbieDash.identDb and NebbieDash.identDb.entries) or {}) do if NebbieDash.isIdentArchived(entry) and opts.includeArchived ~= true then -- soft-deleted: non matchano give/drop/destroy di default elseif opts.onlyCedibile and not NebbieDash.isIdentEntryCedibile(entry) then -- skip non cedibili else local score = NebbieDash.identMatchQuality(needle, entry.objectName or "") if entry.possession and entry.possession.displaySeen then local alt = NebbieDash.identMatchQuality(needle, entry.possession.displaySeen) if alt > score then score = alt end end for _, alias in ipairs(entry.formerNames or {}) do local alt = NebbieDash.identMatchQuality(needle, alias) if alt > score then score = alt end end if score > 0 then local preferBoost = 0 if preferChar and entry.possession and entry.possession.status == "held" and entry.possession.character and tostring(entry.possession.character):lower() == preferChar then preferBoost = 0.5 end local effective = score + preferBoost if effective > bestScore then secondScore = bestScore best, bestScore = entry, effective elseif effective > secondScore then secondScore = effective end end end end if bestScore < 1 then return nil, 0 end -- Ambiguita': due entry con score quasi uguale → non aggiornare in automatico. if secondScore > 0 and (bestScore - secondScore) < 0.6 then return nil, 0 end return best, math.floor(bestScore) end
function NebbieDash.setIdentPossession(entry, status, character, via, displaySeen, fromChar) if not entry then return nil end if status == "held" and NebbieDash.isIdentExcludedChar(character) then return nil end local now = os.time() local prev = entry.possession and entry.possession.character entry.possession = { status = status or "unknown", character = (status == "held") and character or nil, at = now, via = via, from = fromChar or prev, displaySeen = displaySeen or (entry.possession and entry.possession.displaySeen), } if status == "held" and character and character ~= "" then entry.byCharacter = entry.byCharacter or {} entry.byCharacter[character] = entry.byCharacter[character] or { at = now } entry.byCharacter[character].at = now end NebbieDash.scheduleIdentDbSave() return entry end
function NebbieDash.parseGiveLine(text) text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" local item, target = text:match("^Dai%s+(.+)%s+a%s+(%S+)%.%s*$") if not item or not target then return nil end return { item = item, target = target } end
function NebbieDash.parseDropLine(text) text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" local item = text:match("^Posi%s+(.+)%.%s*$") if not item then return nil end return { item = item } end
function NebbieDash.onIdentGiveLine() local text = line or (type(getCurrentLine) == "function" and getCurrentLine()) or "" local parsed = NebbieDash.parseGiveLine(text) if not parsed then return end local entry = select(1, NebbieDash.matchIdentEntryByItemText(parsed.item, { onlyCedibile = true, preferChar = NebbieDash.currentChar, })) if not entry then return end local fromChar = NebbieDash.currentChar or (entry.possession and entry.possession.character) NebbieDash.setIdentPossession(entry, "held", parsed.target, "give", parsed.item, fromChar) cecho(string.format( "<green>[NebbieDash] Ident: <white>%s<green> passato a <yellow>%s<green> (da %s).
", entry.objectName or parsed.item, parsed.target, tostring(fromChar or "?"))) end
function NebbieDash.onIdentDropLine() local text = line or (type(getCurrentLine) == "function" and getCurrentLine()) or "" local parsed = NebbieDash.parseDropLine(text) if not parsed then return end local entry = select(1, NebbieDash.matchIdentEntryByItemText(parsed.item, { onlyCedibile = true, preferChar = NebbieDash.currentChar, })) if not entry then return end local fromChar = NebbieDash.currentChar or (entry.possession and entry.possession.character) NebbieDash.setIdentPossession(entry, "ground", nil, "drop", parsed.item, fromChar) NebbieDash._identDropPending = { key = entry.key, objectName = entry.objectName, displaySeen = parsed.item, from = fromChar, at = os.time(), } cecho(string.format( "<orange>[NebbieDash] Ident: <white>%s<orange> → oggetto lasciato in terra (da %s).
", entry.objectName or parsed.item, tostring(fromChar or "?"))) cecho("<grey>Chi lo raccoglie? Digita <yellow>nidentdb hold <NomePg><grey> (es. <yellow>nidentdb hold Sirio<grey>).
") end
function NebbieDash.cmdIdentDbHold(charName) charName = (charName or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if charName == "" then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Uso: <yellow>nidentdb hold <NomePg><orange> — assegna l'oggetto lasciato in terra.
") return end local pending = NebbieDash._identDropPending if not pending or not pending.key then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Nessun drop in attesa. Fai un <white>drop<orange> di un oggetto già in archivio identify, oppure <yellow>nidentdb hold <oggetto> <NomePg><orange>.
") return end local entry = NebbieDash.identDb.entries and NebbieDash.identDb.entries[pending.key] if not entry then NebbieDash._identDropPending = nil cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Entry identify del drop non trovata più in archivio.
") return end NebbieDash.setIdentPossession(entry, "held", charName, "hold", pending.displaySeen, pending.from) NebbieDash._identDropPending = nil cecho(string.format( "<green>[NebbieDash] Ident: <white>%s<green> ora in possesso di <yellow>%s<green>.
", entry.objectName or "?", charName)) end
function NebbieDash.cmdIdentDbHoldExplicit(objectQuery, charName) objectQuery = (objectQuery or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" charName = (charName or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if objectQuery == "" or charName == "" then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Uso: <yellow>nidentdb hold <oggetto> <NomePg>
") return end local results = NebbieDash.searchIdentDb(objectQuery) if not results or #results == 0 then local entry = select(1, NebbieDash.matchIdentEntryByItemText(objectQuery)) if entry then results = { entry } end end if not results or #results == 0 then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Nessun identify per <white>" .. objectQuery .. "
") return end local entry = results[1] local fromChar = entry.possession and entry.possession.character NebbieDash.setIdentPossession(entry, "held", charName, "hold", objectQuery, fromChar) if NebbieDash._identDropPending and NebbieDash._identDropPending.key == entry.key then NebbieDash._identDropPending = nil end cecho(string.format( "<green>[NebbieDash] Ident: <white>%s<green> ora in possesso di <yellow>%s<green>.
", entry.objectName or "?", charName)) end
function NebbieDash.noteIdentSourceHint(source) if not source or source == "" then return end NebbieDash._identSourceHint = { source = source, at = os.time() } end
function NebbieDash.consumeIdentSourceHint() local hint = NebbieDash._identSourceHint NebbieDash._identSourceHint = nil if not hint or not hint.at then return nil end if (os.time() - hint.at) > (NebbieDash.IDENT_SOURCE_HINT_TTL or 8) then return nil end return hint.source end
function NebbieDash.onIdentSourceSpellLine() local text = line or (type(getCurrentLine) == "function" and getCurrentLine()) or "" text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text) if text:find("Pronunci le parole, 'identify'", 1, true) or text:find('Pronunci le parole, "identify"', 1, true) then NebbieDash.noteIdentSourceHint("spell") end end
function NebbieDash.onIdentSourceScrollLine() local text = line or (type(getCurrentLine) == "function" and getCurrentLine()) or "" text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text) if text:find("pergamena di identificazione", 1, true) then NebbieDash.noteIdentSourceHint("scroll") end end
function NebbieDash.isIdentFatigueLine(text) text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text or "") return text:match("^Vieni sopraffatt[oa] da un'ondata di stanchezza%.%s*$") ~= nil end
function NebbieDash.armIdentCaptureWatchdog(gen) if type(tempTimer) ~= "function" then return end tempTimer(NebbieDash.IDENT_CAPTURE_TIMEOUT or 3, function() local cap = NebbieDash._identCapture if not cap or NebbieDash._identCaptureGen ~= gen then return end if cap.activity ~= cap.watchedActivity then cap.watchedActivity = cap.activity NebbieDash.armIdentCaptureWatchdog(gen) else NebbieDash.finishIdentArchiveCapture() end end) end
function NebbieDash.startIdentArchiveCapture() if NebbieDash._identCapture then NebbieDash.finishIdentArchiveCapture() end NebbieDash._identCaptureGen = (NebbieDash._identCaptureGen or 0) + 1 local gen = NebbieDash._identCaptureGen NebbieDash._identCapture = { lines = {}, character = NebbieDash.currentChar or "unknown", source = NebbieDash.consumeIdentSourceHint(), activity = 0, watchedActivity = 0, startedAt = os.time(), } if NebbieDash._identLineTrig then pcall(enableTrigger, NebbieDash._identLineTrig) end NebbieDash.armIdentCaptureWatchdog(gen) end
function NebbieDash.onIdentKnowledgeLine() NebbieDash.startIdentArchiveCapture() end
function NebbieDash.onIdentArchiveLine() local cap = NebbieDash._identCapture if not cap then if NebbieDash._identLineTrig then pcall(disableTrigger, NebbieDash._identLineTrig) end return end local text = line or (type(getCurrentLine) == "function" and getCurrentLine()) or "" text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text or "") local trimmed = text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if NebbieDash.isIdentFatigueLine(trimmed) then NebbieDash.finishIdentArchiveCapture() return end if NebbieDash.isAnyPromptLine(trimmed) then NebbieDash.finishIdentArchiveCapture() return end if trimmed ~= "" then table.insert(cap.lines, trimmed) cap.activity = (cap.activity or 0) + 1 end end
function NebbieDash.finishIdentArchiveCapture() local cap = NebbieDash._identCapture NebbieDash._identCapture = nil if NebbieDash._identLineTrig then pcall(disableTrigger, NebbieDash._identLineTrig) end if not cap then return end local parsed = NebbieDash.parseIdentifyFull(cap.lines) if not parsed then return end -- Preferisci currentChar al momento della chiusura (switch PG mid-capture). local who = NebbieDash.currentChar or cap.character or "unknown" if NebbieDash.isIdentExcludedChar(who) then return -- Sirio/esclusi: non archiviamo identify end NebbieDash.upsertIdentRecord(parsed, who, cap.source) end
function NebbieDash.identDbEntryCount() local n = 0 for _ in pairs((NebbieDash.identDb and NebbieDash.identDb.entries) or {}) do n = n + 1 end return n end
function NebbieDash.searchIdentDb(query, opts) opts = opts or {} query = (query or ""):lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" local results = {} for _, entry in pairs((NebbieDash.identDb and NebbieDash.identDb.entries) or {}) do if NebbieDash.isIdentEntryFromExcludedChar(entry) and opts.includeExcluded ~= true then -- skip Sirio/esclusi elseif NebbieDash.isIdentArchived(entry) and opts.includeArchived ~= true then -- skip Deleted elseif query == "" then table.insert(results, entry) else local possChar = entry.possession and entry.possession.character or "" local possStatus = entry.possession and entry.possession.status or "" local hay = table.concat({ entry.objectName or "", entry.objectType or "", entry.flags or "", entry.vnumOriginario or "", table.concat(entry.affects or {}, " "), table.concat(NebbieDash.identWearSlotsList(entry), " "), entry.lastCharacter or "", possChar, possStatus, entry.possession and entry.possession.displaySeen or "", }, " "):lower() if hay:find(query, 1, true) then table.insert(results, entry) end end end table.sort(results, function(a, b) return (a.objectName or "") < (b.objectName or "") end) return results end
-- true se l'entry "appartiene" a charName per filtri UI/export. -- Con possesso held: conta SOLO il detentore attuale (re-identify sposta il pezzo). -- Senza possesso held: lastCharacter, poi (se includeHistory) byCharacter. function NebbieDash.identEntryMatchesCharacter(entry, charName, opts) opts = opts or {} if type(entry) ~= "table" then return false end charName = (charName or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if charName == "" then return true end local needle = charName:lower() local function nameHit(who) if not who or who == "" then return false end local w = tostring(who):lower() return w == needle or w:find(needle, 1, true) ~= nil end local poss = entry.possession if poss and poss.status == "held" and poss.character and poss.character ~= "" then return nameHit(poss.character) end if nameHit(entry.lastCharacter) then return true end if opts.includeHistory == false then return false end for who, _ in pairs(entry.byCharacter or {}) do if nameHit(who) then return true end end return false end
function NebbieDash.listIdentDbByCharacter(charName, opts) opts = opts or {} charName = (charName or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if NebbieDash.isIdentExcludedChar(charName) then return {} end local results = {} for _, entry in pairs((NebbieDash.identDb and NebbieDash.identDb.entries) or {}) do if NebbieDash.isIdentEntryFromExcludedChar(entry) and opts.includeExcluded ~= true then -- skip Sirio elseif NebbieDash.isIdentArchived(entry) and opts.includeArchived ~= true then -- skip elseif NebbieDash.identEntryMatchesCharacter(entry, charName, opts) then table.insert(results, entry) end end table.sort(results, function(a, b) return (a.lastAt or 0) > (b.lastAt or 0) end) return results end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Slot indossabili sull'archivio identify. -- L'identify del MUD non stampa wear_flags: impariamo dallo slot di `eq` -- (A) e/o da tag manuale in nidentui (B). -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Slot bilaterali (L/R) → un solo nome in UI/DB ident (dito, polso, orecchio). -- Accetta anche forme corte da filtro (`nidentui slot dito`). function NebbieDash.normalizeWearSlotLabel(loc) loc = tostring(loc or ""):lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" -- Apostrofo tipografico → ASCII (output Mudlet a volte differisce). loc = loc:gsub("’", "'"):gsub("‘", "'") if loc == "sul dito destro" or loc == "sul dito sinistro" or loc == "alle dita" or loc == "dito" or loc == "dita" then return "alle dita" end if loc == "al polso destro" or loc == "al polso sinistro" or loc == "ai polsi" or loc == "polso" or loc == "polsi" then return "ai polsi" end if loc == "all'orecchio destro" or loc == "all'orecchio sinistro" or loc == "alle orecchie" or loc == "orecchio" or loc == "orecchie" then return "alle orecchie" end return loc end
function NebbieDash.identWearSlotChoices() local seen, out = {}, {} for _, loc in ipairs(NebbieDash.EQ_SLOT_ORDER or {}) do local n = NebbieDash.normalizeWearSlotLabel(loc) if n ~= "" and not seen[n] then seen[n] = true table.insert(out, n) end end if NebbieDash.showClanSlot then local n = NebbieDash.normalizeWearSlotLabel(NebbieDash.EQ_SLOT_CLAN) if n ~= "" and not seen[n] then table.insert(out, n) end end return out end
function NebbieDash.identWearSlotsList(entry) if not entry then return {} end local out, seen = {}, {} for _, loc in ipairs(entry.wearSlots or {}) do local n = NebbieDash.normalizeWearSlotLabel(loc) if n ~= "" and not seen[n] then seen[n] = true table.insert(out, n) end end return out end
function NebbieDash.primaryIdentWearSlot(entry) local slots = NebbieDash.identWearSlotsList(entry) return slots[1] end
function NebbieDash.identEntryMatchesWearSlotFilter(entry, needle) needle = NebbieDash.normalizeWearSlotLabel(needle) if needle == "" then return true end for _, loc in ipairs(NebbieDash.identWearSlotsList(entry)) do if loc == needle or loc:find(needle, 1, true) then return true end end return false end
function NebbieDash.addIdentWearSlot(entry, location, source) if not entry then return false end -- Tag manuale: eq/resync non devono riaggiungere altri slot (dopo rebuild -- loadIdentDb richiamava sync eq e ripristinava i multi-slot). if entry.wearSlotsManual and source ~= "manual" then return false end local loc = NebbieDash.normalizeWearSlotLabel(location) if loc == "" or loc == "?" then return false end entry.wearSlots = entry.wearSlots or {} for _, s in ipairs(entry.wearSlots) do if NebbieDash.normalizeWearSlotLabel(s) == loc then return false end end table.insert(entry.wearSlots, loc) if source == "manual" then entry.wearSlotsManual = true elseif not entry.wearSlotsSource then entry.wearSlotsSource = source or "eq" end return true end
function NebbieDash.setIdentWearSlotsManual(entry, locations) if not entry then return end local out, seen = {}, {} for _, loc in ipairs(locations or {}) do local n = NebbieDash.normalizeWearSlotLabel(loc) if n ~= "" and not seen[n] then seen[n] = true table.insert(out, n) end end entry.wearSlots = out entry.wearSlotsManual = true entry.wearSlotsSource = "manual" NebbieDash.scheduleIdentDbSave() end
function NebbieDash.identItemMatchesEqText(ident, eqItemText) if not ident or not eqItemText or eqItemText == "" then return false end local key = NebbieDash.normalizeIdentObjectKey(ident.objectName or "") if key == "" then return false end local itemLow = tostring(eqItemText):lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if itemLow == "" then return false end if itemLow == key then return true end if itemLow:find(key, 1, true) or key:find(itemLow, 1, true) then return true end return NebbieDash.keywordsOverlap(itemLow, key) end
-- Dopo un eq riuscito: aggiunge agli identify matchati lo slot visto in equip. -- Salta entry con wearSlotsManual (il tag utente ha priorita'). function NebbieDash.syncIdentWearSlotsFromEqSlots(slots) if not slots then return 0 end NebbieDash.identDb = NebbieDash.identDb or { entries = {} } NebbieDash.identDb.entries = NebbieDash.identDb.entries or {} local added = 0 for _, eqEntry in pairs(slots) do local item = type(eqEntry) == "table" and (eqEntry.item or "") or tostring(eqEntry or "") local loc = type(eqEntry) == "table" and (eqEntry.location or "") or "" if item ~= "" and loc ~= "" then for _, ident in pairs(NebbieDash.identDb.entries) do if not ident.wearSlotsManual and NebbieDash.identItemMatchesEqText(ident, item) then if NebbieDash.addIdentWearSlot(ident, loc, "eq") then added = added + 1 end end end end end if added > 0 then NebbieDash.scheduleIdentDbSave() if NebbieDash._identUiCreated and not NebbieDash._identUiHidden then NebbieDash.refreshIdentUi() end end return added end
-- Incrocia nome identify con la cache eq dei personaggi (neq/nresync). function NebbieDash.findIdentEqHolders(objectName) local key = NebbieDash.normalizeIdentObjectKey(objectName) local holders = {} if key == "" then return holders end for charName, data in pairs(NebbieDash.chars or {}) do for slot, entry in pairs((data and data.eq) or {}) do local item = type(entry) == "table" and (entry.item or "") or tostring(entry or "") local loc = type(entry) == "table" and (entry.location or slot) or slot if item ~= "" then local itemLow = item:lower() if itemLow == key or itemLow:find(key, 1, true) or key:find(itemLow, 1, true) or NebbieDash.keywordsOverlap(item, key) then table.insert(holders, { character = charName, location = loc, item = item, slot = slot, }) end end end end table.sort(holders, function(a, b) if a.character == b.character then return tostring(a.location) < tostring(b.location) end return a.character < b.character end) return holders end
function NebbieDash.formatIdentDbEntry(entry, withHolders) if not entry then return {} end local lines = {} local variant = (entry.key or ""):match("#(%d+)$") local head = string.format("<yellow>%s<white> (%s)", entry.objectName or "?", entry.objectType or "?") if variant then head = head .. string.format(" <orange>#%s<white>", variant) end if entry.vnumOriginario then head = head .. " vnumOrig=" .. tostring(entry.vnumOriginario) end if entry.rare then head = head .. " <orange>[RARO]" end if entry.cedibile then head = head .. " <green>[cedibile]" elseif entry.cedibileManual then head = head .. " <grey>[non cedibile]" end table.insert(lines, head) if entry.flags and entry.flags ~= "" then table.insert(lines, " <grey>flags:<white> " .. entry.flags) end local stats = {} if entry.weight ~= nil then table.insert(stats, "peso " .. tostring(entry.weight)) end if entry.value ~= nil then table.insert(stats, "val " .. tostring(entry.value)) end if entry.rent ~= nil then table.insert(stats, "rent " .. tostring(entry.rent)) end if entry.acApply ~= nil then table.insert(stats, "AC " .. tostring(entry.acApply)) end if entry.damageDice then table.insert(stats, "dado " .. entry.damageDice) end if entry.damageType then table.insert(stats, "dmg " .. entry.damageType) end if #stats > 0 then table.insert(lines, " <grey>stats:<white> " .. table.concat(stats, ", ")) end if entry.affects and #entry.affects > 0 then table.insert(lines, " <grey>affects:<white> " .. table.concat(entry.affects, " | ")) end local wear = NebbieDash.identWearSlotsList(entry) if #wear > 0 then local tag = entry.wearSlotsManual and "manuale" or "eq/tag" table.insert(lines, " <grey>slot:<cyan> " .. table.concat(wear, ", ") .. " <grey>(" .. tag .. ")") end local when = entry.lastAt and os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", entry.lastAt) or "?" local src = entry.lastSource and (" (" .. entry.lastSource .. ")") or "" table.insert(lines, string.format( " <grey>ultimo ident:<white> %s%s <grey>@ %s", tostring(entry.lastCharacter or "?"), src, when)) local poss = entry.possession if poss then local pwhen = poss.at and os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", poss.at) or "?" if poss.status == "ground" then table.insert(lines, string.format( " <orange>possesso:<white> oggetto lasciato in terra <grey>(da %s @ %s)", tostring(poss.from or "?"), pwhen)) elseif poss.status == "held" and poss.character then local via = poss.via and (" via " .. poss.via) or "" table.insert(lines, string.format( " <grey>possesso:<white> %s%s <grey>@ %s", poss.character, via, pwhen)) end end if withHolders then local holders = NebbieDash.findIdentEqHolders(entry.objectName) if #holders == 0 then table.insert(lines, " <grey>in equip:<white> (nessun match nella cache eq — prova nresync)") else for _, h in ipairs(holders) do table.insert(lines, string.format( " <grey>in equip:<white> %s <grey>@<white> %s <grey>(%s)", h.character, tostring(h.location), h.item)) end end end return lines end
function NebbieDash.csvEscapeField(value) local s = tostring(value == nil and "" or value) if s:find('[,"
]', 1) then return '"' .. s:gsub('"', '""') .. '"' end return s end
function NebbieDash.identExportCsvPath(charName) local safe = (charName or "unknown"):gsub("[^%w%-_]", "_") if safe == "" then safe = "unknown" end local stamp = os.date("%d-%m-%Y-%H-%M-%S") return NebbieDash.configPath(safe .. "-" .. stamp .. ".csv") end
function NebbieDash.formatIdentEntryCsvRow(entry) local affects = table.concat(entry.affects or {}, " | ") local poss = entry.possession or {} return { entry.key or "", entry.objectName or "", entry.objectType or "", entry.flags or "", entry.vnumOriginario or "", entry.weight ~= nil and tostring(entry.weight) or "", entry.value ~= nil and tostring(entry.value) or "", entry.rent ~= nil and tostring(entry.rent) or "", entry.rare and "1" or "0", entry.acApply ~= nil and tostring(entry.acApply) or "", entry.damageDice or "", entry.damageType or "", affects, entry.cedibile and "1" or "0", entry.cedibileManual and "1" or "0", entry.lastCharacter or "", entry.lastSource or "", entry.lastAt and os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", entry.lastAt) or "", poss.status or "", poss.character or "", poss.via or "", } end
NebbieDash.IDENT_CSV_HEADER = { "key", "objectName", "objectType", "flags", "vnumOriginario", "weight", "value", "rent", "rare", "acApply", "damageDice", "damageType", "affects", "cedibile", "cedibileManual", "lastCharacter", "lastSource", "lastAt", "possessionStatus", "possessionCharacter", "possessionVia", }
function NebbieDash.cmdIdentDbSetCedibile(query, cedibile) query = (query or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if query == "" then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Uso: <yellow>nidentdb " .. (cedibile and "cedibile" or "noncedibile") .. " <oggetto>
") return end local results = NebbieDash.searchIdentDb(query) if not results or #results == 0 then local entry = select(1, NebbieDash.matchIdentEntryByItemText(query)) if entry then results = { entry } end end if not results or #results == 0 then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Nessun identify per <white>" .. query .. "
") return end if #results > 1 then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Query ambigua (" .. tostring(#results) .. " entry). Specifica meglio il nome.
") for i, entry in ipairs(results) do if i > 8 then break end cecho(string.format(" <grey>%s<white> %s
", entry.key or "?", entry.objectName or "?")) end return end local entry = results[1] NebbieDash.setIdentCedibile(entry, cedibile, true) cecho(string.format( "<green>[NebbieDash] Ident: <white>%s<green> ora %s.
", entry.objectName or entry.key or "?", cedibile and "cedibile (give/drop tracciati)" or "non cedibile")) end
function NebbieDash.exportIdentDbCsvForCharacter(charName) charName = (charName or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if charName == "" then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Uso: <yellow>nidentdb export <NomePg>
") return nil end local results = NebbieDash.listIdentDbByCharacter(charName) if not results or #results == 0 then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Nessun identify in archivio per PG <white>" .. charName .. "
") return nil end NebbieDash.ensureConfigDir() local path = NebbieDash.identExportCsvPath(charName) local f, err = io.open(path, "w") if not f then cecho("<red>[NebbieDash] Impossibile scrivere CSV: <white>" .. tostring(err) .. "
") return nil end local header = {} for _, col in ipairs(NebbieDash.IDENT_CSV_HEADER) do table.insert(header, NebbieDash.csvEscapeField(col)) end f:write(table.concat(header, ",") .. "
") for _, entry in ipairs(results) do local cols = NebbieDash.formatIdentEntryCsvRow(entry) local row = {} for _, c in ipairs(cols) do table.insert(row, NebbieDash.csvEscapeField(c)) end f:write(table.concat(row, ",") .. "
") end f:close() cecho(string.format( "<green>[NebbieDash] Export identify: <white>%d<green> righe → <yellow>%s
", #results, path)) return path end
function NebbieDash.cmdIdentDb(argStr) argStr = (argStr or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" local mode, rest = argStr:match("^(%S+)%s+(.-)%s*$") if not mode then mode, rest = argStr, "" end mode = (mode or ""):lower()
if argStr == "" or mode == "help" or mode == "?" then cecho("<green>[NebbieDash] Archivio identify: <white>" .. tostring(NebbieDash.identDbEntryCount()) .. "<green> oggetti in <white>" .. NebbieDash.identDbPath() .. "
") cecho("<grey>Uso: <yellow>nidentdb <query><grey> | <yellow>nidentdb where <query><grey> | <yellow>nidentdb char <nome>
") cecho("<grey> <yellow>nidentdb hold <NomePg><grey> | <yellow>nidentdb hold <oggetto> <NomePg>
") cecho("<grey> <yellow>nidentdb cedibile <oggetto><grey> | <yellow>nidentdb noncedibile <oggetto>
") cecho("<grey> <yellow>nidentdb del <oggetto><grey> | <yellow>nidentdb ui<grey> (= nidentui)
") cecho("<grey> <yellow>nidentdb export <NomePg><grey> | <yellow>nidentdbreload
") cecho("<grey>Give/drop aggiornano solo oggetti <white>cedibili<grey> (auto con PROCAREA-REWARD).
") cecho("<grey>Stesso nome + stesse stats/affects = aggiorna; stats diverse = nuova entry #2/#3…
") return end
if mode == "ui" or mode == "gui" or mode == "window" then NebbieDash.cmdIdentUi(rest) return end
if mode == "del" or mode == "delete" or mode == "rm" then NebbieDash.cmdIdentUi("del " .. (rest or "")) return end
if mode == "hold" then -- "hold Sirio" (drop pendente) oppure "hold mantello Sirio" (oggetto + PG). local objPart, charPart = rest:match("^(.+)%s+(%S+)$") if objPart and charPart and objPart:match("%S") then NebbieDash.cmdIdentDbHoldExplicit(objPart, charPart) else NebbieDash.cmdIdentDbHold(rest) end return end
if mode == "cedibile" then NebbieDash.cmdIdentDbSetCedibile(rest, true) return end if mode == "noncedibile" then NebbieDash.cmdIdentDbSetCedibile(rest, false) return end
if mode == "export" then NebbieDash.exportIdentDbCsvForCharacter(rest) return end
local results local withHolders = false if mode == "where" then withHolders = true results = NebbieDash.searchIdentDb(rest) elseif mode == "char" then results = NebbieDash.listIdentDbByCharacter(rest) else results = NebbieDash.searchIdentDb(argStr) end
if not results or #results == 0 then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Nessun identify in archivio per <white>" .. argStr .. "
") return end local limit = 25 cecho("<green>[NebbieDash] " .. tostring(#results) .. " identify" .. (#results > limit and (" (mostro i primi " .. limit .. ")") or "") .. ":
") for i, entry in ipairs(results) do if i > limit then break end for _, lineTxt in ipairs(NebbieDash.formatIdentDbEntry(entry, withHolders or mode == "where")) do cecho(lineTxt .. "
") end end end
function NebbieDash.cmdReloadIdentDb() NebbieDash.loadIdentDb() cecho("<green>[NebbieDash] Ident DB ricaricato: <white>" .. tostring(NebbieDash.identDbEntryCount()) .. "<green> oggetti (<white>" .. NebbieDash.identDbPath() .. "<green>).
") end
-- Mudlet getHTTP/postHTTP espongono il body solo se < ~10k caratteri: il pull -- e' quindi a pagine (/v1/ident?page=N). Il push manda tutto il DB locale e -- riceve un riepilogo compatto. Auth: Bearer token nelle preferenze. -- Comandi: nidentsync | nidentpull | nidentpush | nidentsync status|url|token -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- NebbieDash.IDENT_SYNC_PAGE_SIZE = 5 -- URL sync fissa (solo il token e' richiesto all'utente). NebbieDash.IDENT_SYNC_DEFAULT_URL = "https://nebbie.wizmorgan.it/nebbie-ident"
function NebbieDash.jsonEncode(value) if type(yajl) == "table" and type(yajl.to_string) == "function" then local ok, encoded = pcall(yajl.to_string, value) if ok and type(encoded) == "string" then return encoded end end return NebbieDash.jsonEncodePure(value) end
function NebbieDash.jsonDecode(text) if type(text) ~= "string" then return nil end if type(yajl) == "table" and type(yajl.to_value) == "function" then local ok, decoded = pcall(yajl.to_value, text) if ok then return decoded end end return NebbieDash.jsonDecodePure(text) end
function NebbieDash.jsonEncodePure(value) local t = type(value) if value == nil then return "null" end if t == "boolean" then return value and "true" or "false" end if t == "number" then return tostring(value) end if t == "string" then local s = value :gsub("\", "\\") :gsub('"', '\"') :gsub("
", "\n") :gsub("", "\r") :gsub("	", "\t") return '"' .. s .. '"' end if t ~= "table" then return "null" end local isArray = true local n = 0 for k, _ in pairs(value) do n = n + 1 if type(k) ~= "number" or k < 1 or math.floor(k) ~= k then isArray = false break end end if isArray then for i = 1, n do if value[i] == nil then isArray = false break end end end if isArray then local parts = {} for i = 1, n do parts[i] = NebbieDash.jsonEncodePure(value[i]) end return "[" .. table.concat(parts, ",") .. "]" end local parts = {} for k, v in pairs(value) do if type(k) == "string" then table.insert(parts, NebbieDash.jsonEncodePure(k) .. ":" .. NebbieDash.jsonEncodePure(v)) end end table.sort(parts) return "{" .. table.concat(parts, ",") .. "}" end
function NebbieDash.jsonDecodePure(text) local i = 1 local function peek() return text:sub(i, i) end local function get() local c = text:sub(i, i) i = i + 1 return c end local function skip() while text:sub(i, i):match("%s") do i = i + 1 end end local parseValue local function parseString() if get() ~= '"' then return nil end local out = {} while true do local c = get() if c == "" then return nil end if c == '"' then break end if c == "\" then local e = get() if e == "n" then table.insert(out, "
") elseif e == "r" then table.insert(out, "") elseif e == "t" then table.insert(out, "	") elseif e == '"' or e == "\" or e == "/" then table.insert(out, e) elseif e == "u" then local hex = text:sub(i, i + 3) i = i + 4 local code = tonumber(hex, 16) or 32 if code < 128 then table.insert(out, string.char(code)) else table.insert(out, "?") end else table.insert(out, e) end else table.insert(out, c) end end return table.concat(out) end local function parseNumber() local s, e = text:find("^-?%d+%.?%d*[eE]?[+-]?%d*", i) if not s then return nil end local n = tonumber(text:sub(s, e)) i = e + 1 return n end local function parseArray() get() -- [ local arr = {} skip() if peek() == "]" then get() return arr end while true do local v = parseValue() if v == nil and peek() ~= "n" then return nil end table.insert(arr, v) skip() local c = get() if c == "]" then break end if c ~= "," then return nil end skip() end return arr end local function parseObject() get() -- { local obj = {} skip() if peek() == "}" then get() return obj end while true do skip() local key = parseString() if not key then return nil end skip() if get() ~= ":" then return nil end skip() local val = parseValue() obj[key] = val skip() local c = get() if c == "}" then break end if c ~= "," then return nil end end return obj end parseValue = function() skip() local c = peek() if c == '"' then return parseString() end if c == "{" then return parseObject() end if c == "[" then return parseArray() end if c == "t" and text:sub(i, i + 3) == "true" then i = i + 4 return true end if c == "f" and text:sub(i, i + 4) == "false" then i = i + 5 return false end if c == "n" and text:sub(i, i + 3) == "null" then i = i + 4 return nil end if c == "-" or c:match("%d") then return parseNumber() end return nil end local ok, val = pcall(parseValue) if not ok then return nil end return val end
function NebbieDash.deepCopyTable(value) if type(value) ~= "table" then return value end local out = {} for k, v in pairs(value) do out[k] = NebbieDash.deepCopyTable(v) end return out end
function NebbieDash.identEntryLastAt(entry) if type(entry) ~= "table" then return 0 end return tonumber(entry.lastAt) or 0 end
function NebbieDash.mergeIdentByCharacter(a, b) local out = {} if type(a) == "table" then for who, info in pairs(a) do out[who] = NebbieDash.deepCopyTable(info) end end if type(b) == "table" then for who, info in pairs(b) do local cur = out[who] if type(cur) ~= "table" then out[who] = NebbieDash.deepCopyTable(info) elseif type(info) == "table" then if (tonumber(info.at) or 0) >= (tonumber(cur.at) or 0) then out[who] = NebbieDash.deepCopyTable(info) end end end end return out end
-- Merge una entry remota nella locale. Ritorna "inserted"|"updated"|"unchanged". function NebbieDash.mergeIdentEntryLocal(existing, incoming) if type(existing) ~= "table" then return NebbieDash.deepCopyTable(incoming), "inserted" end if type(incoming) ~= "table" then return existing, "unchanged" end local atEx = NebbieDash.identEntryLastAt(existing) local atIn = NebbieDash.identEntryLastAt(incoming) if atIn > atEx then local merged = NebbieDash.deepCopyTable(incoming) merged.byCharacter = NebbieDash.mergeIdentByCharacter(existing.byCharacter, incoming.byCharacter) return merged, "updated" end local merged = NebbieDash.deepCopyTable(existing) local before = NebbieDash.jsonEncodePure(existing.byCharacter or {}) merged.byCharacter = NebbieDash.mergeIdentByCharacter(existing.byCharacter, incoming.byCharacter) local after = NebbieDash.jsonEncodePure(merged.byCharacter or {}) if atIn < atEx then return merged, (before ~= after) and "updated" or "unchanged" end return merged, (before ~= after) and "updated" or "unchanged" end
function NebbieDash.mergeIdentDbFromRemoteEntries(remoteEntries) NebbieDash.identDb = NebbieDash.identDb or { entries = {} } NebbieDash.identDb.entries = NebbieDash.identDb.entries or {} local inserted, updated, unchanged = 0, 0, 0 if type(remoteEntries) ~= "table" then return inserted, updated, unchanged end for key, remote in pairs(remoteEntries) do if type(key) == "string" and key ~= "" and type(remote) == "table" then local existing = NebbieDash.identDb.entries[key] local merged, status = NebbieDash.mergeIdentEntryLocal(existing, remote) if type(merged) == "table" then merged.key = merged.key or key NebbieDash.identDb.entries[key] = merged end if status == "inserted" then inserted = inserted + 1 elseif status == "updated" then updated = updated + 1 else unchanged = unchanged + 1 end end end NebbieDash.purgeIdentEntriesFromExcludedChars() return inserted, updated, unchanged end
function NebbieDash.identSyncConfigured() local url = NebbieDash.prefs and NebbieDash.prefs.ident_sync_url or "" local token = NebbieDash.prefs and NebbieDash.prefs.ident_sync_token or "" url = (url or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" token = (token or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if url == "" or token == "" then return false, url, token end if not url:match("^https?://") then return false, url, token end url = url:gsub("/+$", "") return true, url, token end
function NebbieDash.identSyncHeaders() local ok, _, token = NebbieDash.identSyncConfigured() if not ok then return nil end return { ["Authorization"] = "Bearer " .. token, ["X-Nebbie-Token"] = token, ["Accept"] = "application/json", ["Content-Type"] = "application/json", } end
function NebbieDash.identSyncMaskUrl(url) return (url or ""):gsub("://([^/@]+)@", "://***@") end
function NebbieDash.identSyncBusy() return NebbieDash._identSync and NebbieDash._identSync.active and true or false end
function NebbieDash.identSyncAbort(msg) if NebbieDash._identSync then NebbieDash._identSync.active = false end if msg and msg ~= "" then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Ident sync: " .. msg .. "
") end end
function NebbieDash.ensureIdentSyncHttpHandlers() if NebbieDash._identSyncHttpHandlers then return end if type(registerAnonymousEventHandler) ~= "function" then return end registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysGetHttpDone", "NebbieDash.onIdentSyncGetDone") registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysGetHttpError", "NebbieDash.onIdentSyncGetError") registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysPostHttpDone", "NebbieDash.onIdentSyncPostDone") registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysPostHttpError", "NebbieDash.onIdentSyncPostError") NebbieDash._identSyncHttpHandlers = true end
function NebbieDash.identSyncIsOurUrl(url) local st = NebbieDash._identSync if not st or not st.base then return false end url = tostring(url or "") return url:find(st.base, 1, true) ~= nil end
function NebbieDash.startIdentSyncPull(mode) local okCfg, base, _token = NebbieDash.identSyncConfigured() if not okCfg then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Configura ident_sync_url e ident_sync_token " .. "(preferenze o nidentsync url|token).
") return end if type(getHTTP) ~= "function" then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] getHTTP non disponibile in questa Mudlet — aggiorna Mudlet.
") return end if NebbieDash.identSyncBusy() then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Ident sync gia' in corso.
") return end NebbieDash.ensureIdentSyncHttpHandlers() NebbieDash._identSync = { active = true, mode = mode or "sync", -- sync|pull|push base = base, page = 1, pages = nil, pullInserted = 0, pullUpdated = 0, pullUnchanged = 0, } cecho("<grey>[NebbieDash] Ident sync: pull da <white>" .. NebbieDash.identSyncMaskUrl(base) .. "<grey> ...
") NebbieDash.identSyncRequestPage(1) end
function NebbieDash.identSyncRequestPage(page) local st = NebbieDash._identSync if not st or not st.active then return end local url = string.format( "%s/v1/ident?page=%d&page_size=%d", st.base, page, NebbieDash.IDENT_SYNC_PAGE_SIZE or 5) st.expectGetUrl = url st.page = page local headers = NebbieDash.identSyncHeaders() local ok, err = pcall(getHTTP, url, headers) if not ok then NebbieDash.identSyncAbort("getHTTP fallita: " .. tostring(err)) end end
function NebbieDash.onIdentSyncGetDone(_, url, body) if not NebbieDash.identSyncIsOurUrl(url) then return end local st = NebbieDash._identSync if not st or not st.active then return end if st.expectGetUrl and tostring(url) ~= tostring(st.expectGetUrl) then return end local data = NebbieDash.jsonDecode(body or "") if type(data) ~= "table" or data.ok ~= true then NebbieDash.identSyncAbort("risposta pull non valida") return end local ins, upd, unc = NebbieDash.mergeIdentDbFromRemoteEntries(data.entries or {}) st.pullInserted = (st.pullInserted or 0) + ins st.pullUpdated = (st.pullUpdated or 0) + upd st.pullUnchanged = (st.pullUnchanged or 0) + unc st.pages = tonumber(data.pages) or st.page local page = tonumber(data.page) or st.page if page < (st.pages or page) then NebbieDash.identSyncRequestPage(page + 1) return end NebbieDash.scheduleIdentDbSave() cecho(string.format( "<green>[NebbieDash] Ident pull ok: +%d nuovi, %d aggiornati, %d invariati (pagine %d).
", st.pullInserted or 0, st.pullUpdated or 0, st.pullUnchanged or 0, st.pages or 1)) if st.mode == "pull" then st.active = false return end NebbieDash.identSyncStartPush() end
function NebbieDash.onIdentSyncGetError(_, err, url) if url and not NebbieDash.identSyncIsOurUrl(url) then return end if not (NebbieDash._identSync and NebbieDash._identSync.active) then return end NebbieDash.identSyncAbort("errore GET: " .. tostring(err)) end
function NebbieDash.identSyncStartPush() local st = NebbieDash._identSync if not st then return end if type(postHTTP) ~= "function" then NebbieDash.identSyncAbort("postHTTP non disponibile — pull fatto, push saltato") return end local okCfg, base = NebbieDash.identSyncConfigured() if not okCfg then NebbieDash.identSyncAbort("config sync assente") return end st.base = base st.active = true local url = base .. "/v1/ident/merge" st.expectPostUrl = url NebbieDash.identDb = NebbieDash.identDb or { entries = {} } local payload = { entries = NebbieDash.copyIdentEntriesForSync(), } local body = NebbieDash.jsonEncode(payload) if type(body) ~= "string" or body == "" then NebbieDash.identSyncAbort("serializzazione JSON fallita") return end cecho("<grey>[NebbieDash] Ident sync: push (" .. tostring(NebbieDash.identDbEntryCount()) .. " oggetti)...
") local headers = NebbieDash.identSyncHeaders() local ok, err = pcall(postHTTP, body, url, headers) if not ok then NebbieDash.identSyncAbort("postHTTP fallita: " .. tostring(err)) end end
function NebbieDash.onIdentSyncPostDone(_, url, body) if not NebbieDash.identSyncIsOurUrl(url) then return end local st = NebbieDash._identSync if not st or not st.active then return end if st.expectPostUrl and tostring(url) ~= tostring(st.expectPostUrl) then return end local data = NebbieDash.jsonDecode(body or "") st.active = false if type(data) ~= "table" or data.ok ~= true then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Ident push: risposta non valida.
") return end cecho(string.format( "<green>[NebbieDash] Ident push ok: +%d / ~%d / =%d — totale hub %d.
", tonumber(data.inserted) or 0, tonumber(data.updated) or 0, tonumber(data.unchanged) or 0, tonumber(data.total) or 0)) NebbieDash.prefs = NebbieDash.prefs or {} NebbieDash.prefs.ident_sync_last_ok = os.time() -- non riscriviamo il token in chiaro oltre al file preferenze gia' esistente end
function NebbieDash.onIdentSyncPostError(_, err, url) if url and not NebbieDash.identSyncIsOurUrl(url) then return end if not (NebbieDash._identSync and NebbieDash._identSync.active) then return end NebbieDash.identSyncAbort("errore POST: " .. tostring(err)) end
function NebbieDash.cmdIdentSync(argStr) argStr = (argStr or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" local mode, rest = argStr:match("^(%S+)%s*(.-)%s*$") mode = (mode or ""):lower() rest = rest or "" if mode == "" or mode == "sync" or mode == "full" then NebbieDash.startIdentSyncPull("sync") return end if mode == "pull" then NebbieDash.startIdentSyncPull("pull") return end if mode == "push" then if NebbieDash.identSyncBusy() then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Ident sync gia' in corso.
