") return end local okCfg = NebbieDash.identSyncConfigured() if not okCfg then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Configura ident_sync_url e ident_sync_token.
") return end NebbieDash.ensureIdentSyncHttpHandlers() local ok, base = NebbieDash.identSyncConfigured() NebbieDash._identSync = { active = true, mode = "push", base = base } NebbieDash.identSyncStartPush() return end if mode == "status" or mode == "info" then local ok, url = NebbieDash.identSyncConfigured() local showUrl = url if not showUrl or showUrl == "" then showUrl = (NebbieDash.prefs and NebbieDash.prefs.ident_sync_url) or NebbieDash.IDENT_SYNC_DEFAULT_URL or "https://nebbie.wizmorgan.it/nebbie-ident" end cecho("<green>[NebbieDash] Ident sync URL: <white>" .. NebbieDash.identSyncMaskUrl(showUrl) .. (ok and "" or " <grey>(token mancante)") .. "
") cecho("<grey>Token: <white>" .. ((NebbieDash.prefs and NebbieDash.prefs.ident_sync_token or "") ~= "" and "impostato" or "mancante") .. "<grey> — on_boot: <white>" .. ((NebbieDash.prefs and NebbieDash.prefs.ident_sync_on_boot) and "on" or "off") .. "<grey> — skip_prompt: <white>" .. ((NebbieDash.prefs and NebbieDash.prefs.ident_sync_skip_prompt) and "on" or "off") .. "
") if NebbieDash.identSyncBusy() then cecho("<yellow>Stato: sync in corso.
") end return end if mode == "url" then if rest == "" then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Uso: nidentsync url <https://host[/prefisso]>
") return end rest = rest:gsub("/+$", "") if not rest:match("^https?://") then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] URL deve iniziare con http:// o https://
") return end NebbieDash.prefs = NebbieDash.prefs or {} NebbieDash.prefs.ident_sync_url = rest NebbieDash.savePreferencesFile() cecho("<green>[NebbieDash] ident_sync_url salvato: <white>" .. NebbieDash.identSyncMaskUrl(rest) .. "
") return end if mode == "token" then if rest == "" then NebbieDash.promptIdentSyncTokenSetup(true) return end NebbieDash.applyIdentSyncToken(rest) return end if mode == "skip" or mode == "later" or mode == "dopo" then NebbieDash.prefs = NebbieDash.prefs or {} NebbieDash.prefs.ident_sync_skip_prompt = true NebbieDash.savePreferencesFile() cecho("<grey>[NebbieDash] Ok: non ripropongo il setup sync all'avvio. " .. "Quando vuoi: <yellow>nidentsync token <segreto>
") return end if mode == "setup" or mode == "prompt" then NebbieDash.prefs = NebbieDash.prefs or {} NebbieDash.prefs.ident_sync_skip_prompt = false NebbieDash.promptIdentSyncTokenSetup(true) return end if mode == "onboot" or mode == "boot" then local v = rest:lower() if v ~= "on" and v ~= "off" then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Uso: nidentsync onboot <on|off>
") return end NebbieDash.prefs = NebbieDash.prefs or {} NebbieDash.prefs.ident_sync_on_boot = (v == "on") NebbieDash.savePreferencesFile() cecho("<green>[NebbieDash] ident_sync_on_boot = " .. v .. "
") return end cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Uso: nidentsync [sync|pull|push|status|token …|skip|setup|onboot on|off]
") end

-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Sync file di configurazione ndashboard (stesso hub/token degli ident). -- Merge **additivo**: aggiunge chiavi/righe mancanti, non sovrascrive valori -- gia' presenti (ne' in locale ne' sull'hub). -- Comandi: ncfgsync | ncfgpull | ncfgpush | ncfgsync status|list -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- NebbieDash.CFG_SYNC_PAGE_SIZE = 40
-- Catalogo file syncabili. kind: -- kv_eq → "key = value" (shortcuts, sounds-like) -- kv_colon → "Name: rest" (hunger, item-keywords) -- lines → una riga = un entry (speedwalks, cast-spells) -- dig_loot → "keep|exclude|drop keyword" -- prefs → preferenze whitelist (mai token) NebbieDash.CFG_SYNC_FILES = { { name = "nebbie-spell-shortcuts.txt", kind = "kv_eq", reload = function() if type(NebbieDash.loadSpellCastConfig) == "function" then NebbieDash.loadSpellCastConfig() end end, }, { name = "nebbie-cast-spells.txt", kind = "lines", reload = function() if type(NebbieDash.loadSpellCastConfig) == "function" then NebbieDash.loadSpellCastConfig() end end, }, { name = "nebbie-speedwalks.txt", kind = "lines", reload = function() if type(NebbieDash.loadSpeedwalks) == "function" then NebbieDash.loadSpeedwalks() end if NebbieDash._swUiVisible and type(NebbieDash.showSwUiWindow) == "function" then pcall(NebbieDash.showSwUiWindow) end end, }, { name = "nebbie-hunger-macros.txt", kind = "kv_colon", reload = function() if type(NebbieDash.loadHungerMacros) == "function" then NebbieDash.loadHungerMacros() end end, }, { name = "nebbie-item-keywords.txt", kind = "kv_colon", reload = function() if type(NebbieDash.loadItemKeywords) == "function" then NebbieDash.loadItemKeywords() end end, }, { name = "nebbie-dig-loot.txt", kind = "dig_loot", reload = function() if type(NebbieDash.loadDigLootRules) == "function" then NebbieDash.loadDigLootRules() end end, }, { name = "nebbie-dash-preferences.txt", kind = "prefs", reload = function() if type(NebbieDash.loadPreferences) == "function" then NebbieDash.loadPreferences() end end, }, { name = "nebbie-batch-commands.txt", kind = "lines", }, { name = "nebbie-ident-batch-commands.txt", kind = "lines", }, { name = "nebbie-batch-items.csv", kind = "lines", }, }
NebbieDash.CFG_SYNC_PREFS_KEYS = { dig_tool = true, dig_combat = true, dig_retry_sec = true, text_highlights = true, chat_window = true, gold_alert = true, weapon_swap_delay = true, sanity_neq_on_login = true, sidebar_mode = true, ident_exclude_chars = true, ident_sync_on_boot = true, auto_install_convert_to_userwindow = true, }
function NebbieDash.cfgSyncSpecByName(name) for _, spec in ipairs(NebbieDash.CFG_SYNC_FILES or {}) do if spec.name == name then return spec end end return nil end
function NebbieDash.cfgSyncReadDataLines(path) local lines = {} local f = io.open(path, "r") if not f then return lines end for raw in f:lines() do table.insert(lines, raw) end f:close() return lines end
function NebbieDash.cfgSyncExportEntries(spec) local path = NebbieDash.configPath(spec.name) local entries = {} local lines = NebbieDash.cfgSyncReadDataLines(path) if spec.kind == "kv_eq" then for _, raw in ipairs(lines) do local line2 = raw:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if line2 ~= "" and line2:sub(1, 1) ~= "#" then local key, val = NebbieDash.parseSpellShortcutLine(line2) if key and val and key ~= "" then local lk = key:lower() if not entries[lk] then entries[lk] = key .. " = " .. val end end end end elseif spec.kind == "kv_colon" then for _, raw in ipairs(lines) do local line2 = raw:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if line2 ~= "" and line2:sub(1, 1) ~= "#" then local name, rest = line2:match("^([^:]+):%s*(.+)$") if name and rest then name = name:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") rest = rest:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") local lk = name:lower() if lk ~= "" and not entries[lk] then entries[lk] = name .. ": " .. rest end end end end elseif spec.kind == "dig_loot" then for _, raw in ipairs(lines) do local kind, kw = NebbieDash.parseDigLootLine(raw) if kind and kw then local key = kind .. "|" .. kw:lower() if not entries[key] then entries[key] = kind .. " " .. kw end end end elseif spec.kind == "prefs" then for _, raw in ipairs(lines) do local line2 = raw:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if line2 ~= "" and line2:sub(1, 1) ~= "#" then local k, v = line2:match("^([%w_]+)%s*=%s*(.-)%s*$") if k and NebbieDash.CFG_SYNC_PREFS_KEYS[k] then entries[k] = k .. " = " .. tostring(v) end end end else -- lines for _, raw in ipairs(lines) do local line2 = raw:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if line2 ~= "" and line2:sub(1, 1) ~= "#" then local key = line2:lower() if not entries[key] then entries[key] = line2 end end end end return entries end
function NebbieDash.cfgSyncLocalKeys(spec) local keys = {} for k, _ in pairs(NebbieDash.cfgSyncExportEntries(spec)) do keys[k] = true end return keys end
-- Aggiunge in coda al file solo le righe le cui chiavi non esistono gia'. function NebbieDash.cfgSyncAppendMissing(spec, remoteEntries) if type(remoteEntries) ~= "table" then return 0 end local path = NebbieDash.configPath(spec.name) NebbieDash.ensureConfigDir() local existing = NebbieDash.cfgSyncLocalKeys(spec) local toAdd = {} for key, line in pairs(remoteEntries) do if type(key) == "string" and key ~= "" and type(line) == "string" and line ~= "" then if not existing[key] then table.insert(toAdd, { key = key, line = line }) end end end table.sort(toAdd, function(a, b) return a.key < b.key end) if #toAdd == 0 then return 0 end -- Assicura file esistente (scheletro default se manca). if spec.name == "nebbie-dig-loot.txt" and type(NebbieDash.ensureDigLootFile) == "function" then NebbieDash.ensureDigLootFile() elseif spec.name == "nebbie-spell-shortcuts.txt" then NebbieDash.ensureSpellShortcutsFile() elseif spec.name == "nebbie-cast-spells.txt" then NebbieDash.ensureCastSpellsFile() elseif spec.name == "nebbie-speedwalks.txt" and type(NebbieDash.ensureSpeedwalkFile) == "function" then NebbieDash.ensureSpeedwalkFile() elseif spec.name == "nebbie-hunger-macros.txt" then NebbieDash.ensureHungerMacrosFile() elseif spec.name == "nebbie-item-keywords.txt" then NebbieDash.ensureItemKeywordsFile() elseif spec.name == "nebbie-dash-preferences.txt" then NebbieDash.ensurePreferencesFile() end local f = io.open(path, "a") if not f then return 0 end f:write("
# --- sync hub " .. os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") .. " ---
") for _, row in ipairs(toAdd) do f:write(row.line .. "
") existing[row.key] = true end f:close() return #toAdd end
function NebbieDash.cfgSyncBusy() return NebbieDash._cfgSync and NebbieDash._cfgSync.active and true or false end
function NebbieDash.cfgSyncAbort(msg) if NebbieDash._cfgSync then NebbieDash._cfgSync.active = false end if msg and msg ~= "" then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Config sync: " .. msg .. "
") end end
function NebbieDash.ensureCfgSyncHttpHandlers() if NebbieDash._cfgSyncHttpHandlers then return end if type(registerAnonymousEventHandler) ~= "function" then return end registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysGetHttpDone", "NebbieDash.onCfgSyncGetDone") registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysGetHttpError", "NebbieDash.onCfgSyncGetError") registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysPostHttpDone", "NebbieDash.onCfgSyncPostDone") registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysPostHttpError", "NebbieDash.onCfgSyncPostError") NebbieDash._cfgSyncHttpHandlers = true end
function NebbieDash.cfgSyncIsOurUrl(url) local st = NebbieDash._cfgSync if not st or not st.base then return false end url = tostring(url or "") return url:find(st.base, 1, true) ~= nil and url:find("/v1/config", 1, true) ~= nil end
function NebbieDash.startCfgSyncPull(mode) local okCfg, base = NebbieDash.identSyncConfigured() if not okCfg then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Config sync: serve lo stesso token di nidentsync " .. "(nidentsync token <segreto>).
") return end if type(getHTTP) ~= "function" then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] getHTTP non disponibile — aggiorna Mudlet.
") return end if NebbieDash.cfgSyncBusy() then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Config sync gia' in corso.
") return end if NebbieDash.identSyncBusy() then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Ident sync in corso — riprova dopo.
") return end NebbieDash.ensureCfgSyncHttpHandlers() local queue = {} for _, spec in ipairs(NebbieDash.CFG_SYNC_FILES or {}) do table.insert(queue, spec.name) end NebbieDash._cfgSync = { active = true, mode = mode or "sync", base = base, fileQueue = queue, fileIndex = 0, page = 1, pullInserted = 0, filesTouched = 0, } cecho("<grey>[NebbieDash] Config sync: pull da <white>" .. NebbieDash.identSyncMaskUrl(base) .. "<grey> ...
") NebbieDash.cfgSyncPullNextFile() end
function NebbieDash.cfgSyncPullNextFile() local st = NebbieDash._cfgSync if not st or not st.active then return end st.fileIndex = (st.fileIndex or 0) + 1 local name = st.fileQueue and st.fileQueue[st.fileIndex] if not name then cecho(string.format( "<green>[NebbieDash] Config pull ok: +%d righe/chiavi nuove (%d file toccati).
", st.pullInserted or 0, st.filesTouched or 0)) if st.mode == "pull" then st.active = false return end NebbieDash.cfgSyncStartPush() return end st.currentFile = name st.page = 1 st.fileInserted = 0 NebbieDash.cfgSyncRequestPage(name, 1) end
function NebbieDash.cfgSyncRequestPage(fileName, page) local st = NebbieDash._cfgSync if not st or not st.active then return end local url = string.format( "%s/v1/config?file=%s&page=%d&page_size=%d", st.base, tostring(fileName):gsub("([^%w%-_%.~])", function(c) return string.format("%%%02X", string.byte(c)) end), page, NebbieDash.CFG_SYNC_PAGE_SIZE or 40) st.expectGetUrl = url st.page = page local headers = NebbieDash.identSyncHeaders() local ok, err = pcall(getHTTP, url, headers) if not ok then NebbieDash.cfgSyncAbort("getHTTP fallita: " .. tostring(err)) end end
function NebbieDash.onCfgSyncGetDone(_, url, body) if not NebbieDash.cfgSyncIsOurUrl(url) then return end local st = NebbieDash._cfgSync if not st or not st.active then return end if st.expectGetUrl and tostring(url) ~= tostring(st.expectGetUrl) then return end local data = NebbieDash.jsonDecode(body or "") if type(data) ~= "table" or data.ok ~= true then NebbieDash.cfgSyncAbort("risposta pull non valida (" .. tostring(st.currentFile) .. ")") return end local spec = NebbieDash.cfgSyncSpecByName(st.currentFile) local n = 0 if spec then n = NebbieDash.cfgSyncAppendMissing(spec, data.entries or {}) if n > 0 then st.pullInserted = (st.pullInserted or 0) + n st.fileInserted = (st.fileInserted or 0) + n if type(spec.reload) == "function" then pcall(spec.reload) end end end local page = tonumber(data.page) or st.page or 1 local pages = tonumber(data.pages) or page if page < pages then NebbieDash.cfgSyncRequestPage(st.currentFile, page + 1) return end if (st.fileInserted or 0) > 0 then st.filesTouched = (st.filesTouched or 0) + 1 cecho("<grey>[NebbieDash] Config: <white>" .. tostring(st.currentFile) .. "<grey> +" .. tostring(st.fileInserted) .. "
") end NebbieDash.cfgSyncPullNextFile() end
function NebbieDash.onCfgSyncGetError(_, err, url) if url and not NebbieDash.cfgSyncIsOurUrl(url) then return end if not (NebbieDash._cfgSync and NebbieDash._cfgSync.active) then return end NebbieDash.cfgSyncAbort("errore GET: " .. tostring(err)) end
function NebbieDash.cfgSyncStartPush() local st = NebbieDash._cfgSync if not st then return end if type(postHTTP) ~= "function" then NebbieDash.cfgSyncAbort("postHTTP non disponibile — pull fatto, push saltato") return end local okCfg, base = NebbieDash.identSyncConfigured() if not okCfg then NebbieDash.cfgSyncAbort("config sync assente") return end st.base = base st.active = true local files = {} local total = 0 for _, spec in ipairs(NebbieDash.CFG_SYNC_FILES or {}) do local entries = NebbieDash.cfgSyncExportEntries(spec) local count = 0 for _ in pairs(entries) do count = count + 1 end if count > 0 then files[spec.name] = { entries = entries } total = total + count end end local url = base .. "/v1/config/merge" st.expectPostUrl = url local body = NebbieDash.jsonEncode({ files = files }) if type(body) ~= "string" or body == "" then NebbieDash.cfgSyncAbort("serializzazione JSON fallita") return end cecho("<grey>[NebbieDash] Config sync: push (" .. tostring(total) .. " chiavi)...
") local headers = NebbieDash.identSyncHeaders() local ok, err = pcall(postHTTP, body, url, headers) if not ok then NebbieDash.cfgSyncAbort("postHTTP fallita: " .. tostring(err)) end end
function NebbieDash.onCfgSyncPostDone(_, url, body) if not NebbieDash.cfgSyncIsOurUrl(url) then return end local st = NebbieDash._cfgSync if not st or not st.active then return end if st.expectPostUrl and tostring(url) ~= tostring(st.expectPostUrl) then return end local data = NebbieDash.jsonDecode(body or "") st.active = false if type(data) ~= "table" or data.ok ~= true then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Config push: risposta non valida.
") return end cecho(string.format( "<green>[NebbieDash] Config push ok: +%d nuove / =%d gia' presenti (hub file=%d).
", tonumber(data.inserted) or 0, tonumber(data.unchanged) or 0, tonumber(data.files) or 0)) end
function NebbieDash.onCfgSyncPostError(_, err, url) if url and not NebbieDash.cfgSyncIsOurUrl(url) then return end if not (NebbieDash._cfgSync and NebbieDash._cfgSync.active) then return end NebbieDash.cfgSyncAbort("errore POST: " .. tostring(err)) end
function NebbieDash.cmdCfgSync(argStr) argStr = (argStr or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" local mode, rest = argStr:match("^(%S+)%s*(.-)%s*$") mode = (mode or ""):lower() rest = rest or "" if mode == "" or mode == "sync" or mode == "full" then NebbieDash.startCfgSyncPull("sync") return end if mode == "pull" then NebbieDash.startCfgSyncPull("pull") return end if mode == "push" then if NebbieDash.cfgSyncBusy() or NebbieDash.identSyncBusy() then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Sync gia' in corso.
") return end if not NebbieDash.identSyncConfigured() then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Configura nidentsync token prima.
") return end NebbieDash.ensureCfgSyncHttpHandlers() local ok, base = NebbieDash.identSyncConfigured() NebbieDash._cfgSync = { active = true, mode = "push", base = base } NebbieDash.cfgSyncStartPush() return end if mode == "list" or mode == "files" then cecho("<cyan>[NebbieDash] File config syncabili (merge additivo):
") for _, spec in ipairs(NebbieDash.CFG_SYNC_FILES or {}) do local n = 0 for _ in pairs(NebbieDash.cfgSyncExportEntries(spec)) do n = n + 1 end cecho("<yellow> " .. spec.name .. "<grey> kind=" .. tostring(spec.kind) .. " locali=" .. tostring(n) .. "
") end cecho("<grey>Esclusi: sounds (path macchina), chars/ui cache, ident/know DB " .. "(hanno sync dedicati).
") return end if mode == "status" or mode == "info" or mode == "help" or mode == "?" then local ok, url = NebbieDash.identSyncConfigured() cecho("<green>[NebbieDash] Config sync usa lo stesso hub/token di nidentsync.
") cecho("<grey>URL: <white>" .. NebbieDash.identSyncMaskUrl( url ~= "" and url or (NebbieDash.IDENT_SYNC_DEFAULT_URL or "")) .. (ok and "" or " <orange>(token mancante)") .. "
") cecho("<grey>Comandi: <yellow>ncfgsync<grey> | <yellow>ncfgpull<grey> | <yellow>ncfgpush<grey> | <yellow>ncfgsync list
") cecho("<grey>Merge: aggiunge solo righe/chiavi mancanti, non sovrascrive.
") return end cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Uso: ncfgsync [sync|pull|push|list|status]
") end
function NebbieDash.cmdCfgPull() NebbieDash.cmdCfgSync("pull") end
function NebbieDash.cmdCfgPush() NebbieDash.cmdCfgSync("push") end
function NebbieDash.applyIdentSyncToken(token) token = (token or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if token == "" then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Token vuoto.
") return false end if token:lower() == "skip" or token:lower() == "dopo" or token:lower() == "later" then NebbieDash.cmdIdentSync("skip") return false end NebbieDash.prefs = NebbieDash.prefs or {} local defaultUrl = NebbieDash.IDENT_SYNC_DEFAULT_URL or "https://nebbie.wizmorgan.it/nebbie-ident" if not NebbieDash.prefs.ident_sync_url or NebbieDash.prefs.ident_sync_url == "" then NebbieDash.prefs.ident_sync_url = defaultUrl end NebbieDash.prefs.ident_sync_token = token NebbieDash.prefs.ident_sync_skip_prompt = true NebbieDash.savePreferencesFile() cecho("<green>[NebbieDash] Token sync salvato. URL: <white>" .. NebbieDash.identSyncMaskUrl(NebbieDash.prefs.ident_sync_url) .. "
") cecho("<grey>Avvio sync… (<yellow>nidentsync status<grey> per verificare)
") if type(tempTimer) == "function" then tempTimer(0.4, function() if not NebbieDash.identSyncBusy() then NebbieDash.startIdentSyncPull("sync") end end) else NebbieDash.startIdentSyncPull("sync") end return true end
-- Prompt all'avvio / su richiesta: chiede SOLO il token (URL fissa). function NebbieDash.promptIdentSyncTokenSetup(force) local ok = NebbieDash.identSyncConfigured() if ok and not force then return end -- Durante npackageupdate boot() puo' partire 2–3 volte: un solo prompt. if not force then local now = os.time() if NebbieDash._identSyncPromptAt and (now - NebbieDash._identSyncPromptAt) < 90 then return end NebbieDash._identSyncPromptAt = now else NebbieDash._identSyncPromptAt = os.time() end local url = (NebbieDash.prefs and NebbieDash.prefs.ident_sync_url) or NebbieDash.IDENT_SYNC_DEFAULT_URL or "https://nebbie.wizmorgan.it/nebbie-ident" if url == "" then url = "https://nebbie.wizmorgan.it/nebbie-ident" NebbieDash.prefs = NebbieDash.prefs or {} NebbieDash.prefs.ident_sync_url = url end cecho("
<yellow>[NebbieDash] Sync identify non configurata (manca il token).
") cecho("<grey>URL (fissa): <white>" .. url .. "
") cecho("<grey>Inserisci il token con:
") cecho(" <yellow>nidentsync token <il-tuo-token>
") if type(cechoLink) == "function" then cecho("<grey>Oppure: ") cechoLink("<cyan>[più tardi]", [[NebbieDash.cmdIdentSync("skip")]], "Non chiedere più all'avvio; potrai configurare dopo", true) cecho(" ") cechoLink("<cyan>[ripeti istruzioni]", [[NebbieDash.promptIdentSyncTokenSetup(true)]], "Mostra di nuovo queste istruzioni", true) cecho("
") else cecho("<grey>Oppure: <yellow>nidentsync skip<grey> (configuri dopo)
") end cecho("<grey>─────────────────────────────────────
") end
function NebbieDash.maybeIdentSyncOnBoot() if type(tempTimer) ~= "function" then return end -- Un solo timer: boot ripetuti (install/PostInstall/sysInstall) lo riarmano. if NebbieDash._identSyncBootTimer and type(killTimer) == "function" then pcall(killTimer, NebbieDash._identSyncBootTimer) NebbieDash._identSyncBootTimer = nil end NebbieDash._identSyncBootTimer = tempTimer(2.0, function() NebbieDash._identSyncBootTimer = nil NebbieDash.prefs = NebbieDash.prefs or {} -- Assicura URL di default anche su preferenze vecchie. if not NebbieDash.prefs.ident_sync_url or NebbieDash.prefs.ident_sync_url == "" then NebbieDash.prefs.ident_sync_url = NebbieDash.IDENT_SYNC_DEFAULT_URL or "https://nebbie.wizmorgan.it/nebbie-ident" end local configured = NebbieDash.identSyncConfigured() if not configured then if NebbieDash.prefs.ident_sync_skip_prompt then return end NebbieDash.promptIdentSyncTokenSetup(false) return end if NebbieDash.prefs.ident_sync_on_boot then if NebbieDash.identSyncBusy() then return end NebbieDash.startIdentSyncPull("sync") end end) end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Archivio know monster (condiviso profiles/ndashboard) — stesso schema di -- nidentdb. Cattura il blocco di cast 'know monster' (format string da -- spell_know_monster in magic3.cpp). Numeri GetApprox: noisy, si aggiornano -- a ogni cast. Colori/aggiunte testo stile dadomud: criteri in seguito. -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- NebbieDash.KNOW_DB_SAVE_DELAY = 0.2 NebbieDash.KNOW_CAPTURE_TIMEOUT = 3 NebbieDash.KNOW_SOURCE_HINT_TTL = 8
function NebbieDash.knowDbPath() return NebbieDash.configPath("nebbie-know-db.lua") end
function NebbieDash.loadKnowDb() NebbieDash.ensureConfigDir() NebbieDash.knowDb = NebbieDash.knowDb or { entries = {} } NebbieDash.knowDb.entries = NebbieDash.knowDb.entries or {} local path = NebbieDash.knowDbPath() if type(io.exists) == "function" and io.exists(path) then local loaded = {} local ok = pcall(function() table.load(path, loaded) end) if ok and type(loaded.entries) == "table" then NebbieDash.knowDb = loaded NebbieDash.knowDb.entries = NebbieDash.knowDb.entries or {} end end end
function NebbieDash.saveKnowDb() if not NebbieDash.persistEnabled then return end NebbieDash.ensureConfigDir() NebbieDash.knowDb = NebbieDash.knowDb or { entries = {} } pcall(function() table.save(NebbieDash.knowDbPath(), NebbieDash.knowDb) end) end
function NebbieDash.flushKnowDbSave() NebbieDash._knowDbSavePending = false NebbieDash._knowDbSaveTimer = nil NebbieDash.saveKnowDb() end
function NebbieDash.scheduleKnowDbSave() if NebbieDash._knowDbSavePending then return end NebbieDash._knowDbSavePending = true if type(tempTimer) == "function" then NebbieDash._knowDbSaveTimer = tempTimer(NebbieDash.KNOW_DB_SAVE_DELAY or 0.2, function() NebbieDash.flushKnowDbSave() end) else NebbieDash.flushKnowDbSave() end end
function NebbieDash.normalizeKnowMonsterKey(name) return ((name or ""):lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")) or "" end
-- Spezza la lista tipi (FIRE COLD …). I token "+N" NON sono tipi: sono la -- soglia di hitroll dell'arma (armi da +0 a +N fanno 0 danni vs quella -- resist/immune). Restituisce bits, hitrollMax (numero N oppure nil). function NebbieDash.splitKnowBitList(text) local out = {} local hitrollMax = nil for token in (text or ""):gmatch("%S+") do token = token:gsub("[%.%,%;%:]+$", "") local hr = token:match("^%+(%d+)$") if hr then local n = tonumber(hr) if n and (not hitrollMax or n > hitrollMax) then hitrollMax = n end elseif token ~= "" and not token:match("^%-%d+$") then table.insert(out, token) end end return out, hitrollMax end
-- Se un tipo è sia immune sia resistente, vince immune: resta solo in immune. function NebbieDash.filterKnowResistantByImmune(resistant, immune) if not resistant or #resistant == 0 then return resistant or {} end if not immune or #immune == 0 then return resistant end local immSet = {} for _, t in ipairs(immune) do immSet[(t or ""):upper()] = true end local out = {} for _, t in ipairs(resistant) do if not immSet[(t or ""):upper()] then table.insert(out, t) end end return out end
function NebbieDash.applyKnowImmuneWins(entry) if not entry then return entry end if entry.resistant and entry.immune then entry.resistant = NebbieDash.filterKnowResistantByImmune(entry.resistant, entry.immune) end return entry end
-- Parser del blocco know monster (righe già senza colori ANSI Mudlet). -- Livelli caster (codice, non help): razza sempre; exp>5; livello>10; hate>15; -- hits>20; susc>25; resist>30; immune>35; attacchi>40; danno>45. function NebbieDash.parseKnowMonsterFull(lines) local entry = { monsterName = nil, race = nil, exp = nil, warriorLevel = nil, hateRace = nil, hateClass = nil, hits = nil, susceptible = nil, resistant = nil, immune = nil, hitrollResistMax = nil, -- armi +0..+N fanno 0 vs quella resist hitrollImmuneMax = nil, -- idem vs quella immune attacks = nil, damageDice = nil, } for _, raw in ipairs(lines or {}) do local text = NebbieDash.stripColors(raw or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if text == "" then -- skip elseif text:match("^Non e' realmente un mostro%.%s*$") then return nil else local name, race = text:match("^(.+) e' di razza (.+)%.%s*$") if name and race then entry.monsterName = name entry.race = race:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") end local nExp, exp = text:match("^(.+) ha circa (%d+) punti esperienza%.%s*$") if nExp and exp then entry.monsterName = entry.monsterName or nExp entry.exp = tonumber(exp) end local nLev, lev = text:match( "^(.+) combatte piu' o meno come un guerriero del (%d+)%^ livello%.%s*$") if nLev and lev then entry.monsterName = entry.monsterName or nLev entry.warriorLevel = tonumber(lev) end local nHr, hr = text:match("^(.+) sembra odiare la razza dei (.+)%.%s*$") if nHr and hr then entry.monsterName = entry.monsterName or nHr entry.hateRace = hr:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") end local nHc, hc = text:match("^(.+) sembra odiare la classe (.+)%.%s*$") if nHc and hc then entry.monsterName = entry.monsterName or nHc entry.hateClass = hc:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") end local nHit, hits = text:match("^Probabilmente (.+) ha (%d+) punti vita%.%s*$") if nHit and hits then entry.monsterName = entry.monsterName or nHit entry.hits = tonumber(hits) end local nSus, sus = text:match("^(.+) e' suscettibile a (.+)%.%s*$") if nSus and sus then entry.monsterName = entry.monsterName or nSus entry.susceptible = select(1, NebbieDash.splitKnowBitList(sus)) end local nRes, res = text:match("^(.+) e' resistente a (.+)%.%s*$") if nRes and res then entry.monsterName = entry.monsterName or nRes local bits, hrMax = NebbieDash.splitKnowBitList(res) entry.resistant = bits if hrMax ~= nil then entry.hitrollResistMax = hrMax end end local nImm, imm = text:match("^(.+) e' immune a (.+)%.%s*$") if nImm and imm then entry.monsterName = entry.monsterName or nImm local bits, hrMax = NebbieDash.splitKnowBitList(imm) entry.immune = bits if hrMax ~= nil then entry.hitrollImmuneMax = hrMax end end local nAtt, att = text:match("^(.+) ha circa (%d+)%.0 attacchi per turno%.%s*$") if nAtt and att then entry.monsterName = entry.monsterName or nAtt entry.attacks = tonumber(att) end local dA, dB = text:match( "^Ognuno dei quali fa circa (%d+)d(%d+) punti di danno%.%s*$") if dA and dB then entry.damageDice = tostring(dA) .. "d" .. tostring(dB) end end end if not entry.monsterName or entry.monsterName == "" then return nil end if not entry.race or entry.race == "" then return nil end return NebbieDash.applyKnowImmuneWins(entry) end
-- Soglia hitroll effettiva (max tra resist e immune): armi +0..+N → 0 danni. function NebbieDash.knowHitrollThreshold(entry) if not entry then return nil end local a, b = entry.hitrollResistMax, entry.hitrollImmuneMax if a and b then return math.max(a, b) end return a or b end
-- Tag corto da appendere al look in stanza (solo info critiche). function NebbieDash.formatKnowRoomTag(entry) if not entry then return nil end local resistant = NebbieDash.filterKnowResistantByImmune(entry.resistant, entry.immune) local parts = {} if entry.warriorLevel ~= nil then table.insert(parts, "L" .. tostring(entry.warriorLevel)) end if entry.susceptible and #entry.susceptible > 0 then table.insert(parts, "SUSC:" .. table.concat(entry.susceptible, ",")) end if entry.immune and #entry.immune > 0 then table.insert(parts, "IMM:" .. table.concat(entry.immune, ",")) end if resistant and #resistant > 0 then table.insert(parts, "RESI:" .. table.concat(resistant, ",")) end local hr = NebbieDash.knowHitrollThreshold(entry) if hr ~= nil then -- Serve arma con hitroll > N (es. +4 → serve +5). table.insert(parts, "HR>+" .. tostring(hr)) end if #parts == 0 then return nil end return " [" .. table.concat(parts, " | ") .. "]" end
function NebbieDash.normalizeKnowNameForMatch(name) name = (name or ""):lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" name = name:gsub("^l'", ""):gsub("^un'", "") name = name:gsub("^il%s+", ""):gsub("^la%s+", ""):gsub("^lo%s+", "") name = name:gsub("^un%s+", ""):gsub("^una%s+", ""):gsub("^uno%s+", "") name = name:gsub("^gli%s+", ""):gsub("^le%s+", ""):gsub("^i%s+", "") return name:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" end
-- Trova la migliore entry know per una riga di presenza in stanza. function NebbieDash.findKnowEntryForRoomLine(text) text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text or ""):lower() if text == "" then return nil end local best, bestScore = nil, 0 for _, entry in pairs((NebbieDash.knowDb and NebbieDash.knowDb.entries) or {}) do local name = entry.monsterName or "" local nameLow = name:lower() local score = 0 if nameLow ~= "" and text:find(nameLow, 1, true) then score = 100 + #nameLow else local bare = NebbieDash.normalizeKnowNameForMatch(name) if bare ~= "" and #bare >= 4 and text:find(bare, 1, true) then score = 50 + #bare end end if score > bestScore then best, bestScore = entry, score end end if bestScore < 50 then return nil end return best end
function NebbieDash.onKnowRoomPresenceLine() local text = line or (type(getCurrentLine) == "function" and getCurrentLine()) or "" text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text or "") -- Solo righe di presenza in stanza (look / entrata). if not (text:find(" e' qui", 1, true) or text:find(" sono qui", 1, true) or text:find(" vola qui", 1, true) or text:find(" giace qui", 1, true) or text:find(" sta dormendo qui", 1, true) or text:find(" sta riposando qui", 1, true) or text:find(" sta galleggiando qui", 1, true)) then return end local entry = NebbieDash.findKnowEntryForRoomLine(text) if not entry then return end local tag = NebbieDash.formatKnowRoomTag(entry) if not tag then return end if type(decho) == "function" then decho("<255,200,0>" .. tag) elseif type(cecho) == "function" then cecho("<yellow>" .. tag) end end
function NebbieDash.upsertKnowRecord(parsed, character, source) if not parsed or not parsed.monsterName then return nil end local key = NebbieDash.normalizeKnowMonsterKey(parsed.monsterName) if key == "" then return nil end NebbieDash.knowDb = NebbieDash.knowDb or { entries = {} } NebbieDash.knowDb.entries = NebbieDash.knowDb.entries or {} local now = os.time() local existing = NebbieDash.knowDb.entries[key] or {} existing.key = key existing.monsterName = parsed.monsterName existing.race = parsed.race -- Merge: aggiorna i campi presenti; conserva quelli noti da cast di livello -- più alto se il cast corrente non li ha rivelati. if parsed.exp ~= nil then existing.exp = parsed.exp end if parsed.warriorLevel ~= nil then existing.warriorLevel = parsed.warriorLevel end if parsed.hateRace ~= nil then existing.hateRace = parsed.hateRace end if parsed.hateClass ~= nil then existing.hateClass = parsed.hateClass end if parsed.hits ~= nil then existing.hits = parsed.hits end if parsed.susceptible ~= nil then existing.susceptible = parsed.susceptible end if parsed.resistant ~= nil then existing.resistant = parsed.resistant end if parsed.immune ~= nil then existing.immune = parsed.immune end if parsed.hitrollResistMax ~= nil then existing.hitrollResistMax = math.max(existing.hitrollResistMax or 0, parsed.hitrollResistMax) end if parsed.hitrollImmuneMax ~= nil then existing.hitrollImmuneMax = math.max(existing.hitrollImmuneMax or 0, parsed.hitrollImmuneMax) end if parsed.attacks ~= nil then existing.attacks = parsed.attacks end if parsed.damageDice ~= nil then existing.damageDice = parsed.damageDice end NebbieDash.applyKnowImmuneWins(existing) existing.lastAt = now existing.lastCharacter = character or existing.lastCharacter or "unknown" existing.lastSource = source or existing.lastSource existing.byCharacter = existing.byCharacter or {} local who = character or "unknown" existing.byCharacter[who] = { at = now, source = source or (existing.byCharacter[who] and existing.byCharacter[who].source), } NebbieDash.knowDb.entries[key] = existing NebbieDash.scheduleKnowDbSave() return existing end
function NebbieDash.noteKnowSourceHint(source) if not source or source == "" then return end NebbieDash._knowSourceHint = { source = source, at = os.time() } end
function NebbieDash.consumeKnowSourceHint() local hint = NebbieDash._knowSourceHint NebbieDash._knowSourceHint = nil if not hint or not hint.at then return nil end if (os.time() - hint.at) > (NebbieDash.KNOW_SOURCE_HINT_TTL or 8) then return nil end return hint.source end
function NebbieDash.onKnowSourceSpellLine() local text = line or (type(getCurrentLine) == "function" and getCurrentLine()) or "" text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text) if text:find("Pronunci le parole, 'know monster'", 1, true) or text:find('Pronunci le parole, "know monster"', 1, true) then NebbieDash.noteKnowSourceHint("spell") end end
function NebbieDash.armKnowCaptureWatchdog(gen) if type(tempTimer) ~= "function" then return end tempTimer(NebbieDash.KNOW_CAPTURE_TIMEOUT or 3, function() local cap = NebbieDash._knowCapture if not cap or NebbieDash._knowCaptureGen ~= gen then return end if cap.activity ~= cap.watchedActivity then cap.watchedActivity = cap.activity NebbieDash.armKnowCaptureWatchdog(gen) else NebbieDash.finishKnowArchiveCapture() end end) end
function NebbieDash.startKnowMonsterCapture() if NebbieDash._knowCapture then NebbieDash.finishKnowArchiveCapture() end NebbieDash._knowCaptureGen = (NebbieDash._knowCaptureGen or 0) + 1 local gen = NebbieDash._knowCaptureGen NebbieDash._knowCapture = { lines = {}, character = NebbieDash.currentChar or "unknown", source = NebbieDash.consumeKnowSourceHint(), activity = 0, watchedActivity = 0, startedAt = os.time(), } if NebbieDash._knowLineTrig then pcall(enableTrigger, NebbieDash._knowLineTrig) end NebbieDash.armKnowCaptureWatchdog(gen) end
-- Prima riga utile del blocco: "<Nome> e' di razza <Razza>." function NebbieDash.onKnowMonsterRaceLine() local text = line or (type(getCurrentLine) == "function" and getCurrentLine()) or "" text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text or "") local trimmed = text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if not trimmed:match("e' di razza ") then return end NebbieDash.startKnowMonsterCapture() local cap = NebbieDash._knowCapture if not cap then return end table.insert(cap.lines, trimmed) cap.activity = (cap.activity or 0) + 1 end
function NebbieDash.onKnowArchiveLine() local cap = NebbieDash._knowCapture if not cap then if NebbieDash._knowLineTrig then pcall(disableTrigger, NebbieDash._knowLineTrig) end return end local text = line or (type(getCurrentLine) == "function" and getCurrentLine()) or "" text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text or "") local trimmed = text:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if NebbieDash.isAnyPromptLine(trimmed) then NebbieDash.finishKnowArchiveCapture() return end -- Evita di duplicare la riga razza già inserita dallo start handler. if #cap.lines == 1 and trimmed == cap.lines[1] then return end if trimmed ~= "" then table.insert(cap.lines, trimmed) cap.activity = (cap.activity or 0) + 1 end end
function NebbieDash.echoKnowMonsterSummary(entry) if not entry then return end local name = entry.monsterName or "?" if entry.warriorLevel ~= nil then cecho(string.format( "<yellow>[Know]<white> %s <grey>— livello ~<yellow>%d
", name, entry.warriorLevel)) else cecho(string.format("<yellow>[Know]<white> %s
", name)) end if entry.susceptible and #entry.susceptible > 0 then cecho("<yellow>[Know] <red>SUSCETTIBILE:<yellow> " .. table.concat(entry.susceptible, " ") .. "
") end if entry.immune and #entry.immune > 0 then cecho("<yellow>[Know] <cyan>IMMUNE:<white> " .. table.concat(entry.immune, " ") .. "
") end if entry.resistant and #entry.resistant > 0 then cecho("<yellow>[Know] <green>RESISTENTE:<white> " .. table.concat(entry.resistant, " ") .. " <grey>(esclusi tipi già immune)
") end local hr = NebbieDash.knowHitrollThreshold(entry) if hr ~= nil then cecho(string.format( "<yellow>[Know] <orange>HITROLL:<white> armi +0..+%d → 0 danni; serve arma +%d o superiore.
", hr, hr + 1)) end end
-- Evidenziazioni live sulle righe del cast know monster (text_highlights). function NebbieDash.onKnowHighlightLevelLine() if NebbieDash.textHighlights == false then return end local text = line or (type(getCurrentLine) == "function" and getCurrentLine()) or "" text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text) local lev = text:match("guerriero del (%d+)%^") if not lev then return end -- Solo "51^" (livello), non tutta la riga. NebbieDash.hlColorSpan(lev .. "^", 255, 255, 0, 0, 0, 128) end
function NebbieDash.onKnowHighlightSusceptibleLine() if NebbieDash.textHighlights == false then return end local text = line or (type(getCurrentLine) == "function" and getCurrentLine()) or "" text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text) local span = text:match("(e' suscettibile a .+)$") if not span then return end -- Molto evidente: giallo su rosso. NebbieDash.hlColorSpan(span, 255, 255, 0, 180, 0, 0) end
function NebbieDash.onKnowHighlightResistantLine() if NebbieDash.textHighlights == false then return end local text = line or (type(getCurrentLine) == "function" and getCurrentLine()) or "" text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text) local span = text:match("(e' resistente a .+)$") if not span then return end NebbieDash.hlColorSpan(span, 200, 255, 200, 0, 80, 0) end
function NebbieDash.onKnowHighlightImmuneLine() if NebbieDash.textHighlights == false then return end local text = line or (type(getCurrentLine) == "function" and getCurrentLine()) or "" text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text) local span = text:match("(e' immune a .+)$") if not span then return end NebbieDash.hlColorSpan(span, 255, 255, 255, 0, 60, 160) end
function NebbieDash.finishKnowArchiveCapture() local cap = NebbieDash._knowCapture NebbieDash._knowCapture = nil if NebbieDash._knowLineTrig then pcall(disableTrigger, NebbieDash._knowLineTrig) end if not cap then return end local parsed = NebbieDash.parseKnowMonsterFull(cap.lines) if not parsed then return end NebbieDash.upsertKnowRecord(parsed, cap.character, cap.source) NebbieDash.echoKnowMonsterSummary(parsed) end
function NebbieDash.knowDbEntryCount() local n = 0 for _ in pairs((NebbieDash.knowDb and NebbieDash.knowDb.entries) or {}) do n = n + 1 end return n end
function NebbieDash.searchKnowDb(query) query = (query or ""):lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" local results = {} for _, entry in pairs((NebbieDash.knowDb and NebbieDash.knowDb.entries) or {}) do if query == "" then table.insert(results, entry) else local hay = table.concat({ entry.monsterName or "", entry.race or "", entry.hateRace or "", entry.hateClass or "", table.concat(entry.susceptible or {}, " "), table.concat(entry.resistant or {}, " "), table.concat(entry.immune or {}, " "), entry.damageDice or "", entry.lastCharacter or "", }, " "):lower() if hay:find(query, 1, true) then table.insert(results, entry) end end end table.sort(results, function(a, b) return (a.monsterName or "") < (b.monsterName or "") end) return results end
function NebbieDash.listKnowDbByRace(raceQuery) raceQuery = (raceQuery or ""):lower():match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" local results = {} for _, entry in pairs((NebbieDash.knowDb and NebbieDash.knowDb.entries) or {}) do local race = (entry.race or ""):lower() if raceQuery == "" or race == raceQuery or race:find(raceQuery, 1, true) then table.insert(results, entry) end end table.sort(results, function(a, b) return (a.monsterName or "") < (b.monsterName or "") end) return results end
function NebbieDash.formatKnowDbEntry(entry) if not entry then return {} end local resistant = NebbieDash.filterKnowResistantByImmune(entry.resistant, entry.immune) local lines = {} table.insert(lines, string.format("<yellow>%s<white> — razza <cyan>%s", entry.monsterName or "?", entry.race or "?")) if entry.warriorLevel ~= nil then table.insert(lines, string.format(" <yellow>livello ~%d", entry.warriorLevel)) end local stats = {} if entry.exp ~= nil then table.insert(stats, "exp~" .. tostring(entry.exp)) end if entry.hits ~= nil then table.insert(stats, "hp~" .. tostring(entry.hits)) end if entry.attacks ~= nil then table.insert(stats, "att " .. tostring(entry.attacks)) end if entry.damageDice then table.insert(stats, "dmg " .. entry.damageDice) end if #stats > 0 then table.insert(lines, " <grey>approx:<white> " .. table.concat(stats, ", ")) end if entry.hateRace and entry.hateRace ~= "" then table.insert(lines, " <grey>odia razza:<white> " .. entry.hateRace) end if entry.hateClass and entry.hateClass ~= "" then table.insert(lines, " <grey>odia classe:<white> " .. entry.hateClass) end if entry.susceptible and #entry.susceptible > 0 then table.insert(lines, " <red>SUSCETTIBILE:<yellow> " .. table.concat(entry.susceptible, " ")) end if entry.immune and #entry.immune > 0 then table.insert(lines, " <cyan>IMMUNE:<white> " .. table.concat(entry.immune, " ")) end if resistant and #resistant > 0 then table.insert(lines, " <green>RESISTENTE:<white> " .. table.concat(resistant, " ")) end local hr = NebbieDash.knowHitrollThreshold(entry) if hr ~= nil then table.insert(lines, string.format( " <orange>HITROLL:<white> +0..+%d inutili; serve arma +%d+", hr, hr + 1)) end local when = entry.lastAt and os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", entry.lastAt) or "?" local src = entry.lastSource and (" (" .. entry.lastSource .. ")") or "" table.insert(lines, string.format( " <grey>ultimo know:<white> %s%s <grey>@ %s", tostring(entry.lastCharacter or "?"), src, when)) return lines end
function NebbieDash.cmdKnowDb(argStr) argStr = (argStr or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" local mode, rest = argStr:match("^(%S+)%s+(.-)%s*$") if not mode then mode, rest = argStr, "" end mode = (mode or ""):lower()
if argStr == "" or mode == "help" or mode == "?" then cecho("<green>[NebbieDash] Archivio know monster: <white>" .. tostring(NebbieDash.knowDbEntryCount()) .. "<green> mostri in <white>" .. NebbieDash.knowDbPath() .. "
") cecho("<grey>Uso: <yellow>nknowdb <query><grey> | <yellow>nknowdb race <razza><grey> | <yellow>nknowdbreload
") cecho("<grey>Si aggiorna automaticamente a ogni cast 'know monster' riuscito (NPC).
") return end
local results if mode == "race" then results = NebbieDash.listKnowDbByRace(rest) else results = NebbieDash.searchKnowDb(argStr) end
if not results or #results == 0 then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Nessun know monster in archivio per <white>" .. argStr .. "
") return end local limit = 40 cecho("<green>[NebbieDash] Know monster: <white>" .. tostring(#results) .. ( #results > limit and (" (mostra primi " .. limit .. ")") or "" ) .. "
") for i, entry in ipairs(results) do if i > limit then break end for _, lineTxt in ipairs(NebbieDash.formatKnowDbEntry(entry)) do cecho(lineTxt .. "
") end end end
function NebbieDash.cmdReloadKnowDb() NebbieDash.loadKnowDb() cecho("<green>[NebbieDash] Know DB ricaricato: <white>" .. tostring(NebbieDash.knowDbEntryCount()) .. "<green> mostri (<white>" .. NebbieDash.knowDbPath() .. "<green>).
") end

Suoni: nebbie-dash-sounds.txt -- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- NebbieDash.textHighlights = true

function NebbieDash.soundsPath() return NebbieDash.configPath("nebbie-dash-sounds.txt") end
function NebbieDash.ensureSoundsFile() local path = NebbieDash.soundsPath() if type(io.exists) == "function" and io.exists(path) then return end NebbieDash.ensureConfigDir() local f = io.open(path, "w") if not f then return end f:write( "# NebbieDash — percorsi suono opzionali (vuoto = silenzioso)
" .. "# Dopo modifiche: npreferencesreload oppure ntriggers
" .. "# Vuoto = prova suoni di sistema (Linux freedesktop / Windows Media / macOS Sounds).
" .. "# Esempio Windows: C:/Users/tu/.config/mudlet/profiles/ndashboard/sounds/humber.mp3
" .. "humber =
" .. "dig_done =
" .. "sanc_gone =
" .. "aura_loss =
" .. "gold_loss =
" ) f:close() end
function NebbieDash.loadSoundsConfig() NebbieDash.migrateConfigFileIfNeeded("nebbie-dash-sounds.txt") NebbieDash.ensureSoundsFile() NebbieDash.sounds = NebbieDash.sounds or { humber = "", dig_done = "", sanc_gone = "", aura_loss = "", gold_loss = "", } if NebbieDash.sounds.gold_loss == nil then NebbieDash.sounds.gold_loss = "" end local path = NebbieDash.soundsPath() if type(io.exists) ~= "function" or not io.exists(path) then return end local f = io.open(path, "r") if not f then return end for line in f:lines() do local key, val = line:match("^%s*([%w_]+)%s*=%s*(.-)%s*$") if key and not key:match("^#") then val = (val or ""):gsub("%s*#.*$", ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if NebbieDash.sounds[key] ~= nil then NebbieDash.sounds[key] = val end end end f:close() end
-- Riproduce un file audio. Su macOS Mudlet playSoundFile spesso non gestisce -- gli .aiff di sistema → fallback afplay. Su Linux prova playSoundFile poi -- paplay/ffplay se disponibili. function NebbieDash.shellQuote(s) return "'" .. tostring(s or ""):gsub("'", "'\''") .. "'" end
function NebbieDash.playSoundPath(path, opts) opts = opts or {} path = (path or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if path == "" then return false, "empty" end if type(io.exists) == "function" and not io.exists(path) then local f = io.open(path, "rb") if f then f:close() else return false, "missing" end end local osname = NebbieDash.detectHostOs() local ext = (path:match("%.([%w]+)$") or ""):lower() local preferAfplay = (osname == "macos") or ext == "aiff" or ext == "aif" or ext == "caf" local function tryAfplay() -- Background: non bloccare Mudlet sul suono. local cmd = "afplay " .. NebbieDash.shellQuote(path) .. " >/dev/null 2>&1 &" local ok = pcall(os.execute, cmd) return ok end local function tryPlaySoundFile() if type(playSoundFile) ~= "function" then return false end local ok = pcall(playSoundFile, path) return ok == true end local function tryLinuxCli() local q = NebbieDash.shellQuote(path) for _, bin in ipairs({ "paplay", "pw-play", "ffplay -nodisp -autoexit -loglevel quiet" }) do local cmd = bin .. " " .. q .. " >/dev/null 2>&1 &" if pcall(os.execute, cmd) then return true end end return false end if preferAfplay then if tryAfplay() then return true, "afplay" end if tryPlaySoundFile() then return true, "playSoundFile" end return false, "afplay_failed" end if tryPlaySoundFile() then return true, "playSoundFile" end if osname == "linux" and tryLinuxCli() then return true, "cli" end if osname == "macos" and tryAfplay() then return true, "afplay" end return false, "no_player" end
function NebbieDash.playHighlightSound(key) local path = NebbieDash.sounds and NebbieDash.sounds[key] if not path or path == "" then return end NebbieDash.playSoundPath(path) end
function NebbieDash.hlColorSpan(text, r, g, b, br, bg, bb) if type(selectString) ~= "function" or not text or text == "" then return end selectString(text, 1) if type(setFgColor) == "function" then setFgColor(r, g, b) end if br and type(setBgColor) == "function" then setBgColor(br, bg, bb) end if type(resetFormat) == "function" then resetFormat() end end
function NebbieDash.hlColorWholeLine(r, g, b, br, bg, bb) local text = line or (type(getCurrentLine) == "function" and getCurrentLine()) or "" text = NebbieDash.stripColors(text) if text == "" then return end NebbieDash.hlColorSpan(text, r, g, b, br, bg, bb) end
function NebbieDash.onAutoColorGem(pattern, r, g, b, descrizione) if NebbieDash.textHighlights == false then return end local text = line or (type(getCurrentLine) == "function" and getCurrentLine()) or "" local needle = pattern if type(selectString) == "function" then local ok = selectString(needle, 1) if ok == false or ok == 0 then -- fallback: prova a colorare comunque la riga se contiene il pattern if not text:find(needle, 1, true) then return end selectString(needle, 1) end if type(setFgColor) == "function" then setFgColor(r, g, b) end if type(resetFormat) == "function" then resetFormat() end end if descrizione and descrizione ~= "" and type(decho) == "function" then decho("<128,128,128> [" .. descrizione .. "]") end end

function NebbieDash.resolveWeaponTargetFromArg(data, argStr) argStr = (argStr or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") argStr = argStr:gsub("^['"]", ""):gsub("['"]$", "") if argStr == "" then return nil end local needle = argStr:lower() local best, bestLen = nil, 0 for _, w in ipairs(data.weapons or {}) do local kw = (w.keyword or ""):lower() local dn = (w.displayName or ""):lower() if kw == needle or dn == needle then return w end if kw:find(needle, 1, true) or dn:find(needle, 1, true) then local score = math.max(#needle, #kw) if score > bestLen then best, bestLen = w, score end end if NebbieDash.keywordsOverlap(kw, needle) or NebbieDash.keywordsOverlap(dn, needle) then if #kw > bestLen then best, bestLen = w, #kw end end end if best then best.userKeyword = argStr return best end return { keyword = argStr, displayName = argStr, userKeyword = argStr } end
function NebbieDash.runWeaponSwap(target) local name = NebbieDash.currentChar if not name or not target then return false end if NebbieDash._weaponSwapBusy then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Cambio arma gia' in corso.
") return false end local data = NebbieDash.getCharData(name) NebbieDash.loadItemKeywords() local currentKeyword = NebbieDash.currentWieldedKeyword(data) local resolvedKw = NebbieDash.resolveWeaponSwapKeyword(target) if currentKeyword ~= "" and resolvedKw ~= "" and NebbieDash.keywordsOverlap(currentKeyword, resolvedKw) then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Stai gia' impugnando " .. (target.displayName or resolvedKw) .. ".
") return false end local steps, err = NebbieDash.buildWeaponSwapSteps(data, target) if not steps then if err == "no_backpack" then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Nessuno zaino rilevato (slot 'sulla schiena') — esegui <yellow>neq<orange> prima.
") end return false end local gen = NebbieDash.beginWeaponSwapGuard(data) NebbieDash.runCommandSequence(steps, NebbieDash.weaponSwapDelay) -- Timeout generoso: le risposte MUD (soprattutto rem/wear zaino) possono -- arrivare dopo l'ultimo send; altrimenti un rem in ritardo svuota la schiena. local timeout = (NebbieDash.weaponSwapDelay or 0.5) * #steps + 4.0 tempTimer(timeout, function() NebbieDash.endWeaponSwapGuard(gen, true) end) return true end
-- --------------------------------------------------------------------------- -- Automine dig (port da dadomud): ndig + trigger gated. -- ndig = rem zaino, get pic (piccone/pick), rem arma, wield, put arma, wear zaino. -- Al primo `dig` inviato al MUD partono retry / umber swap / sanc / vein done. -- Fame/sete: resta nautofeed (niente doppio mangia dadomud). -- ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
NebbieDash._digAuto = NebbieDash._digAuto or { armed = false, active = false, digPending = false, digPendingTimer = nil, verifyingSanctuary = false, quietAttrib = false, stashedCombat = "", currentWield = "", }
function NebbieDash.digAutoState() NebbieDash._digAuto = NebbieDash._digAuto or { armed = false, active = false, digPending = false, digPendingTimer = nil, verifyingSanctuary = false, quietAttrib = false, stashedCombat = "", currentWield = "", } if NebbieDash._digAuto.currentWield == nil then NebbieDash._digAuto.currentWield = "" end return NebbieDash._digAuto end
function NebbieDash.digToolKeyword() local t = NebbieDash.prefs and NebbieDash.prefs.dig_tool t = (t or "pic"):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "pic" if t == "" then t = "pic" end return t end
function NebbieDash.digCombatKeyword() local st = NebbieDash.digAutoState() local pref = NebbieDash.prefs and NebbieDash.prefs.dig_combat pref = (pref or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if pref ~= "" then return pref end if st.stashedCombat and st.stashedCombat ~= "" then return st.stashedCombat end return "" end
function NebbieDash.digRetrySec() local n = NebbieDash.prefs and tonumber(NebbieDash.prefs.dig_retry_sec) if n and n >= 5 and n <= 120 then return n end return 24 end
function NebbieDash.digLootPath() return NebbieDash.configPath("nebbie-dig-loot.txt") end
function NebbieDash.ensureDigLootFile() local path = NebbieDash.digLootPath() if type(io.exists) == "function" and io.exists(path) then return end NebbieDash.ensureConfigDir() local f = io.open(path, "w") if not f then return end f:write( "# File loot dig — nebbie-complete-dashboard-package
" .. "# Usato quando il filone e' esaurito (dopo inv): mette in zaino i keep,
" .. "# toglie gli exclude dallo zaino, droppa il resto elencato in drop.
" .. "#
" .. "# Sintassi (una regola per riga):
" .. "# keep <keyword> put all.<keyword> <zaino>
" .. "# exclude <keyword> get all.<keyword> <zaino> (dopo i keep)
" .. "# drop <keyword> drop all.<keyword> (lascia a terra)
" .. "#
" .. "# Keyword = come le vuole il MUD (es. oro, mithril, pietra, carbone).
" .. "# Ordine consigliato: keep specifici, poi keep pietra, exclude carbone,
" .. "# poi drop dei rifiuti (pepita residua, minerale, carbone, …).
" .. "#
" .. "# Dopo modifiche: ndigloot oppure ndig loot
" .. "#
" .. "keep oro
" .. "keep mithril
" .. "keep acciaio
" .. "keep pietra
" .. "exclude carbone
" .. "drop pepita
" .. "drop minerale
" .. "drop carbone
" .. "drop resina
" ) f:close() end
function NebbieDash.parseDigLootLine(rawLine) local line2 = (rawLine or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if line2 == "" or line2:sub(1, 1) == "#" then return nil end local kind, kw = line2:match("^(%S+)%s+(.+)$") if not kind or not kw then return nil end kind = kind:lower() kw = kw:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" kw = kw:gsub("%s*#.*$", ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if kw == "" then return nil end if kind ~= "keep" and kind ~= "exclude" and kind ~= "drop" then return nil end return kind, kw end
function NebbieDash.loadDigLootRules() NebbieDash.ensureDigLootFile() NebbieDash.digLoot = { keep = {}, exclude = {}, drop = {} } local path = NebbieDash.digLootPath() local f = io.open(path, "r") if not f then return end for raw in f:lines() do local kind, kw = NebbieDash.parseDigLootLine(raw) if kind then table.insert(NebbieDash.digLoot[kind], kw) end end f:close() end
function NebbieDash.cmdReloadDigLoot() NebbieDash.loadDigLootRules() local d = NebbieDash.digLoot or { keep = {}, exclude = {}, drop = {} } cecho(string.format( "<green>[NebbieDash] Dig loot: keep=%d exclude=%d drop=%d da <white>%s
", #(d.keep or {}), #(d.exclude or {}), #(d.drop or {}), NebbieDash.digLootPath())) for _, kw in ipairs(d.keep or {}) do cecho("<grey> keep <white>" .. kw .. "
") end for _, kw in ipairs(d.exclude or {}) do cecho("<grey> exclude <white>" .. kw .. "
") end for _, kw in ipairs(d.drop or {}) do cecho("<grey> drop <white>" .. kw .. "
") end end
function NebbieDash.digAutoBuildVeinLootSteps() local name = NebbieDash.currentChar if not name then return nil, "no_char" end local data = NebbieDash.getCharData(name) NebbieDash.loadItemKeywords() if not NebbieDash.digLoot then NebbieDash.loadDigLootRules() end local rules = NebbieDash.digLoot or { keep = {}, exclude = {}, drop = {} } local backPhrase, backOverride = NebbieDash.findBackpackKeywords(data) if backPhrase == "" then return nil, "no_backpack" end local backKw = NebbieDash.macroBackpackKeywordFromPhrase(backPhrase, backOverride) if backKw == "" then return nil, "no_backpack" end local steps = {} table.insert(steps, "rem " .. backKw) for _, kw in ipairs(rules.keep or {}) do table.insert(steps, "put all." .. kw .. " " .. backKw) end for _, kw in ipairs(rules.exclude or {}) do table.insert(steps, "get all." .. kw .. " " .. backKw) end for _, kw in ipairs(rules.drop or {}) do table.insert(steps, "drop all." .. kw) end table.insert(steps, "wear " .. backKw) -- Come dadomud: lascia 1 moneta a terra per marcare la stanza scavata. table.insert(steps, "drop 1 coin") return steps, nil end
function NebbieDash.digAutoRunVeinLoot() local steps, err = NebbieDash.digAutoBuildVeinLootSteps() if not steps then if err == "no_backpack" then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Dig loot: nessuno zaino (schiena) — fai <yellow>neq<orange>. Loot saltato; droppo comunque 1 coin.
") else cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Dig loot: personaggio non rilevato — loot saltato; droppo comunque 1 coin.
") end -- Anche senza loot: marca stanza come dadomud. tempTimer(0.4, function() send("drop 1 coin", false) end) return false end local delay = NebbieDash.weaponSwapDelay or 0.5 -- Piccolo ritardo dopo inv cosi' l'output inventario arriva prima dei put. tempTimer(0.4, function() NebbieDash.runCommandSequence(steps, delay) end) cecho(string.format( "<green>[NebbieDash] Dig: filone esaurito — inv + loot zaino + drop 1 coin (%d comandi).
", #steps)) return true end
function NebbieDash.detectHostOs() if type(getOS) == "function" then local ok, osname = pcall(getOS) if ok and type(osname) == "string" and osname ~= "" then local low = osname:lower() if low:find("win", 1, true) then return "windows" end if low:find("mac", 1, true) or low:find("darwin", 1, true) then return "macos" end return "linux" end end if package.config:sub(1, 1) == "\" then return "windows" end return "linux" end
NebbieDash.SYSTEM_SOUND_CANDIDATES = { linux = { humber = { "/usr/share/sounds/freedesktop/stereo/dialog-warning.oga", "/usr/share/sounds/freedesktop/stereo/bell.oga", "/usr/share/sounds/alsa/Noise.wav", }, dig_done = { "/usr/share/sounds/freedesktop/stereo/complete.oga", "/usr/share/sounds/freedesktop/stereo/message.oga", "/usr/share/sounds/freedesktop/stereo/bell.oga", }, dig_warn = { "/usr/share/sounds/freedesktop/stereo/dialog-error.oga", "/usr/share/sounds/freedesktop/stereo/dialog-warning.oga", "/usr/share/sounds/freedesktop/stereo/bell.oga", }, }, windows = { humber = { "C:/Windows/Media/Windows Exclamation.wav", "C:/Windows/Media/Windows Ding.wav", "C:/Windows/Media/chord.wav", }, dig_done = { "C:/Windows/Media/Windows Notify.wav", "C:/Windows/Media/tada.wav", "C:/Windows/Media/chimes.wav", }, dig_warn = { "C:/Windows/Media/Windows Critical Stop.wav", "C:/Windows/Media/Windows Ding.wav", "C:/Windows/Media/chord.wav", }, }, macos = { humber = { "/System/Library/Sounds/Sosumi.aiff", "/System/Library/Sounds/Basso.aiff", "/System/Library/Sounds/Funk.aiff", }, dig_done = { "/System/Library/Sounds/Glass.aiff", "/System/Library/Sounds/Ping.aiff", "/System/Library/Sounds/Hero.aiff", }, dig_warn = { "/System/Library/Sounds/Basso.aiff", "/System/Library/Sounds/Sosumi.aiff", "/System/Library/Sounds/Funk.aiff", }, }, }
function NebbieDash.resolveSystemSound(kind) local osname = NebbieDash.detectHostOs() local tableByOs = NebbieDash.SYSTEM_SOUND_CANDIDATES[osname] or NebbieDash.SYSTEM_SOUND_CANDIDATES.linux local list = tableByOs and tableByOs[kind] if type(list) ~= "table" then return nil end for _, p in ipairs(list) do if type(io.exists) == "function" and io.exists(p) then return p end -- Fallback senza io.exists: prova open local f = io.open(p, "rb") if f then f:close(); return p end end return nil end
function NebbieDash.playSystemOrConfiguredSound(key, systemKind) local path = NebbieDash.sounds and NebbieDash.sounds[key] if path and path ~= "" then NebbieDash.playHighlightSound(key) return true end local sys = NebbieDash.resolveSystemSound(systemKind or key) if not sys then return false end local ok = NebbieDash.playSoundPath(sys) return ok == true end
function NebbieDash.cmdDigTestSound(which) which = ((which or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""):lower() if which == "" then which = "humber" end local map = { humber = "humber", dig_done = "dig_done", done = "dig_done", dig_warn = "dig_warn", warn = "dig_warn", sanc = "dig_warn", sanc_gone = "dig_warn", } local kind = map[which] if not kind then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Uso: ndig testsound [humber|dig_done|dig_warn]
") return end local cfg = NebbieDash.sounds and NebbieDash.sounds[kind] local path = (cfg and cfg ~= "" and cfg) or NebbieDash.resolveSystemSound(kind) if not path then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Nessun file suono per <yellow>" .. kind .. "<orange> (OS=" .. tostring(NebbieDash.detectHostOs()) .. ").
") return end local ok, how = NebbieDash.playSoundPath(path) if ok then cecho(string.format( "<green>[NebbieDash] Test suono <yellow>%s<green> via <white>%s<green>: %s
", kind, tostring(how), path)) else cecho(string.format( "<orange>[NebbieDash] Test suono FALLITO (%s) per <yellow>%s<orange>: %s
", tostring(how), kind, path)) end end
function NebbieDash.digAutoCancelRetry() local st = NebbieDash.digAutoState() if st.digPendingTimer and type(killTimer) == "function" then pcall(killTimer, st.digPendingTimer) end st.digPendingTimer = nil st.digPending = false end
-- opts.restoreCombat (default true): dopo lo stop, ripristina dig_combat -- (arma umber) e ripone dig_tool nello zaino — come uscire da ndig. function NebbieDash.digAutoStop(msg, opts) opts = opts or {} local restoreCombat = opts.restoreCombat if restoreCombat == nil then restoreCombat = true end local st = NebbieDash.digAutoState() NebbieDash.digAutoCancelRetry() st.armed = false st.active = false st.verifyingSanctuary = false st.quietAttrib = false if msg then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Dig automine: " .. msg .. "
") end if not restoreCombat then return end local combat = NebbieDash.digCombatKeyword() if combat == "" then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Dig off: nessuna arma combat (ndig combat <kw>) da ripristinare.
") return end -- Gia' in mano l'arma combat (es. umber in corso): non rifare lo swap. if st.currentWield and st.currentWield ~= "" and NebbieDash.keywordsOverlap(st.currentWield, combat) then cecho("<green>[NebbieDash] Dig off: gia' impugnato <yellow>" .. combat .. "<green>.
") return end local putAway = NebbieDash.digToolKeyword() if st.currentWield and st.currentWield ~= "" and not NebbieDash.keywordsOverlap(st.currentWield, combat) then putAway = st.currentWield end cecho("<green>[NebbieDash] Dig off: ripristino <yellow>" .. combat .. "<green>, ripongo <yellow>" .. putAway .. "<green>.
") NebbieDash.digAutoRunSwap(combat, "dig_combat", { putAwayKw = putAway }) end
function NebbieDash.digAutoScheduleRetry() local st = NebbieDash.digAutoState() if not st.active then return end NebbieDash.digAutoCancelRetry() st.digPending = true local sec = NebbieDash.digRetrySec() st.digPendingTimer = tempTimer(sec, function() local s = NebbieDash.digAutoState() s.digPendingTimer = nil if s.digPending and s.active then s.digPending = false send("dig", false) else s.digPending = false end end) end
function NebbieDash.digAutoIsEngaged() local st = NebbieDash.digAutoState() return st.armed or st.active end
function NebbieDash.digAutoActivateFromDigCommand() local st = NebbieDash.digAutoState() if not st.armed and not st.active then return end if not st.active then st.active = true st.armed = true cecho("<green>[NebbieDash] Dig automine attivo (retry/umber/sanc/vein).
") end end
-- Se armed ma active non e' partito (sysDataSendRequest assente / dig via -- send() script), attiva al primo feedback dig dal MUD. function NebbieDash.digAutoEnsureActiveFromWorld() local st = NebbieDash.digAutoState() if st.active then return true end if not st.armed then return false end NebbieDash.digAutoActivateFromDigCommand() return st.active == true end
-- opts.handsEmpty: mani vuote (frantumi) → solo get+wield, niente rem/put. -- opts.putAwayKw: keyword da rimuovere e rimettere in zaino (stile dadomud -- config.armaattuale). Se assente, ricava dall'eq cache (puo' fallire se -- eq non sincronizzato → manca il put: per umber usare sempre putAwayKw). function NebbieDash.digAutoBuildSwapSteps(weaponKw, opts) opts = opts or {} local name = NebbieDash.currentChar if not name then return nil, "no_char" end local data = NebbieDash.getCharData(name) NebbieDash.loadItemKeywords() local backPhrase, backOverride = NebbieDash.findBackpackKeywords(data) if backPhrase == "" then return nil, "no_backpack" end weaponKw = (weaponKw or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if weaponKw == "" then return nil, "no_weapon" end local backKw = NebbieDash.macroBackpackKeywordFromPhrase(backPhrase, backOverride) local putAwayKw = "" if not opts.handsEmpty then putAwayKw = ((opts.putAwayKw or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")) or "" if putAwayKw == "" then local wieldPhrase = NebbieDash.currentWieldedKeyword(data) if wieldPhrase ~= "" and data.eqUpdated then local wieldItem = nil for _, row in ipairs(NebbieDash.buildEquipRows(data)) do if not row.empty and row.location == "impugnato" then wieldItem = row.item break end end if wieldItem then local resolved, isOv = NebbieDash.resolveItemKeywords(wieldItem) putAwayKw = NebbieDash.macroBackpackKeywordFromPhrase(resolved, isOv) else putAwayKw = NebbieDash.macroBackpackKeywordFromPhrase(wieldPhrase, false) end end end end local doPutAway = putAwayKw ~= "" and not NebbieDash.keywordsOverlap(putAwayKw, weaponKw) local steps = {} table.insert(steps, "rem " .. backKw) table.insert(steps, "get " .. weaponKw .. " " .. backKw) if doPutAway then table.insert(steps, "rem " .. putAwayKw) end table.insert(steps, "wield " .. weaponKw) if doPutAway then table.insert(steps, "put " .. putAwayKw .. " " .. backKw) end table.insert(steps, "wear " .. backKw) return steps, nil, putAwayKw end
function NebbieDash.digAutoFlushPendingSwap() local pend = NebbieDash._digSwapPending if not pend then return end NebbieDash._digSwapPending = nil NebbieDash.digAutoRunSwap(pend.weaponKw, pend.label, pend.opts) end
function NebbieDash.digAutoRunSwap(weaponKw, label, opts) if NebbieDash._hungerMacroBusy then -- Fame/sete sta usando lo zaino: coda il cambio dig e riparti dopo. NebbieDash._digSwapPending = { weaponKw = weaponKw, label = label, opts = opts, } cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Dig: attendo fine macro fame/sete prima del cambio arma.
") return true end if NebbieDash._weaponSwapBusy then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Dig: cambio arma gia' in corso.
") return false end local steps, err = NebbieDash.digAutoBuildSwapSteps(weaponKw, opts) if not steps then if err == "no_backpack" then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Dig: nessuno zaino (schiena) — fai <yellow>neq<orange> prima.
") elseif err == "no_weapon" then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Dig: keyword arma mancante (" .. (label or "?") .. ").
") else cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Dig: personaggio non rilevato.
") end return false end local name = NebbieDash.currentChar local data = NebbieDash.getCharData(name) local gen = NebbieDash.beginWeaponSwapGuard(data) NebbieDash.runCommandSequence(steps, NebbieDash.weaponSwapDelay) local timeout = (NebbieDash.weaponSwapDelay or 0.5) * #steps + 4.0 tempTimer(timeout, function() NebbieDash.endWeaponSwapGuard(gen, true) end) -- Traccia cosa abbiamo in mano (come dadomud config.armaattuale). NebbieDash.digAutoState().currentWield = weaponKw return true end
function NebbieDash.digAutoEquipTool() local st = NebbieDash.digAutoState() local name = NebbieDash.currentChar if not name then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Nessun personaggio — attendi prompt o nchar.
") return false end local data = NebbieDash.getCharData(name) NebbieDash.loadItemKeywords() local current = NebbieDash.currentWieldedKeyword(data) if current ~= "" then -- Stasha l'arma combat se non configurata esplicitamente. local pref = NebbieDash.prefs and NebbieDash.prefs.dig_combat pref = (pref or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or "" if pref == "" then st.stashedCombat = current end end local tool = NebbieDash.digToolKeyword() local putAway = current if putAway == "" then putAway = st.currentWield end local ok = NebbieDash.digAutoRunSwap(tool, "dig_tool", { putAwayKw = (putAway ~= "" and not NebbieDash.keywordsOverlap(putAway, tool)) and putAway or nil, }) if ok then st.armed = true st.active = false st.currentWield = tool NebbieDash.digAutoCancelRetry() cecho(string.format( "<green>[NebbieDash] Dig pronto: impugnato <yellow>%s<green>. Digita <yellow>dig<green> per avviare le automazioni.
", tool)) local combat = NebbieDash.digCombatKeyword() if combat ~= "" then cecho("<grey>[NebbieDash] Dig combat (umber): <white>" .. combat .. "
") else cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Nessuna arma combat nota — imposta <yellow>ndig combat <kw><orange>.
") end end return ok end
function NebbieDash.digAutoRequestSanctuaryCheck() local st = NebbieDash.digAutoState() if not st.active then return end st.verifyingSanctuary = true st.quietAttrib = true send("att", false) end
function NebbieDash.digAutoOnAttribFinished() local st = NebbieDash.digAutoState() if not st.verifyingSanctuary then return end st.verifyingSanctuary = false st.quietAttrib = false if not st.active then return end local name = NebbieDash.currentChar local data = name and NebbieDash.getCharData(name) local hasSanc = false if data and type(data.activeSpells) == "table" then for k, _ in pairs(data.activeSpells) do if tostring(k):lower() == "sanctuary" then hasSanc = true break end end end if hasSanc then send("dig", false) else local who = name or "" if who == "" then who = "me" end send("cast 'sanctuary' " .. who, false) tempTimer(2.0, function() local s = NebbieDash.digAutoState() if s.active then send("dig", false) end end) end end
-- --- Trigger handlers (active, oppure armed→active al primo feedback MUD) ---
function NebbieDash.onDigGataLine() if not NebbieDash.digAutoEnsureActiveFromWorld() then return end NebbieDash.digAutoScheduleRetry() end
function NebbieDash.onDigVeinDoneLine() if not NebbieDash.digAutoEnsureActiveFromWorld() then return end NebbieDash.digAutoCancelRetry() NebbieDash.playSystemOrConfiguredSound("dig_done", "dig_done") if type(NebbieDash.armGoldSpendExpected) == "function" then NebbieDash.armGoldSpendExpected("dig_vein", 8) end send("inv", false) NebbieDash.digAutoRunVeinLoot() end
function NebbieDash.onDigHumberInLine() if not NebbieDash.digAutoEnsureActiveFromWorld() then return end local st = NebbieDash.digAutoState() NebbieDash.digAutoCancelRetry() NebbieDash.playSystemOrConfiguredSound("humber", "humber") local combat = NebbieDash.digCombatKeyword() if combat == "" then cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Dig umber: manca arma combat (ndig combat <kw>).
") return end -- Sempre rem+put del dig_tool (non solo se eq cache ha impugnato). local putAway = NebbieDash.digToolKeyword() if st.currentWield and st.currentWield ~= "" then putAway = st.currentWield end cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Dig umber: impugnato <yellow>" .. combat .. "<orange>, ripongo <yellow>" .. putAway .. "<orange>.
") NebbieDash.digAutoRunSwap(combat, "dig_combat", { putAwayKw = putAway }) end
function NebbieDash.onDigHumberOutLine() if not NebbieDash.digAutoEnsureActiveFromWorld() then return end local st = NebbieDash.digAutoState() local who = NebbieDash.currentChar or "" if who ~= "" then send("cast 'heal' " .. who, false) end local tool = NebbieDash.digToolKeyword() -- Riponi arma combat, riprendi dig_tool (come dadomud armaattuale → dig). local putAway = NebbieDash.digCombatKeyword() if putAway == "" and st.currentWield and st.currentWield ~= "" then putAway = st.currentWield end cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Dig: umber morto — riprendo <yellow>" .. tool .. "<orange>, ripongo <yellow>" .. (putAway ~= "" and putAway or "?") .. "<orange>.
") NebbieDash.digAutoRunSwap(tool, "dig_tool", { putAwayKw = (putAway ~= "" and putAway) or nil, }) tempTimer((NebbieDash.weaponSwapDelay or 0.5) * 6 + 0.5, function() local s = NebbieDash.digAutoState() if not s.active then return end NebbieDash.digAutoRequestSanctuaryCheck() end) end
function NebbieDash.onDigSancGoneLine() if not NebbieDash.digAutoEnsureActiveFromWorld() then return end NebbieDash.digAutoCancelRetry() NebbieDash.playSystemOrConfiguredSound("sanc_gone", "dig_warn") NebbieDash.digAutoRequestSanctuaryCheck() end
function NebbieDash.onDigRefreshWarnLine() if not NebbieDash.digAutoEnsureActiveFromWorld() then return end local who = NebbieDash.currentChar or "" if who ~= "" then send("cast 'refresh' " .. who, false) end end
function NebbieDash.onDigTrueSightGoneLine() if not NebbieDash.digAutoEnsureActiveFromWorld() then return end local who = NebbieDash.currentChar or "" if who ~= "" then send("cast 'true sight' " .. who, false) end end
-- True se la riga frantumi riguarda un attrezzo da scavo (non uno scudo/arma -- generica). Il MUD stampa "$p cade a terra in frantumi." con short desc -- (es. "Piccone …" oppure "A mining pick …"). function NebbieDash.digLineLooksLikeBrokenTool(text, toolKw) local lower = NebbieDash.stripColors(tostring(text or "")):lower() if lower:find("piccone", 1, true) then return true end if lower:find("mining pick", 1, true) then return true end if lower:find("%f[%w]pick%f[%W]") then return true end if lower:find("%f[%w]pala%f[%W]") then return true end toolKw = ((toolKw or ""):match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") or ""):lower() if toolKw ~= "" and lower:find(toolKw, 1, true) then return true end return false end
-- Dig senza tool in mano (skills.cpp): riprova get+wield dig_tool. function NebbieDash.onDigNoToolLine() local st = NebbieDash.digAutoState() if not st.active and not st.armed then return end NebbieDash.digAutoCancelRetry() NebbieDash.playSystemOrConfiguredSound("dig_warn", "dig_warn") local tool = NebbieDash.digToolKeyword() cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Dig: manca attrezzo — prendo <yellow>" .. tool .. "<orange> dallo zaino.
") local ok = NebbieDash.digAutoRunSwap(tool, "dig_tool", { handsEmpty = true }) if not ok then NebbieDash.digAutoStop("nessun attrezzo disponibile — automine fermato.") return end if st.active then tempTimer((NebbieDash.weaponSwapDelay or 0.5) * 4 + 0.5, function() local s = NebbieDash.digAutoState() if not s.active then return end NebbieDash.digAutoRequestSanctuaryCheck() end) end end
function NebbieDash.onDigPickBrokenLine() if not NebbieDash.digAutoEnsureActiveFromWorld() then return end local st = NebbieDash.digAutoState() local text = line or (type(getCurrentLine) == "function" and getCurrentLine()) or "" local tool = NebbieDash.digToolKeyword() if not NebbieDash.digLineLooksLikeBrokenTool(text, tool) then return end NebbieDash.digAutoCancelRetry() NebbieDash.playSystemOrConfiguredSound("dig_warn", "dig_warn") -- Mani gia' vuote: solo get+wield (niente rem/put stale). Pulisci cache impugnato. local name = NebbieDash.currentChar if name and type(NebbieDash.patchCachedEqLocation) == "function" then local data = NebbieDash.getCharData(name) if data and data.eqUpdated then NebbieDash.patchCachedEqLocation(data, "impugnato", nil) end end cecho("<orange>[NebbieDash] Dig: piccone in frantumi — prendo <yellow>" .. tool .. "<orange> dallo zaino.
") NebbieDash.digAutoRunSwap(tool, "dig_tool", { handsEmpty = true }) tempTimer((NebbieDash.weaponSwapDelay or 0.5) * 4 + 0.5, function() local s = NebbieDash.digAutoState() if not s.active then return end NebbieDash.digAutoRequestSanctuaryCheck() end) end
function NebbieDash.teardownDigAutomineTriggers() for _, id in ipairs(NebbieDash._digTrigIds or {}) do if id then pcall(function() killTrigger(id) end) end end NebbieDash._digTrigIds = {} if NebbieDash._digAliasId then pcall(function() killAlias(NebbieDash._digAliasId) end) NebbieDash._digAliasId = nil end end
function NebbieDash.installDigAutomineTriggers() NebbieDash.teardownDigAutomineTriggers() NebbieDash._digTrigIds = {} if type(tempTrigger) == "function" then local function add(pat, code) local id = tempTrigger(pat, code) if id then table.insert(NebbieDash._digTrigIds, id) end end add("Fai una mossa maldestra e non riesci a scavare.", [[NebbieDash.onDigGataLine()]]) add("fondo trovi qualcosa.", [[NebbieDash.onDigGataLine()]]) add("Qui non si riesce piu' a scavare, il filone sembra esaurito!", [[NebbieDash.onDigVeinDoneLine()]]) add("ACCIDENTI!!! Qualcosa si muove nel punto in cui hai scavato!", [[NebbieDash.onDigHumberInLine()]]) add("Il tuo sangue si gela al grido di morte di Un umber hulk.", [[NebbieDash.onDigHumberOutLine()]]) add("L'aura bianca che ti circondava svanisce.", [[NebbieDash.onDigSancGoneLine()]]) add("L'aura bianca che ti circonda inizia a diventare meno intensa.", [[NebbieDash.onDigRefreshWarnLine()]]) add("La tua visione torna normale.", [[NebbieDash.onDigTrueSightGoneLine()]]) -- skills.cpp do_miner senza tool in mano add("Forse usando l'attrezzo adatto", [[NebbieDash.onDigNoToolLine()]]) -- fight.cpp MakeScrap: "$p cade a terra in frantumi." (Piccone / A mining pick / …) add("cade a terra in frantumi", [[NebbieDash.onDigPickBrokenLine()]]) end -- Alias dedicato: send() da script/altri alias spesso NON alza -- sysDataSendRequest, quindi active restava false dopo un dig "riuscito". if type(tempAlias) == "function" then NebbieDash._digAliasId = tempAlias([[^dig$]], [[ NebbieDash.digAutoActivateFromDigCommand() send("dig", false) ]]) end end
